exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 12 — See New Places, Meet New Faces
exercises.instructionUz: 12-UNIT — Yangi joylarni ko'r, yangi odamlarni uchrat
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT NOMINING MA'NOSI:
  'See New Places, Meet New Faces'
  = Yangi joylarni ko'r, yangi yuzlarni (odamlarni) uchrat

  Bu — sayohat haqidagi ingliz maqoliga o'xshash ibora.
  'faces' (yuzlar) bu yerda 'odamlar' ma'nosida.
  'places' va 'faces' QOFIYALANADI — shuning uchun
  ibora yodda yaxshi qoladi.


UNIT 12 NING ASOSIY MAVZUSI:
  QIYOSLASh (Comparisons) —
  ikki joyni bir-biri bilan solishtirish.


BETDAGI IKKI ShAHAR:

  STRATFORD-UPON-AVON
    • Angliyadagi TINCh shaharcha
    • Eyvon (Avon) daryosi bo'yida
    • Uilyam Shekspirning tug'ilgan joyi
    • Rasmlarda: eski yog'och uylar, somon tomli uy,
      daryo va qayiq, cherkov minorasi

  LOS ANGELES (LA)
    • AQShdagi ShOVQINLI katta shahar
    • Kaliforniya shtatida
    • Rasmlarda: baland osmono'par binolar, ko'p mashina,
      gavjum ko'chalar, 'HILTON' mehmonxonasi


'UPON' NIMA?
  'Stratford-UPON-Avon' = Eyvon daryosi USTIDAGI Stratford.
  'upon' — 'on' ning eski, rasmiy shakli.
  Angliyada daryo bo'yidagi shaharlar shunday ataladi
  (Newcastle-upon-Tyne, Henley-on-Thames).


'LA' QISQARTMASI:
  'LA' — Los Angeles ning qisqartmasi,
  'el-EY' deb o'qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the adjective-noun collocations to these places.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifat-ot birikmalarini shu joylarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN IKKI USTUN:

  SIFATLAR (qarama-qarshi juftliklar):
     quiet    -  noisy
     clean    -  dirty/polluted
     tall     -  small
     cheap    -  expensive
     modern   -  old
     exciting -  boring

  OTLAR:
     place
     streets
     buildings/houses
     shops/hotels/restaurants
     city/town
     nightlife


HAR BIR JUFTLIK QAYSI OTGA MOS KELADI:

  quiet / noisy          →  PLACE
     (tinch joy / shovqinli joy)

  clean / dirty-polluted →  STREETS
     (toza ko'chalar / iflos ko'chalar)

  tall / small           →  BUILDINGS / HOUSES
     (baland binolar / kichik uylar)

  cheap / expensive      →  ShOPS / HOTELS / RESTAURANTS
     (arzon do'konlar / qimmat do'konlar)

  modern / old           →  CITY / TOWN
     (zamonaviy shahar / eski shaharcha)

  exciting / boring      →  NIGHTLIFE
     (qiziqarli tungi hayot / zerikarli tungi hayot)


QANDAY ANIQLANDI — MANTIQ:
  Har bir sifat juftligi FAQAT bitta otga tabiiy
  ravishda yopishadi:
    • ko'chalar TOZA yoki IFLOS bo'ladi
    • binolar BALAND yoki KIChIK bo'ladi
    • do'konlar ARZON yoki QIMMAT bo'ladi
    • tungi hayot QIZIQARLI yoki ZERIKARLI bo'ladi
  Bu — 'collocation' (so'z birikmasi) deyiladi:
  ma'lum so'zlar bir-biri bilan ODATDA birga keladi.


DIQQAT — 'TALL' va 'SMALL' TENG JUFTLIK EMAS:
  'tall' ning aniq aksi — 'short'.
  Lekin binolar haqida gapirganda ingliz tilida
  'tall buildings' ↔ 'small houses' deyiladi.
  Kitob shuning uchun shu juftlikni bergan.

exercises.instructionEn: Then make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng namunadagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Stratford is a quiet place, WHILE LA is a noisy place.'
  'The streets in Stratford are ...'

QOLIP:
  [Stratford haqida] , WHILE [LA haqida] .

'WHILE' NIMA QILADI:
  'while' — QARAMA-QARShI QO'YISh bog'lovchisi
  ('holbuki', 'esa' ma'nosida).
  Ikki narsani solishtirganda ishlatiladi.
  Undan OLDIN VERGUL qo'yiladi.

  DIQQAT: 'while' ning boshqa ma'nosi ham bor —
  'paytida' (While I was cooking, he arrived).
  Bu yerda esa 'esa/holbuki' ma'nosida.


BARCHA OLTI GAP:

  1  Stratford is a quiet place, while LA is a noisy
     place.                                    (NAMUNA)

  2  The streets in Stratford are clean, while the
     streets in LA are dirty and polluted.

  3  The houses in Stratford are small, while the
     buildings in LA are tall.

  4  The shops and restaurants in Stratford are cheap,
     while those in LA are expensive.

  5  Stratford is an old town, while LA is a modern city.

  6  The nightlife in Stratford is boring, while the
     nightlife in LA is exciting.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Stratford tinch joy, LA esa shovqinli joy.
  2  Stratforddagi ko'chalar toza, LA dagi ko'chalar esa
     iflos va ifloslangan.
  3  Stratforddagi uylar kichik, LA dagi binolar esa baland.
  4  Stratforddagi do'kon va restoranlar arzon,
     LA dagilari esa qimmat.
  5  Stratford eski shaharcha, LA esa zamonaviy shahar.
  6  Stratforddagi tungi hayot zerikarli, LA dagi tungi
     hayot esa qiziqarli.


DIQQAT — 'THOSE' TAKRORDAN QUTQARADI:
  4-gapda 'the shops and restaurants in LA' o'rniga
  'THOSE in LA' deyish mumkin —
  bu ingliz tilida ancha tabiiyroq.

DIQQAT — 'IN' PREDLOGI:
  'the streets IN Stratford' — shahar ichidagi narsa
  uchun IN ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and use the adjectives below to compare the two places, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va quyidagi sifatlardan foydalanib ikki joyni solishtiring, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN 9 TA SIFAT (allaqachon QIYOSIY shaklda):
  noisier, more expensive, cleaner, quieter, more modern,
  more polluted, cheaper, older, more crowded

KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:
  LA is NOISIER THAN Stratford.
  LA is MORE EXPENSIVE THAN Stratford.


QIYOSIY DARAJA QOIDASI (Unit 12 ning asosiy grammatikasi):

  QISQA sifat (1 bo'g'in) → sifat + -ER + THAN
     old    → older    than
     cheap  → cheaper  than
     clean  → cleaner  than
     quiet  → quieter  than

  '-Y' bilan tugagan sifat → -Y tushadi, -IER qo'shiladi
     noisy  → noisIER  than
     dirty  → dirtIER  than
     easy   → easIER   than

  UZUN sifat (2+ bo'g'in) → MORE + sifat + THAN
     expensive → MORE expensive than
     modern    → MORE modern    than
     polluted  → MORE polluted  than
     crowded   → MORE crowded   than
     exciting  → MORE exciting  than

  DIQQAT: 'more noisier' yoki 'more cheaper' XATO —
  IKKALASINI BIRGA ishlatib bo'lmaydi.


BARCHA TO'QQIZ GAP:

   1  LA is NOISIER than Stratford.            (NAMUNA)
   2  LA is MORE EXPENSIVE than Stratford.     (NAMUNA)
   3  Stratford is CLEANER than LA.
   4  Stratford is QUIETER than LA.
   5  LA is MORE MODERN than Stratford.
   6  LA is MORE POLLUTED than Stratford.
   7  Stratford is CHEAPER than LA.
   8  Stratford is OLDER than LA.
   9  LA is MORE CROWDED than Stratford.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  LA Stratforddan shovqinliroq.
   2  LA Stratforddan qimmatroq.
   3  Stratford LA dan tozaroq.
   4  Stratford LA dan tinchroq.
   5  LA Stratforddan zamonaviyroq.
   6  LA Stratforddan ifloslanganroq.
   7  Stratford LA dan arzonroq.
   8  Stratford LA dan eskiroq.
   9  LA Stratforddan gavjumroq.


QAYSI ShAHAR OLDINDA TURADI — MANTIQ:
  Kitob 1-mashqda aytdi: Stratford — TINCh shaharcha,
  LA — ShOVQINLI shahar.
  Shunga ko'ra:
    LA oldinda:        noisier, more expensive,
                       more modern, more polluted,
                       more crowded
    Stratford oldinda: cleaner, quieter, cheaper, older

  Har bir gapni TESKARI ham aytish mumkin
  (Stratford is quieter than LA = LA is noisier than
  Stratford), lekin yuqoridagi shakl eng tabiiy.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  crowded  = gavjum, odam ko'p
  polluted = ifloslangan

exercises.instructionEn: The sentences below describe LA. Try to fill in the missing adjectives, then listen and check.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplar LA ni tasvirlaydi. Yetishmayotgan sifatlarni to'ldirishga harakat qiling, so'ng tinglang va tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI GAP — har birida sifatning BIRINChI HARFI berilgan.
Bu — javobni topishga yordam beradigan ip.

TO'LIQ GAPLAR (to'ldirilgan holda):

  1  The hotels in LA are more EXPENSIVE than those in
     many other American cities.
  2  There are many INTERESTING places you can visit.
  3  There are FAMOUS restaurants you can eat at.
  4  You can buy CHEAP, fashionable clothes on Melrose
     Avenue.
  5  The nightlife is EXCITING.
  6  LA is a modern, NOISY and crowded city.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  LA dagi mehmonxonalar boshqa ko'p Amerika
     shaharlaridagilardan qimmatroq.
  2  Siz borishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab qiziqarli
     joylar bor.
  3  Siz ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ajoyib
     restoranlar bor.
  4  Melrouz avenyusida arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib
     olishingiz mumkin.
  5  Tungi hayot juda qiziqarli.
  6  LA — zamonaviy, shovqinli va gavjum shahar.


QANDAY ANIQLANDI — HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

  1  'more E......' — 'more' bor, demak UZUN sifat.
     1 va 2-mashq ro'yxatlarida 'e' bilan boshlanadigan
     uzun sifat: EXPENSIVE. Mehmonxona haqida —
     mos keladi. ANIQ.

  2  'many I...... places you can visit' —
     borish mumkin bo'lgan joylar → INTERESTING.
     Bu — turg'un birikma ('interesting places').
     ANIQ.

  3  'There are F...... restaurants' —
     'f' bilan boshlanadigan sifat na 1-mashq, na
     2-mashq ro'yxatida yo'q. LEKIN 83-betdagi maqola
     shu gapni SO'ZMA-SO'Z takrorlaydi:
     'There are FAMOUS restaurants you can eat at.'
     → FAMOUS. ANIQ.

  4  'C......, fashionable clothes' —
     vergul bilan ikkinchi sifat 'fashionable' berilgan.
     'c' bilan boshlanadigan, narx haqidagi sifat:
     CHEAP (1-mashq ro'yxatidan). ANIQ.

  5  'The nightlife is E......' —
     1-mashqda 'nightlife' juftligi aynan
     'exciting - boring' edi. 'e' → EXCITING. ANIQ.

  6  'a modern, N...... and crowded city' —
     1-mashqda 'quiet - NOISY' juftligi 'place' uchun,
     va kitob birinchi qatorida LA ni
     'a NOISY city in the USA' deb atagan.
     'n' → NOISY. ANIQ.


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI SIFATLAR TARTIBI:
  'a modern, noisy and crowded city'
  Uch sifat: birinchi ikkitasi VERGUL bilan,
  oxirgisidan oldin 'AND' qo'yiladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  fashionable = moda, zamonaviy (kiyim haqida)
  an avenue   = keng ko'cha, avenyu
  Melrose Avenue = LA dagi mashhur savdo ko'chasi
  famous      = mashhur
  to visit    = borib ko'rmoq, tashrif buyurmoq

tasks.prompt: 1  The hotels in LA are more e............ than those in many other American cities.
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ.
'more' bor → UZUN sifat kerak.
'e' + narx + mehmonxona → EXPENSIVE.
2-mashqda ham 'more expensive' berilgan.
DIQQAT: 'those' = 'the hotels' o'rniga —
takrordan qutqaradi.
tasks.speak: 1  The hotels in LA are more e............ than those in many other American cities.

tasks.prompt: 2  There are many i............ places you can visit.
tasks.promptUz: Borib ko'rish mumkin bo'lgan joylar qanday?
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ.
'interesting places' — turg'un birikma.
'many' dan keyin KO'PLIK ot ('places').
'you can visit' — 'places' ni aniqlaydi
('which' tushirib qoldirilgan).
tasks.speak: 2  There are many i............ places you can visit.

tasks.prompt: 3  There are f............ restaurants you can eat at.
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ — 83-betdagi maqoladan TASDIQLANGAN.
Maqolaning 'EATING OUT' bo'limi so'zma-so'z shunday
boshlanadi: 'There are FAMOUS restaurants you can
eat at, like the Buffalo Club ...'
'famous' = mashhur.
DIQQAT: 'eat AT' — predlog gap oxirida
(restoranDA ovqatlanmoq).
tasks.speak: 3  There are f............ restaurants you can eat at.

tasks.prompt: 4  You can buy c............, fashionable clothes on Melrose Avenue.
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ.
'c' + narx → CHEAP (1-mashq ro'yxatidan).
Ma'no ham mos: 'arzon, lekin moda kiyimlar'.
'Melrose Avenue' — LA dagi mashhur savdo ko'chasi.
'ON ... Avenue' — ko'cha bilan predlog ON.
tasks.speak: 4  You can buy c............, fashionable clothes on Melrose Avenue.

tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ.
1-mashqda 'nightlife' juftligi aynan
'exciting - boring' edi.
'e' → EXCITING.
LA — shovqinli, gavjum shahar → tungi hayoti
ZERIKARLI emas, QIZIQARLI.

tasks.prompt: 6  LA is a modern, n............ and crowded city.
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ.
Kitobning 1-mashqdagi birinchi qatori:
'Los Angeles, a NOISY city in the USA'.
'n' → NOISY.
DIQQAT: uch sifat ketma-ket —
'modern, noisy AND crowded'.
tasks.speak: 6  LA is a modern, n............ and crowded city.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan so'zlarni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  film, heavy, 24-hour, sunny, designer,
  famous, expensive, make

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  SUNNY weather        (quyoshli ob-havo)
  2  HEAVY traffic        (zich transport oqimi)
  3  EXPENSIVE shops      (qimmat do'konlar)
  4  FILM stars           (kino yulduzlari)
  5  to MAKE films        (film suratga olmoq)
  6  DESIGNER clothes     (dizayner kiyimlar)
  7  24-HOUR cafes        (24 soat ishlaydigan kafelar)
  8  FAMOUS restaurants   (mashhur restoranlar)


HAMMASI 83-BETDAGI MAQOLADAN:
  'sunny weather, tall buildings and heavy traffic'
  'the EXPENSIVE shops on Rodeo Drive'
  'It's also home to FILM STARS'
  'Universal Studios to see how they MAKE FILMS'
  'Do you want DESIGNER CLOTHES?'
  '24-HOUR CAFES like Van Go's Ear'
  'There are FAMOUS RESTAURANTS you can eat at'


DIQQAT — 5-BAND BOShQAChA:
  Ro'yxatdagi 7 ta so'z SIFAT yoki OT,
  faqat 'make' — FE'L.
  Bo'shliqdan oldin 'to' turgani shuni ko'rsatadi:
  'TO ...... films' → 'TO MAKE films'.

DIQQAT — '24-HOUR' YOZILIShI:
  Sifat sifatida ishlatilganda 'hour' KO'PLIK
  BO'LMAYDI: '24-hour cafes' ('24-hours' XATO).
  Xuddi shunday: 'a five-minute walk',
  'a ten-year-old boy'.

DIQQAT — 'FILM STARS' va 'DESIGNER CLOTHES':
  Bu yerda birinchi so'z OT bo'lsa ham,
  SIFAT vazifasini bajaradi (ot + ot birikmasi).

DIQQAT — 'HEAVY' NING MA'NOSI:
  'heavy' = og'ir. Lekin 'heavy traffic' = zich
  transport oqimi (og'ir transport EMAS).
  Shuningdek: 'heavy rain' = kuchli yomg'ir.

tasks.whyUz:
Ob-havo haqidagi yagona sifat — SUNNY.
Maqola: 'sunny weather'.
'sunny' = quyoshli (sun + -ny).

'HEAVY traffic' — turg'un birikma.
Maqola: 'tall buildings and heavy traffic'.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'heavy' = ZICH, og'ir emas.

Maqola: 'go to the EXPENSIVE shops on Rodeo Drive'.
'expensive' = qimmat.

'FILM stars' = kino yulduzlari.
Maqola: 'It's also home to film stars'.
DIQQAT: 'film' bu yerda OT, lekin SIFAT
vazifasini bajaradi.

Bo'shliqdan oldin 'TO' turibdi →
FE'L kerak. Ro'yxatdagi yagona fe'l — MAKE.
Maqola: 'Universal Studios to see how they MAKE
FILMS'.
DIQQAT: ingliz tilida 'MAKE a film' deyiladi
('do a film' EMAS).

Maqola: 'Do you want DESIGNER CLOTHES?'
'designer clothes' = mashhur dizayner yaratgan,
qimmat kiyimlar.
83-betdagi C rasmi.

Maqola: '24-HOUR CAFES like Van Go's Ear'.
= 24 soat, tunu kun ishlaydigan kafelar.
DIQQAT: sifat sifatida 'hour' KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI.

Maqola: 'There are FAMOUS restaurants you can
eat at'.
82-betdagi 3-mashqning 3-bandi ham shu edi.
'famous' = mashhur.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: of, in, at, to, with, on
exercises.instructionUz: To'ldiring: of, in, at, to, with, on
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI PREDLOG, 10 ta bo'shliq —
demak ba'zilari BIR NEChA marta ishlatiladi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  the second largest city IN America
   2  it's home TO film stars
   3  close TO special bus-stops
   4  footprints OF film stars
   5  you can get rides TO the various sights
   6  eat AT a restaurant
   7  packed WITH celebrities
   8  IN the world
   9  ON Rodeo Drive
  10  popular WITH visitors


QAYSI PREDLOG NECHA MARTA:
  TO   — 3 marta (2, 3, 5)
  IN   — 2 marta (1, 8)
  WITH — 2 marta (7, 10)
  OF   — 1 marta (4)
  AT   — 1 marta (6)
  ON   — 1 marta (9)


QOIDALAR:

  IN + katta joy (mamlakat, shahar, dunyo)
     in America, in the world, in Tashkent

  ON + ko'cha, avenyu
     on Rodeo Drive, on Melrose Avenue
     DIQQAT: 'in' EMAS!

  AT + aniq nuqta (bino, muassasa)
     at a restaurant, at a hotel, at school

  TO + yo'nalish yoki yaqinlik
     home TO ... (makoni)
     close TO ... (yaqin)
     rides TO ... (qayerga)

  OF + egalik / tegishlilik
     footprints OF film stars

  WITH + birgalik yoki to'lganlik
     packed WITH, popular WITH


ESLAB QOLISh UChUN TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR:
  be home TO ...     = ... ning makoni bo'lmoq
  close TO ...       = ... ga yaqin
  packed WITH ...    = ... bilan to'lib ketgan
  popular WITH ...   = ... orasida mashhur

tasks.whyUz:
MAMLAKAT bilan IN.
'in America', 'in Uzbekistan'.

'be home TO ...' — turg'un birikma
(... ning makoni bo'lmoq).
DIQQAT: 'home OF' EMAS.

'close TO ...' — turg'un birikma (... ga yaqin).
DIQQAT: 'close FROM' XATO.

EGALIK: kimning izlari? → film stars NING.
'OF' egalikni bildiradi.

tasks.prompt: 5  you can get rides ........ the various sights
tasks.whyUz:
YO'NALISh: qayerga? → sights GA.
'a ride TO ...' = ... ga yo'l/sayohat.
tasks.speak: 5  you can get rides ........ the various sights

tasks.whyUz:
'eat AT a restaurant' — muassasa bilan AT.
83-betdagi maqola: 'eat AT the Border Grill'.
DIQQAT: 'eat IN a restaurant' ham aytiladi,
lekin kitob 'at' shaklini o'rgatadi.

'packed WITH ...' — turg'un birikma
(... bilan to'lib ketgan).
TO'LGANLIK har doim WITH bilan.

'IN the world' — turg'un birikma.
Maqola: 'one of the most exciting museums IN THE
WORLD'.
ORTTIRMA daraja bilan doim 'in' yoki 'of'.

KO'ChA bilan ON.
'ON Rodeo Drive', 'ON Melrose Avenue'.
DIQQAT: 'in Rodeo Drive' XATO.

'popular WITH ...' — turg'un birikma
(... orasida mashhur).
DIQQAT: 'popular AMONG' ham to'g'ri, lekin
kitob 'with' shaklini beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the synonyms.
exercises.instructionUz: Sinonimlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SINONIM — bir xil ma'noli boshqa so'z.

RO'YXAT (6 ta):
  district, not dangerous, memorable, well-known,
  interesting, near

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  safe          =  NOT DANGEROUS
  2  close         =  NEAR
  3  fascinating   =  INTERESTING
  4  famous        =  WELL-KNOWN
  5  unforgettable =  MEMORABLE
  6  area          =  DISTRICT


HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

  safe (xavfsiz) = not dangerous (xavfli emas)
     'dangerous' ning INKORI.
     Maqola: 'they are clean and SAFE'.

  close (yaqin) = near (yaqin)
     Ikkalasi ham masofani bildiradi.
     DIQQAT: 'close' predlogi TO,
     'near' esa predlogsiz: 'near the school'.

  fascinating (maftunkor) = interesting (qiziqarli)
     'fascinating' — kuchliroq shakl.
     Maqola oxiri: 'but it's also FASCINATING'.

  famous (mashhur) = well-known (yaxshi tanilgan)
     'well-known' = well + known (chiziqcha bilan).

  unforgettable (unutilmas) = memorable (esda qolarli)
     'memorable' — 'memory' (xotira) dan.
     'unforgettable' — un + forget + able.

  area (hudud) = district (tuman, hudud)
     Maqola: 'the Sunset Strip, an AREA in Hollywood'.


NIMANI O'RGATADI:
  Bir gapni turlicha aytish mumkin:
     'The hotels are safe.'
     'The hotels are not dangerous.'
  Yozishda TAKRORDAN qochish uchun sinonimlar
  kerak bo'ladi.

tasks.whyUz:
'safe' = xavfsiz.
'not dangerous' = xavfli emas.
Yagona INKOR shaklidagi variant.

Ikkalasi ham 'yaqin'.
DIQQAT: 'close TO the shop' (predlog bilan),
'NEAR the shop' (predlogsiz).

'fascinating' = maftunkor —
'interesting' ning KUChLIROQ shakli.
82-betdagi 3-mashqda ham 'interesting places'.

'well-known' = yaxshi tanilgan, mashhur.
Chiziqcha bilan yoziladi.
5-mashqning 8-bandi: 'famous restaurants'.

'memorable' = esda qolarli ('memory' dan).
'unforgettable' = un + forget + able = unutilmas.
Maqola: 'A visit there is always UNFORGETTABLE.'

Ikkalasi ham 'hudud'.
Maqola: 'the Sunset Strip, an AREA in Hollywood'.
'district' — ko'proq shahar ichidagi tuman.

exercises.instructionEn: Circle the wrong word. IN MY TOWN ...
exercises.instructionUz: NOTO'G'RI so'zni aylantiring. MENING SHAHRIMDA ...
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — BU MAShQ TESKARI:
  Odatda TO'G'RI variantni tanlaysiz.
  Bu yerda esa NOTO'G'RI so'zni topish kerak.

Har qatorda TO'RT sifat bor — uchtasi otga
MOS KELADI, bittasi esa MOS KELMAYDI.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR (noto'g'ri so'zlar):
  1  HEAVY      (building)
  2  POLLUTED   (hotel)
  3  CROWDED    (nightlife)
  4  DELICIOUS  (restaurant)
  5  FRIENDLY   (streets)


HAR BIRI NEGA NOTO'G'RI:

  1  'The museum is a ...... BUILDING.'
     tall ✓  small ✓  modern ✓  HEAVY ✗
     'heavy' = og'ir — BINO haqida aytilmaydi.
     'heavy' odatda: heavy traffic, heavy rain,
     heavy bag.

  2  'You can stay in a ...... HOTEL.'
     luxurious ✓  cheap ✓  expensive ✓  POLLUTED ✗
     'polluted' = ifloslangan — HAVO, SUV, ShAHAR
     haqida aytiladi, mehmonxona haqida emas.

  3  'The NIGHTLIFE is ...... .'
     interesting ✓  dull ✓  boring ✓  CROWDED ✗
     'crowded' = gavjum — JOY haqida aytiladi
     (a crowded street, a crowded city),
     'nightlife' esa TUShUNChA.

  4  'You can have dinner in a very ......
      RESTAURANT.'
     romantic ✓  clean ✓  famous ✓  DELICIOUS ✗
     'delicious' = mazali — faqat OVQAT haqida.
     'a delicious dish' ✓ / 'a delicious
     restaurant' ✗

  5  'The STREETS are ...... .'
     dangerous ✓  safe ✓  crowded ✓  FRIENDLY ✗
     'friendly' = do'stona — ODAMLAR haqida
     aytiladi ('friendly people'), ko'chalar
     haqida emas.


UMUMIY QOIDA — COLLOCATION:
  Ingliz tilida ma'lum sifatlar ma'lum otlar
  bilan BIRGA keladi. Bu 'collocation' deyiladi.
  Grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri bo'lsa ham, noto'g'ri
  juftlik G'ALATI eshitiladi.

  Coursebook 82-betdagi 1-mashq ham aynan shu
  haqda edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  luxurious = hashamatli
  dull      = zerikarli ('boring' ning sinonimi)
  tasty     = mazali

tasks.prompt: 1  The museum is a tall / small / modern / heavy building.
tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI: HEAVY.
'heavy' = og'ir — BINO haqida aytilmaydi.
'heavy' odatda: heavy TRAFFIC (zich transport),
heavy RAIN (kuchli yomg'ir), heavy BAG (og'ir sumka).
Tall, small, modern — hammasi bino uchun to'g'ri.

tasks.prompt: 2  You can stay in a luxurious / polluted / cheap / expensive hotel.
tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI: POLLUTED.
'polluted' = ifloslangan — HAVO, SUV yoki
SHAHAR haqida aytiladi ('a polluted city'),
mehmonxona haqida emas.
'luxurious' = hashamatli.

tasks.prompt: 3  The nightlife is crowded / interesting / dull / boring.
tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI: CROWDED.
'crowded' = gavjum — JOY haqida aytiladi
('a crowded street'), 'nightlife' esa
TUSHUNCHA (aniq joy emas).
'dull' = zerikarli ('boring' ning sinonimi).

tasks.prompt: 4  You can have dinner in a very romantic / clean / famous / delicious restaurant.
tasks.promptUz: Siz juda ... restoranda kechki ovqat qilishingiz mumkin.
tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI: DELICIOUS.
'delicious' = mazali — faqat OVQAT haqida.
'a delicious dish' ✓
'a delicious restaurant' ✗
To'g'ri bo'lardi: 'a restaurant with delicious food'.

tasks.prompt: 5  The streets are dangerous / safe / crowded / friendly.
tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI: FRIENDLY.
'friendly' = do'stona — ODAMLAR haqida aytiladi
('friendly people', 'friendly staff'),
ko'chalar haqida emas.
Dangerous, safe, crowded — hammasi ko'cha uchun
to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda namunadagidek savol bering va javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: 'WHAT IS the museum LIKE in your town?'
  SB: 'It is a modern building.'
  SA: 'WHERE CAN I stay in your town?'
  SB: 'You can stay in a luxurious hotel.'


IKKI SAVOL QOLIPI:

  1) 'What is X LIKE in your town?'
     = Shahringizda X qanday?
     DIQQAT: 'like' bu yerda 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS —
     TASVIRLASh so'raydi.
     Coursebook 85-betdagi 15-mashqda ham
     shu qolip bor edi ('What was New York like?').

  2) 'Where can I + fe'l ... in your town?'
     = Shahringizda qayerda ... qilishim mumkin?


BESh SAVOL-JAVOB (1a-mashqning gaplaridan):

  1  SA: What is the museum like in your town?
     SB: It is a modern building.        (NAMUNA)

  2  SA: Where can I stay in your town?
     SB: You can stay in a luxurious hotel. (NAMUNA)

  3  SA: What is the nightlife like in your town?
     SB: It is very interesting.

  4  SA: Where can I have dinner in your town?
     SB: You can have dinner in a very famous
         restaurant.

  5  SA: What are the streets like in your town?
     SB: They are safe but crowded.


DIQQAT — 'IS' va 'ARE':
  'What IS the museum like?'   (birlik)
  'What ARE the streets like?' (ko'plik)
  Javobda ham: 'IT is ...' / 'THEY are ...'

tasks.answer: SA: What is the museum like in your town? — SB: It is a modern building.
tasks.promptUz: Shahringizda muzey qanday? — U zamonaviy bino. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

tasks.promptUz: Shahringizda qayerda turishim mumkin? — Hashamatli mehmonxonada turishingiz mumkin. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

tasks.answer: SA: What is the nightlife like in your town? — SB: It is very interesting.
tasks.promptUz: Shahringizda tungi hayot qanday? — U juda qiziqarli.

tasks.answer: SA: Where can I have dinner in your town? — SB: You can have dinner in a very famous restaurant.
tasks.promptUz: Shahringizda qayerda kechki ovqat qilishim mumkin? — Juda mashhur restoranda ovqatlanishingiz mumkin.

tasks.answer: SA: What are the streets like in your town? — SB: They are safe but crowded.
tasks.promptUz: Shahringizda ko'chalar qanday? — Ular xavfsiz, lekin gavjum. (KO'PLIK → 'are' va 'they')

  Bu yerda esa 'heavy TRAFFIC' va 'friendly

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the opposites of the adjectives in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qalin yozilgan sifatlarning ZIDLARI bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR SAVOLDA QALIN sifat bor —
javobda uning ZIDINI yozish kerak.

Javob DOIM 'No, ...' bilan boshlanadi —
ya'ni savoldagi sifat NOTO'G'RI.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  quiet    →  NOISY       (tinch → shovqinli)
  2  big      →  SMALL       (katta → kichik)
  3  safe     →  DANGEROUS   (xavfsiz → xavfli)
  4  dirty    →  CLEAN       (iflos → toza)
  5  modern   →  OLD         (zamonaviy → eski)
  6  boring   →  EXCITING    (zerikarli → qiziqarli)
  7  cheap    →  EXPENSIVE   (arzon → qimmat)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  A: Nyu-York tinch shaharmi?
     B: Yo'q, u juda shovqinli.
  2  A: Katta uydami yashaysiz?
     B: Yo'q, men kichkina uyda yashayman.
  3  A: Kechasi yolg'iz yurish xavfsizmi?
     B: Yo'q, ancha xavfli.
  4  A: Mamlakatingizdagi plyajlar iflosmi?
     B: Yo'q, ular juda toza.
  5  A: Venesiyada ko'p zamonaviy binolar bormi?
     B: Yo'q, ko'p eski binolar bor.
  6  A: Venadagi tungi hayot zerikarlimi?
     B: Yo'q, u juda qiziqarli.
  7  A: Milandagi do'konlar arzonmi?
     B: Yo'q, ular ancha qimmat.


HAMMA ZID JUFTLIKLAR Coursebook 82-BETDAGI
1-MAShQDAN:
     quiet   ↔  noisy
     clean   ↔  dirty
     tall    ↔  small
     cheap   ↔  expensive
     modern  ↔  old
     exciting ↔ boring
  Faqat 'safe ↔ dangerous' yangi
  (Coursebook 84-bet, 7-mashqda 'safe = not
   dangerous' berilgan edi).


DIQQAT — KUChAYTIRUVChILARGA E'TIBOR BERING:
  'it's VERY noisy'      (juda)
  'it's QUITE dangerous' (ancha)
  'they are VERY clean'  (juda)
  'they are QUITE expensive' (ancha)
  Bularning hammasi ODDIY sifat bilan keladi
  (Grammar 52-bet qoidasi).


JOY NOMLARI:
  New York — AQSh
  Venice   — Venesiya, Italiya (eski binolari bilan
             mashhur)
  Vienna   — Vena, Avstriya poytaxti
  Milan    — Milan, Italiya (moda markazi)

quiet (tinch) ↔ NOISY (shovqinli).

juftligi.

Coursebook 84-bet, 7-mashqda:
'safe = not dangerous'.

tasks.speak: 5  A: Has Venice got many MODERN buildings?  B: No, there are lots of ............ buildings.

exercises.instructionEn: Use words from the list to write the synonyms of the underlined words in the spaces below.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlardan foydalanib, tagi chizilgan so'zlarning sinonimlarini quyidagi bo'sh joylarga yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (6 ta):
  boring, fascinating, areas, well-known,
  unforgettable, quiet


MATN (tagi chizilgan so'zlar QALIN):

  A visit to Paris is a 1) MEMORABLE experience.
  Here you can see lots of 2) INTERESTING sights or
  enjoy lunch in one of the many 3) FAMOUS
  restaurants in the city. Paris has a large number
  of different 4) DISTRICTS you can visit and many
  excellent shops where you can buy fashionable
  clothes.

  The nightlife in Paris is very popular with
  visitors. You can spend an evening at the theatre,
  enjoy a drink in a cafe or go for a 5) PEACEFUL
  walk along the riverside.

  Don't miss the chance to visit Paris! There is
  never a 6) DULL moment.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Parijga tashrif — unutilmas tajriba. Bu yerda
  ko'plab maftunkor diqqatga sazovor joylarni
  ko'rishingiz yoki shahardagi ko'plab mashhur
  restoranlarning birida tushlik qilishingiz
  mumkin. Parijda borib ko'rish mumkin bo'lgan
  turli hududlar juda ko'p, hamda moda kiyimlar
  sotib olish mumkin bo'lgan a'lo do'konlar bor.

  Parijdagi tungi hayot sayyohlar orasida juda
  mashhur. Kechqurunni teatrda o'tkazishingiz,
  kafeda ichimlik ichishingiz yoki daryo bo'ylab
  tinch sayr qilishingiz mumkin.

  Parijga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang!
  Hech qachon zerikarli daqiqa bo'lmaydi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  memorable    →  UNFORGETTABLE  (unutilmas)
  2  interesting  →  FASCINATING    (maftunkor)
  3  famous       →  WELL-KNOWN     (yaxshi tanilgan)
  4  districts    →  AREAS          (hududlar)
  5  peaceful     →  QUIET          (tinch)
  6  dull         →  BORING         (zerikarli)


DIQQAT — Coursebook 84-BETDAGI 7-MAShQ BILAN
BOG'LIQ:
  U yerda sinonimlar TESKARI yo'nalishda berilgan
  edi:
     unforgettable = memorable
     fascinating   = interesting
     famous        = well-known
     area          = district
  Bu yerda esa AYNAN o'sha juftliklar,
  faqat teskari tomondan.
  Faqat 'peaceful = quiet' va 'dull = boring'
  yangi.


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA KO'PLIK:
  Matnda 'districts' KO'PLIK → javob ham KO'PLIK:
  'AREAS' ('area' emas).


DIQQAT — MATN Coursebook 87-BETDAGI STRATFORD
MAQOLASI QOLIPIDA:
  'Don't miss the chance to visit Paris!'
  Stratford maqolasining oxiri:
  'Don't miss the chance to visit it.'
  Bir xil tugallanma qolipi.


RASMDA: Parijdagi Zafar darvozasi
  (the Arc de Triomphe) va uning atrofidagi
  gavjum yo'l.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  memorable   = esda qolarli
  an experience = tajriba
  a district  = tuman, hudud
  an area     = hudud
  peaceful    = tinch, osoyishta
  dull        = zerikarli
  a moment    = daqiqa, lahza

memorable = UNFORGETTABLE (unutilmas).

  7  Plaka — Afinadagi mashhur sayyohlik hududi.


BESh TURG'UN BIRIKMA — YODLASh KERAK:

  be home TO ...    = ... ning makoni bo'lmoq
  popular WITH ...  = ... orasida mashhur
  eat AT ...        = ... da ovqatlanmoq
  close TO ...      = ... ga yaqin
  packed WITH ...   = ... bilan to'lib ketgan

  Bularning HAMMASI Coursebook 84-betdagi
  6-mashqda ham bor edi.


DIQQAT — 6-BAND: 'IN' yoki 'ON'?
  'You can find cheap shops ...... Park Street.'

  BRITANIYA inglizchasida:  IN ... Street
  AMERIKA inglizchasida:    ON ... Street

  Variantlar: at / of / in →
  'ON' berilmagan, shuning uchun javob 'IN'.

  DIQQAT — SOLIShTIRING:
  Coursebook 84-bet, 6-mashq:
     'ON Rodeo Drive'  (AMERIKA — LA haqida)
  Bu yerda:
     'IN Park Street'  (BRITANIYA)
  Ikkalasi ham TO'G'RI — faqat turli variantlar.


DIQQAT — 4-BAND:
  'close TO' — DOIM 'to' bilan.
  'close of' yoki 'close on' XATO.
  Coursebook 84-bet, 7-mashqda sinonimi:
  'close = near' ('near' esa predlogSIZ:
  'near the station').


DIQQAT — 7-BAND:
  'a tourist area IN Athens' — hudud ShAHAR
  ichida → IN.
  Plaka — Afinadagi eski shahar hududi
  (Akropol etagida).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a train station = temir yo'l vokzali
  a tourist       = sayyoh
  Athens          = Afina (Yunoniston poytaxti)
  Plaka           = Plaka (Afinadagi eski hudud)

sections.title: Reading — Los Angeles, The City of Angels

exercises.instructionEn: Los Angeles — The City of Angels
exercises.instructionUz: Los-Anjeles — Farishtalar shahri
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  LOS ANGELES — THE CITY OF ANGELS

  Los Angeles is THE SECOND LARGEST city in America.
  It's also home to film stars, SUNNY weather, TALL
  buildings and HEAVY traffic.

  ACCOMMODATION
  The hotels in LA are MORE EXPENSIVE than those in many
  other American cities, but they are CLEAN and safe.
  The Biltmore and The Omni are lovely, and close to
  special bus-stops where you can get CHEAP rides to the
  various sights.

  PLACES TO VISIT
  There are many INTERESTING places you can visit, like
  Venice Beach with its street performers, Universal
  Studios to see how they make films, and Griffith Park.
  You can also see the handprints and footprints of film
  stars outside Grauman's Chinese Theatre. Children can
  visit the Children's Museum — one of THE MOST EXCITING
  museums in the world.

  EATING OUT
  There are FAMOUS restaurants you can eat at, like the
  Buffalo Club, a place packed with celebrities, or
  Musso & Frank's, Hollywood's OLDEST restaurant. For
  THE MOST DELICIOUS Mexican dishes, eat at the Border
  Grill.

  SHOPPING
  You can buy CHEAP FASHIONABLE clothes on Melrose
  Avenue. Do you want designer clothes? Then go to the
  EXPENSIVE shops on Rodeo Drive. A visit there is always
  UNFORGETTABLE.

  ENTERTAINMENT
  The nightlife is EXCITING on the Sunset Strip, an area
  in Hollywood with famous clubs like The Whiskey and
  The Roxy. There you can enjoy rock 'n' roll music.
  24-hour cafes like Van Go's Ear are popular with
  visitors.

  LA is a MODERN city with something for everyone. It's
  NOISY AND CROWDED, but it's also FASCINATING.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  LOS-ANJELES — FARIShTALAR ShAHRI

  Los-Anjeles Amerikadagi ikkinchi eng katta shahar.
  U shuningdek kino yulduzlari, quyoshli ob-havo,
  baland binolar va zich transport oqimining makoni.

  TURAR JOY
  LA dagi mehmonxonalar boshqa ko'p Amerika
  shaharlaridagilardan qimmatroq, lekin ular toza va
  xavfsiz. 'Biltmore' va 'Omni' — ajoyib, va siz
  diqqatga sazovor joylarga arzon yetib borishingiz
  mumkin bo'lgan maxsus avtobus bekatlariga yaqin.

  BORISh KERAK BO'LGAN JOYLAR
  Borishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab qiziqarli joylar
  bor: ko'cha artistlari bilan Venis-Bich, filmlarni
  qanday suratga olishlarini ko'rish uchun 'Universal
  Studios' va Griffit parki. Shuningdek Grauman Xitoy
  teatri oldida kino yulduzlarining qo'l va oyoq
  izlarini ko'rishingiz mumkin. Bolalar Bolalar
  muzeyiga borishlari mumkin — bu dunyodagi eng
  qiziqarli muzeylardan biri.

  TAShQARIDA OVQATLANISh
  Ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan mashhur restoranlar
  bor: masalan, mashhur odamlar to'lib ketgan 'Buffalo
  Club' yoki Gollivuddagi eng eski restoran 'Musso &
  Frank's'. Eng mazali meksika taomlari uchun 'Border
  Grill' ga boring.

  XARID QILISh
  Melrouz avenyusida arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib
  olishingiz mumkin. Dizayner kiyimlar xohlaysizmi?
  Unda Rodeo-Drayvdagi qimmat do'konlarga boring.
  U yerga tashrif doim unutilmasdir.

  KO'NGILOChAR
  Gollivuddagi 'The Whiskey' va 'The Roxy' kabi mashhur
  klublar joylashgan Sanset-Strip hududida tungi hayot
  juda qiziqarli. U yerda rok-n-roll musiqasidan
  zavqlanishingiz mumkin. 'Van Go's Ear' kabi 24 soat
  ishlaydigan kafelar sayyohlar orasida mashhur.

  LA — har kim uchun biror narsasi bor zamonaviy shahar.
  U shovqinli va gavjum, lekin ayni paytda maftunkor.


SARLAVHANING MA'NOSI:
  'Los Angeles' ispanchada 'Farishtalar' degani
  ('los angeles' = the angels).
  Shuning uchun shaharning laqabi —
  'The City of Angels' (Farishtalar shahri).


MAQOLADAGI QIYOSIY VA ORTTIRMA DARAJALAR
(Unit 12 ning grammatikasi — MATNDAN toping):

  QIYOSIY (-er / more ... than):
     more expensive than

  ORTTIRMA (the ...-est / the most ...):
     THE SECOND LARGEST city
     one of THE MOST EXCITING museums
     Hollywood's OLDEST restaurant
     THE MOST DELICIOUS Mexican dishes

  DIQQAT: orttirma daraja 'THE' bilan keladi.
  'the largest', 'the oldest', 'the most exciting'.
  Bu — 84-betda batafsil o'rganiladi.


MAQOLADAGI ATOQLI OTLAR:
  The Biltmore, The Omni  — mehmonxonalar
  Venice Beach            — plyaj (ko'cha artistlari)
  Universal Studios       — kinostudiya
  Griffith Park           — park
  Grauman's Chinese Theatre — kinoteatr (yulduzlar izlari)
  Children's Museum       — Bolalar muzeyi
  Buffalo Club, Musso & Frank's, Border Grill — restoranlar
  Melrose Avenue, Rodeo Drive — savdo ko'chalari
  Sunset Strip            — ko'ngilochar hudud
  The Whiskey, The Roxy   — klublar
  Van Go's Ear            — 24 soatlik kafe


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  accommodation = turar joy
  a sight       = diqqatga sazovor joy
  various       = turli xil
  a ride        = yo'l, sayohat (transportda)
  a performer   = artist, ijrochi
  a handprint   = qo'l izi
  a footprint   = oyoq izi
  packed with   = ... bilan to'lib ketgan
  a celebrity   = mashhur odam
  delicious     = mazali
  designer clothes = dizayner kiyimlar
  unforgettable = unutilmas
  entertainment = ko'ngilochar
  fascinating   = maftunkor
  heavy traffic = zich transport oqimi

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures on this page. Which shows: heavy traffic; a museum; a street performer; handprints of film stars; a Mexican dish; designer clothes; a club?
exercises.instructionUz: Shu betdagi rasmlarga qarang. Qaysi biri quyidagilarni ko'rsatadi: zich transport oqimi; muzey; ko'cha artisti; kino yulduzlarining qo'l izlari; meksika taomi; dizayner kiyimlar; klub?
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI RASM — A, B, C, D, E, F, G.

RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  A — oldida 'LOS ANGELES CHILDREN'S MUSEUM' deb
      yozilgan zamonaviy bino
      →  A MUSEUM (muzey)

  B — likopchada meksika taomi: taco, sabzavot, sous
      →  A MEXICAN DISH (meksika taomi)

  C — podiumda oq kostyumdagi uch manekenshi
      →  DESIGNER CLOTHES (dizayner kiyimlar)

  D — sementdagi qo'l izlari, qizil gilam va to'siq;
      odamlar tomosha qilyapti
      →  HANDPRINTS OF FILM STARS
         (kino yulduzlarining qo'l izlari)

  E — yuzi bo'yalgan, rang-barang kostyumdagi odam
      baraban chalyapti; atrofda olomon
      →  A STREET PERFORMER (ko'cha artisti)

  F — qorong'i ichki xona, rang-barang yorug'lik,
      odamlar
      →  A CLUB (klub)

  G — shosseda tirbandlikda turgan yuzlab mashinalar
      →  HEAVY TRAFFIC (zich transport oqimi)


JAVOBLAR RO'YXATI:
  heavy traffic            →  G
  a museum                 →  A
  a street performer       →  E
  handprints of film stars →  D
  a Mexican dish           →  B
  designer clothes         →  C
  a club                   →  F


HAR BIRI MAQOLANING QAYSI BO'LIMIGA TEGIShLI:
  A (muzey)        →  PLACES TO VISIT
  B (taom)         →  EATING OUT
  C (kiyim)        →  SHOPPING
  D (qo'l izlari)  →  PLACES TO VISIT
  E (artist)       →  PLACES TO VISIT (Venice Beach)
  F (klub)         →  ENTERTAINMENT
  G (tirbandlik)   →  sarlavha ostidagi kirish
                       ('heavy traffic')

tasks.en: Read the article and answer the questions.

tasks.en: 1  Where can you stay in LA? What is special about these places?
tasks.uz: 1  LA da qayerda turishingiz mumkin? Bu joylarning nimasi maxsus?
tasks.note: SAVOL — ACCOMMODATION bo'limidan.

tasks.en: You can stay at The Biltmore or The Omni. They are lovely, clean and safe, and they are close to special bus-stops where you can get cheap rides to the various sights. Hotels in LA are more expensive than those in many other American cities.
tasks.uz: 'Biltmore' yoki 'Omni' da turishingiz mumkin. Ular ajoyib, toza va xavfsiz, hamda diqqatga sazovor joylarga arzon yetib borish mumkin bo'lgan maxsus avtobus bekatlariga yaqin. LA dagi mehmonxonalar boshqa ko'p Amerika shaharlaridagilardan qimmatroq.

JAVOB.
'to stay AT a hotel' — predlog AT.
MAXSUS TOMONI: bekatlarga yaqin → arzon yetib
borish mumkin. Bu narxi qimmatligini qoplaydi.

tasks.en: 2  Which places can you visit? What can you see there?
tasks.uz: 2  Qaysi joylarga borishingiz mumkin? U yerda nima ko'rasiz?
tasks.note: SAVOL — PLACES TO VISIT bo'limidan.

tasks.en: You can visit Venice Beach, where you can see street performers; Universal Studios, where you can see how they make films; Griffith Park; Grauman's Chinese Theatre, where you can see the handprints and footprints of film stars; and the Children's Museum, one of the most exciting museums in the world.

tasks.note:

BESh joy sanalgan.
DIQQAT: Griffith Park uchun maqola nima ko'rish
mumkinligini AYTMAYDI — faqat nomini beradi.

tasks.en: 3  Where can you eat? What is special about each place?
tasks.uz: 3  Qayerda ovqatlanishingiz mumkin? Har bir joyning nimasi maxsus?
tasks.note: SAVOL — EATING OUT bo'limidan.

tasks.en: You can eat at the Buffalo Club, which is packed with celebrities; at Musso & Frank's, which is Hollywood's oldest restaurant; or at the Border Grill, which has the most delicious Mexican dishes.
tasks.uz: 'Buffalo Club' da ovqatlanishingiz mumkin — u mashhur odamlar bilan to'lib ketgan; 'Musso & Frank's' da — u Gollivuddagi eng eski restoran; yoki 'Border Grill' da — u yerda eng mazali meksika taomlari bor.

UCh restoran, har birining O'Z maxsus tomoni bor:
  Buffalo Club    → mashhur odamlar
  Musso & Frank's → eng eski
  Border Grill    → eng mazali meksika taomlari

tasks.en: 4  Where can you go shopping? What can you buy there?
tasks.uz: 4  Qayerda xarid qilishingiz mumkin? U yerda nima sotib olasiz?
tasks.note: SAVOL — SHOPPING bo'limidan.

tasks.en: You can go shopping on Melrose Avenue, where you can buy cheap fashionable clothes, or on Rodeo Drive, where there are expensive shops selling designer clothes. A visit to Rodeo Drive is always unforgettable.
tasks.uz: Melrouz avenyusida xarid qilishingiz mumkin — u yerda arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib olasiz; yoki Rodeo-Drayvda — u yerda dizayner kiyimlar sotadigan qimmat do'konlar bor. Rodeo-Drayvga tashrif doim unutilmasdir.
tasks.note:
JAVOB.
IKKI ko'cha — QARAMA-QARShI:
  Melrose Avenue → ARZON, moda kiyimlar
  Rodeo Drive    → QIMMAT, dizayner kiyimlar
'go shopping ON ... Avenue' — ko'cha bilan ON.

tasks.en: 5  Where can you go in the evening? What can you do there?
tasks.uz: 5  Kechqurun qayerga borishingiz mumkin? U yerda nima qilishingiz mumkin?
tasks.note: SAVOL — ENTERTAINMENT bo'limidan.

tasks.en: You can go to the Sunset Strip, an area in Hollywood with famous clubs like The Whiskey and The Roxy. There you can enjoy rock 'n' roll music. You can also go to 24-hour cafes like Van Go's Ear, which are popular with visitors.
tasks.uz: Sanset-Stripga borishingiz mumkin — bu Gollivuddagi 'The Whiskey' va 'The Roxy' kabi mashhur klublar joylashgan hudud. U yerda rok-n-roll musiqasidan zavqlanishingiz mumkin. Shuningdek 'Van Go's Ear' kabi 24 soat ishlaydigan kafelarga ham borishingiz mumkin — ular sayyohlar orasida mashhur.
tasks.note:
JAVOB.
'in the evening' = kechqurun.
IKKI xil joy: KLUBLAR (musiqa) va
24 SOATLIK KAFELAR (sayyohlar uchun).

exercises.instructionEn: Stratford-upon-Avon (article)
exercises.instructionUz: Stratford-upon-Avon (maqola)
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI
(kichik sarlavhalar to'ldirilgan holda):

  STRATFORD-UPON-AVON

  This romantic town is in the south-west of England
  and is Shakespeare's birthplace.

  A) ACCOMMODATION
  The Dukes Hotel and The Swans Nest are two lovely
  places to stay in Stratford. The Dukes Hotel is a
  three-star hotel in the centre of the town, and
  The Swans Nest is next to the River Avon. They are
  both quiet and friendly places.

  B) PLACES TO VISIT
  For sightseeing, get on an open-topped double-decker
  bus and see the town. You can also visit New Place —
  Shakespeare's home, or go for a walk in the beautiful
  Bancroft Gardens and see the open-air entertainers.
  Another fascinating place to visit is Warwick Castle,
  one of the oldest castles in Britain.

  C) EATING OUT
  There are some fantastic restaurants in Stratford,
  too. Have lunch at one of the many restaurants in
  Sheep Street — the food is delicious — or have a
  romantic dinner at the restaurant on a canal boat
  in the Canal Basin.

  D) SHOPPING
  Buy yourself something nice in one of Stratford High
  Street's excellent shops. However, for gifts, the
  street market in Rother Street is the best.

  E) NIGHTLIFE
  Stratford is a small town. There aren't many
  nightclubs, but you can spend an evening at the
  Royal Shakespeare Theatre or enjoy a quiet drink at
  one of the town's friendly pubs. You can also go for
  a walk along the riverside and enjoy the
  peacefulness of the place under the moon and stars.

  Stratford is the ideal place for an interesting
  holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  STRATFORD-UPON-AVON

  Bu romantik shaharcha Angliyaning janubi-g'arbida
  joylashgan va Shekspirning tug'ilgan joyi.

  A) TURAR JOY
  'Dukes Hotel' va 'Swans Nest' — Stratfordda
  turish uchun ikki ajoyib joy. 'Dukes Hotel' —
  shahar markazidagi uch yulduzli mehmonxona,
  'Swans Nest' esa Eyvon daryosi yonida.
  Ikkalasi ham tinch va samimiy joylar.

  B) BORISh KERAK BO'LGAN JOYLAR
  Shaharni tomosha qilish uchun ochiq ustli
  ikki qavatli avtobusga chiqing va shaharni
  ko'ring. Shuningdek 'New Place' — Shekspirning
  uyiga borishingiz, yoki go'zal Benkroft bog'ida
  sayr qilib, ochiq havodagi artistlarni
  ko'rishingiz mumkin. Yana bir maftunkor joy —
  Britaniyadagi eng eski qal'alardan biri
  Uorvik qal'asi.

  C) TAShQARIDA OVQATLANISh
  Stratfordda ajoyib restoranlar ham bor.
  Sheep ko'chasidagi ko'plab restoranlarning
  birida tushlik qiling — ovqati mazali — yoki
  Kanal havzasidagi kanal qayig'idagi restoranda
  romantik kechki ovqat qiling.

  D) XARID QILISh
  Stratford High Street dagi a'lo do'konlarning
  birida o'zingizga biror yaxshi narsa sotib oling.
  Lekin sovg'alar uchun Rother ko'chasidagi
  ko'cha bozori eng yaxshisi.

  E) TUNGI HAYOT
  Stratford — kichik shaharcha. Tungi klublar ko'p
  emas, lekin kechqurunni Qirollik Shekspir
  teatrida o'tkazishingiz yoki shaharning samimiy
  pablaridan birida tinchgina ichimlik ichishingiz
  mumkin. Shuningdek daryo bo'yida sayr qilib,
  oy va yulduzlar ostida joyning osoyishtaligidan
  zavqlanishingiz mumkin.

  Stratford — qiziqarli ta'til uchun ideal joy.
  Unga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang.


DIQQAT — 83-BETDAGI LA MAQOLASI BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  Ikkala maqola ham BIR XIL tuzilishga ega:
     nomi + joylashuvi + qisqa tasvir
     → turar joy
     → ko'riladigan joylar
     → ovqatlanish
     → xarid
     → tungi hayot
     → umumiy taassurot
  Bu — Writing qutisida tushuntirilgan qolip.


DIQQAT — ZAMON:
  Butun maqola HOZIRGI zamonda ('is', 'are',
  'you can'). Joy tasviri DOIMIY holatni
  bildiradi — Writing qutisi ham shuni aytadi:
  'We normally use PRESENT TENSES in this type
   of writing.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a birthplace     = tug'ilgan joy
  sightseeing      = shahar tomosha qilish
  open-topped      = ochiq ustli
  a double-decker  = ikki qavatli avtobus
  open-air         = ochiq havodagi
  an entertainer   = artist, ko'ngil ochuvchi
  a castle         = qal'a ('t' O'QILMAYDI)
  a canal          = kanal
  a basin          = havza
  a gift           = sovg'a
  a street market  = ko'cha bozori
  a nightclub      = tungi klub
  a pub            = pab (ingliz ichimlik joyi)
  the riverside    = daryo bo'yi
  peacefulness     = osoyishtalik
  ideal            = ideal, eng mos
  Don't miss ...   = ... ni boy bermang

exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  Dear Jennifer,

  We're in Boston! It's a very interesting city on
  the east coast of the USA. Boston is famous for
  its colleges, like Harvard University.

  We stayed in the Ritz-Carlton Hotel for one week.
  It had excellent service, but it was quite
  expensive. Now we are at the Bertram Inn. It is
  cheaper and very clean.

  There are many fascinating places to visit here,
  like the Old North Church. I took a lot of
  photographs there. Yesterday, we went to the
  Public Gardens and I went for a ride in a boat.
  Last week we went to the New England Aquarium.
  We saw some seals and a lot of different fish.

  Boston has hundreds of good restaurants. The best
  one so far is Monica's. They have delicious pasta
  dishes.

  Newbury Street is the best area for shopping. The
  Sunflower and Filene's Basement are two very good
  shops. They've got much cheaper prices than the
  others.

  The nightlife is very exciting here too! On
  Tuesday I went to The Roxy and danced to live pop
  music. Cafes are very popular with visitors too.
  My favourite is the Corner Cafe. It's got a great
  atmosphere.

  See you soon.
  Love,
  Hannah


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Jennifer,

  Biz Bostondamiz! Bu AQShning sharqiy sohilidagi
  juda qiziqarli shahar. Boston kollejlari bilan
  mashhur — masalan, Garvard universiteti.

  Biz bir hafta 'Ritz-Carlton' mehmonxonasida
  turdik. Xizmati a'lo edi, lekin ancha qimmat edi.
  Hozir esa 'Bertram Inn' damiz. U arzonroq va juda
  toza.

  Bu yerda borib ko'radigan ko'plab maftunkor
  joylar bor — masalan, Eski Shimoliy cherkov.
  U yerda ko'p suratga tushdim. Kecha biz Jamoat
  bog'iga bordik va men qayiqda sayr qildim.
  O'tgan hafta 'New England' akvariumiga bordik.
  Biz bir nechta tyulen va ko'plab turli baliqlarni
  ko'rdik.

  Bostonda yuzlab yaxshi restoran bor. Hozircha eng
  yaxshisi — 'Monica's'. Ularda mazali makaron
  taomlari bor.

  Nyubari ko'chasi — xarid uchun eng yaxshi hudud.
  'Sunflower' va 'Filene's Basement' — ikkita juda
  yaxshi do'kon. Ularning narxlari boshqalarnikidan
  ancha arzonroq.

  Bu yerda tungi hayot ham juda qiziqarli!
  Seshanbada 'The Roxy' ga bordim va jonli pop
  musiqa ostida raqsga tushdim. Kafelar ham
  sayyohlar orasida juda mashhur. Menga eng
  yoqqani — 'Corner Cafe'. Uning muhiti ajoyib.

  Tez orada ko'rishguncha.
  Mehr bilan,
  Hanna

tasks.en: We're in Boston! It's a very interesting city on the east coast of the USA. Boston is famous for its colleges, like Harvard University.
tasks.uz: Biz Bostondamiz! Bu AQShning sharqiy sohilidagi juda qiziqarli shahar. Boston kollejlari bilan mashhur — masalan, Garvard universiteti.
tasks.note:
KIRISH: joylashuv + nima bilan mashhur.
'famous FOR' — predlog FOR.
'like' = masalan.

tasks.en: We stayed in the Ritz-Carlton Hotel for one week. It had excellent service, but it was quite expensive.
tasks.uz: Biz bir hafta 'Ritz-Carlton' mehmonxonasida turdik. Xizmati a'lo edi, lekin ancha qimmat edi.
tasks.note:
TURAR JOY (1-mehmonxona).
'quite expensive' — 'quite' + ODDIY sifat.

tasks.en: Now we are at the Bertram Inn. It is cheaper and very clean.
tasks.uz: Hozir esa 'Bertram Inn' damiz. U arzonroq va juda toza.
tasks.note:
TURAR JOY (2-mehmonxona).
'cheapER' — QIYOSIY daraja
(Ritz-Carlton bilan solishtirilmoqda).

tasks.en: There are many fascinating places to visit here, like the Old North Church. I took a lot of photographs there.
tasks.uz: Bu yerda borib ko'radigan ko'plab maftunkor joylar bor — masalan, Eski Shimoliy cherkov. U yerda ko'p suratga tushdim.
tasks.note:
KO'RILADIGAN JOY (1).
'take photographs' = suratga olmoq.

tasks.en: Yesterday, we went to the Public Gardens and I went for a ride in a boat.
tasks.uz: Kecha biz Jamoat bog'iga bordik va men qayiqda sayr qildim.
tasks.note:
KO'RILADIGAN JOY (2).
'go for a ride' = sayr qilmoq.

tasks.en: Last week we went to the New England Aquarium. We saw some seals and a lot of different fish.
tasks.uz: O'tgan hafta 'New England' akvariumiga bordik. Biz bir nechta tyulen va ko'plab turli baliqlarni ko'rdik.
tasks.note:
KO'RILADIGAN JOY (3).
'a seal' = tyulen.
'fish' — ko'pligi ham 'fish'.

tasks.en: Boston has hundreds of good restaurants. The best one so far is Monica's. They have delicious pasta dishes.
tasks.uz: Bostonda yuzlab yaxshi restoran bor. Hozircha eng yaxshisi — 'Monica's'. Ularda mazali makaron taomlari bor.
tasks.note:
RESTORAN.
'THE BEST one so far' — ORTTIRMA daraja.
'so far' = hozircha.

tasks.en: Newbury Street is the best area for shopping. The Sunflower and Filene's Basement are two very good shops. They've got much cheaper prices than the others.
tasks.uz: Nyubari ko'chasi — xarid uchun eng yaxshi hudud. 'Sunflower' va 'Filene's Basement' — ikkita juda yaxshi do'kon. Ularning narxlari boshqalarnikidan ancha arzonroq.
tasks.note:
XARID.
'THE BEST area' — ORTTIRMA.
'MUCH CHEAPER ... THAN' — much + QIYOSIY.

tasks.en: The nightlife is very exciting here too! On Tuesday I went to The Roxy and danced to live pop music.
tasks.uz: Bu yerda tungi hayot ham juda qiziqarli! Seshanbada 'The Roxy' ga bordim va jonli pop musiqa ostida raqsga tushdim.
tasks.note:
TUNGI HAYOT (1).
'live music' = jonli musiqa ('layv' deb o'qiladi).
'dance TO music' — predlog TO.

tasks.en: Cafes are very popular with visitors too. My favourite is the Corner Cafe. It's got a great atmosphere.
tasks.uz: Kafelar ham sayyohlar orasida juda mashhur. Menga eng yoqqani — 'Corner Cafe'. Uning muhiti ajoyib.
tasks.note:
TUNGI HAYOT (2).
'popular WITH' — turg'un birikma.
'atmosphere' = muhit, kayfiyat.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table, then say how we form the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'rganing, so'ng sifatlarning qiyosiy va orttirma darajalari qanday yasalishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — TO'LIQ:

 ┌──────────────┬───────────┬───────────────┬──────────────────┐
 │              │ adjective │  comparative  │   superlative    │
 │              │  (sifat)  │   (qiyosiy)   │    (orttirma)    │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ BIR BO'G'INLI│  cheap    │  cheapER      │ THE cheapEST     │
 │   sifatlar   │  large    │  largER       │ THE largEST      │
 │              │  big      │  bigGER       │ THE bigGEST      │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ -Y bilan     │  noisy    │  noisIER      │ THE noisIEST     │
 │  tugaganlar  │           │               │                  │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ IKKI yoki    │ expensive │ MORE expensive│ THE MOST         │
 │ undan ko'p   │           │               │  expensive       │
 │  bo'g'inli   │           │               │                  │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │              │  good     │  better       │ THE best         │
 │  NOTO'G'RI   │  bad      │  worse        │ THE worst        │
 │   sifatlar   │ much/many │  more         │ THE most         │
 │              │  little   │  less         │ THE least        │
 └──────────────┴───────────┴───────────────┴──────────────────┘


QOIDALAR — TO'RT GURUH:

1) BIR BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   qiyosiy:  sifat + -ER
   orttirma: THE + sifat + -EST

   MAXSUS HOLATLAR:
     • '-e' bilan tugasa → faqat -R / -ST
        large → largER → the largEST
        safe  → safER  → the safEST
     • BITTA unli + BITTA undosh bilan tugasa →
       oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI
        big → bigGER → the bigGEST
        hot → hotTER → the hotTEST
        fat → fatTER → the fatTEST

2) '-Y' bilan tugagan sifatlar
   '-y' tushadi, '-IER' / '-IEST' qo'shiladi
     noisy  → noisIER  → the noisIEST
     easy   → easIER   → the easIEST
     happy  → happIER  → the happIEST
     dirty  → dirtIER  → the dirtIEST

3) IKKI va undan KO'P BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   qiyosiy:  MORE + sifat
   orttirma: THE MOST + sifat
     expensive → MORE expensive → THE MOST expensive
     modern    → MORE modern    → THE MOST modern
     beautiful → MORE beautiful → THE MOST beautiful

4) NOTO'G'RI sifatlar — YODLASh kerak
     good        → better → the best
     bad         → worse  → the worst
     much / many → more   → the most
     little      → less   → the least

   DIQQAT: 'gooder', 'baddest', 'more good' —
   HAMMASI XATO.


ENG KO'P UChRAYDIGAN XATOLAR:
  ✗ more cheaper    ✓ cheaper
  ✗ more noisier    ✓ noisier
  ✗ the most oldest ✓ the oldest
  ✗ gooder          ✓ better
  ✗ cheapest city   ✓ THE cheapest city

  ASOSIY QOIDA: -ER/-EST va MORE/MOST ni
  BIRGA ishlatib bo'lmaydi.
  ORTTIRMA daraja DOIM 'THE' bilan keladi.

tasks.en: Study the table, then say how we form the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives.
tasks.uz: Jadvalni o'rganing, so'ng sifatlarning qiyosiy va orttirma darajalari qanday yasalishini ayting.

tasks.en: one-syllable adjectives: cheap → cheaper → the cheapest
tasks.uz: bir bo'g'inli sifatlar: arzon → arzonroq → eng arzon
tasks.note: Qoida: sifat + -ER / THE + sifat + -EST.

tasks.en: large → larger → the largest
tasks.uz: katta → kattaroq → eng katta
tasks.note: '-e' bilan tugasa → faqat -R va -ST qo'shiladi.

tasks.en: big → bigger → the biggest
tasks.uz: katta → kattaroq → eng katta
tasks.note:
BITTA unli + BITTA undosh →
oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI (big → bigGer).

tasks.en: -y adjectives: noisy → noisier → the noisiest
tasks.uz: -y bilan tugagan sifatlar: shovqinli → shovqinliroq → eng shovqinli
tasks.note: '-y' tushadi, '-IER' / '-IEST' qo'shiladi.

tasks.en: adjectives with two or more syllables: expensive → more expensive → the most expensive
tasks.uz: ikki yoki undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar: qimmat → qimmatroq → eng qimmat
tasks.note:
MORE va THE MOST bilan.
'expensiver' XATO.

tasks.en: irregular: good → better → the best
tasks.uz: noto'g'ri: yaxshi → yaxshiroq → eng yaxshi
tasks.note: YODLASh kerak. 'gooder' XATO.

tasks.en: irregular: bad → worse → the worst
tasks.uz: noto'g'ri: yomon → yomonroq → eng yomon
tasks.note: YODLASh kerak. 'badder' XATO.

tasks.en: irregular: much / many → more → the most
tasks.uz: noto'g'ri: ko'p → ko'proq → eng ko'p
tasks.note:
'much' SANALMAYDIGAN ot bilan,
'many' SANALADIGAN ot bilan.
Qiyosiy shakli ikkalasi uchun bir xil: MORE.

tasks.en: irregular: little → less → the least
tasks.uz: noto'g'ri: kam → kamroq → eng kam
tasks.note: 'much/many' ning AKSI.

exercises.instructionEn: Use
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'llanishi
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — TO'RT QOIDA:


1) QIYOSIY DARAJA (comparative form)
   IKKI odam, narsa, joyni solishtiradi.
   Odatda 'THAN' bilan keladi.

   NAMUNA:
     'The Parthenon is OLDER THAN the Colosseum.'
     (Parfenon Kolizeydan eskiroq.)


2) ORTTIRMA DARAJA (superlative form)
   IKKIDAN KO'P odam, narsa, joyni solishtiradi.
   'THE ... OF' yoki 'THE ... IN' bilan keladi.

   NAMUNA:
     'The Great Pyramid of Cheops is THE OLDEST OF ALL.'
     (Xeops piramidasi hammasidan eng eski.)


3) (NOT) AS + sifat + AS
   Ikki narsani TENGLIK bo'yicha solishtiradi.

   NAMUNA:
     'Stratford-upon-Avon ISN'T AS NOISY AS LA.'
     (Stratford LA chalik shovqinli emas.)

   DIQQAT — IKKI XIL MA'NO:
     'A is AS big AS B'      = A B chalik katta (TENG)
     'A ISN'T AS big AS B'   = A B chalik katta emas
                               (A kichikroq)

   DIQQAT: 'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY
   shakli qo'yiladi ('as noisier as' XATO).


4) MUCH + qiyosiy daraja
   Farqni KUChAYTIRADI ('ancha', 'juda').

   NAMUNA:
     'Stratford is MUCH QUIETER than LA.'
     (Stratford LA dan ancha tinchroq.)

   DIQQAT: 'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan,
   oddiy sifat bilan EMAS ('much quiet' XATO).


BETDAGI UCh TARIXIY YODGORLIK (rasmlarda):

  The Great Pyramid of Cheops  —  2465 BC (m.a.)
     Misrdagi Xeops piramidasi — ENG ESKI

  The Parthenon                —  438 BC (m.a.)
     Afinadagi Parfenon ibodatxonasi — o'rtada

  The Colosseum                —  82 AD (milodiy)
     Rimdagi Kolizey — ENG YANGI

  'BC' = Before Christ = miloddan avvalgi
  'AD' = Anno Domini   = milodiy

  DIQQAT — SANALARNI TAQQOSLASh:
  'BC' sanalarida son KATTA bo'lsa,
  vaqt UZOQROQ (eskiroq).
  2465 BC > 438 BC → piramida Parfenondan ESKIROQ.


ShU UCh YODGORLIK BILAN GAPLAR:
  The Parthenon is older than the Colosseum.
  The Great Pyramid is older than the Parthenon.
  The Great Pyramid of Cheops is the oldest of all.
  The Colosseum is the newest of the three.
  The Colosseum isn't as old as the Parthenon.
  The Great Pyramid is much older than the Colosseum.

tasks.en: Use
tasks.uz: Qo'llanishi

tasks.en: We use the comparative form to compare two people, things, places etc. We usually use than with comparative adjectives.
tasks.uz: Qiyosiy darajani IKKI odam, narsa, joyni solishtirish uchun ishlatamiz. Odatda 'than' bilan.
tasks.note: IKKITA narsa → QIYOSIY daraja.

tasks.en: The Parthenon is older than the Colosseum.
tasks.uz: Parfenon Kolizeydan eskiroq.
tasks.note:
Parfenon — 438 BC, Kolizey — 82 AD.
Parfenon ancha oldin qurilgan.

tasks.en: We use the superlative form to compare more than two people, things, places etc. We use the ... of/in with superlative adjectives.
tasks.uz: Orttirma darajani IKKIDAN KO'P odam, narsa, joyni solishtirish uchun ishlatamiz. 'the ... of/in' bilan.
tasks.note:
UCh yoki undan ko'p → ORTTIRMA daraja.
DOIM 'THE' bilan.

tasks.en: The Great Pyramid of Cheops is the oldest of all.
tasks.uz: Xeops piramidasi hammasidan eng eski.
tasks.note:
2465 BC — uchtasining eng eskisi.
'the oldest OF all' — 'of' bilan.

tasks.en: We can also use (not) as + adjective + as to compare two places, things, people, etc.
tasks.uz: Shuningdek '(not) as + sifat + as' ni ikki joy, narsa, odamni solishtirish uchun ishlatishimiz mumkin.
tasks.note: 'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli.

tasks.en: Stratford-upon-Avon isn't as noisy as LA.
tasks.uz: Stratford-upon-Avon LA chalik shovqinli emas.
tasks.note:
= LA Stratforddan shovqinliroq.
Bir fikrni ikki xil aytish mumkin.

tasks.en: We use much + comparative degree.
tasks.uz: 'much' ni qiyosiy daraja bilan ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
Farqni KUCHAYTIRADI ('ancha', 'juda').
'much quiet' XATO — faqat qiyosiy daraja bilan.

tasks.en: Stratford is much quieter than LA.
tasks.uz: Stratford LA dan ancha tinchroq.
tasks.note: 'much' + 'quieter' (qiyosiy).

tasks.en: The Great Pyramid of Cheops (2465 BC) — The Parthenon (438 BC) — The Colosseum (82 AD)
tasks.uz: Xeops piramidasi (m.a. 2465) — Parfenon (m.a. 438) — Kolizey (mil. 82)
tasks.note:
BC = miloddan avvalgi, AD = milodiy.
BC sanasi KATTA bo'lsa — ESKIROQ.
Eng eskisi: piramida. Eng yangisi: Kolizey.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA JADVALI:

 ┌───────────┬─────────────┬────────────────┐
 │ adjective │ comparative │  superlative   │
 ├───────────┼─────────────┼────────────────┤
 │  large    │  larger     │  the largest   │
 │  sunny    │  sunnier    │  the sunniest  │
 └───────────┴─────────────┴────────────────┘

83-betdagi maqolada tagi chizilgan sifatlar
asosida jadvalni davom ettiring.


TO'LIQ JADVAL — MAQOLADAGI HAMMA SIFAT:

  BIR BO'G'INLI (-ER / THE -EST):
    large   →  larger   →  the largest      (NAMUNA)
    tall    →  taller   →  the tallest
    clean   →  cleaner  →  the cleanest
    cheap   →  cheaper  →  the cheapest
    old     →  older    →  the oldest
    safe    →  safer    →  the safest

  -Y BILAN TUGAGAN (-IER / THE -IEST):
    sunny   →  sunnier  →  the sunniest     (NAMUNA)
    noisy   →  noisier  →  the noisiest
    heavy   →  heavier  →  the heaviest
    lovely  →  lovelier →  the loveliest

  IKKI VA UNDAN KO'P BO'G'INLI (MORE / THE MOST):
    expensive     →  more expensive
                  →  the most expensive
    interesting   →  more interesting
                  →  the most interesting
    exciting      →  more exciting
                  →  the most exciting
    famous        →  more famous
                  →  the most famous
    delicious     →  more delicious
                  →  the most delicious
    fashionable   →  more fashionable
                  →  the most fashionable
    unforgettable →  more unforgettable
                  →  the most unforgettable
    modern        →  more modern
                  →  the most modern
    crowded       →  more crowded
                  →  the most crowded
    fascinating   →  more fascinating
                  →  the most fascinating
    popular       →  more popular
                  →  the most popular


DIQQAT — MAQOLADA ALLAQAChON ISHLATILGANLARI:
  'the second LARGEST city'
  'MORE EXPENSIVE than'
  'one of THE MOST EXCITING museums'
  'Hollywood's OLDEST restaurant'
  'THE MOST DELICIOUS Mexican dishes'


DIQQAT — 'SAFE' VA 'LARGE':
  '-e' bilan tugagani uchun faqat -R va -ST:
     safe  → safER  → the safEST
     large → largER → the largEST

DIQQAT — 'LOVELY':
  '-ly' bilan tugasa ham bu SIFAT (ravish emas),
  shuning uchun '-y' qoidasiga bo'ysunadi:
     lovely → lovelIER → the lovelIEST

tasks.whyUz:
Bir bo'g'inli, '-e' bilan tugagan →
faqat -R va -ST.
Maqolada: 'the second LARGEST city'.

'-y' bilan tugagan → -IER / THE -IEST.
Maqolada: 'SUNNY weather'.

Bir bo'g'inli → -ER / THE -EST.
Maqolada: 'TALL buildings'.

'-y' tushadi → heavIER / the heavIEST.
Maqolada: 'HEAVY traffic'.

Uzun sifat → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolada allaqachon: 'MORE EXPENSIVE than those
in many other American cities'.

Bir bo'g'inli → -ER / THE -EST.
Maqolada: 'they are CLEAN and safe'.

8-mashqdagi jadvalning birinchi qatori.
Maqolada: 'CHEAP rides', 'CHEAP fashionable clothes'.

Uzun sifat → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolada: 'many INTERESTING places'.

Uzun sifat → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolada allaqachon: 'one of THE MOST EXCITING
museums in the world'.

Ikki bo'g'inli → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolada: 'FAMOUS restaurants', 'FAMOUS clubs'.

Bir bo'g'inli → -ER / THE -EST.
Maqolada allaqachon: 'Hollywood's OLDEST
restaurant'.
'Use' qutisidagi namunalar ham shu sifat bilan.

Uzun sifat → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolada allaqachon: 'THE MOST DELICIOUS Mexican
dishes'.

Uzun sifat → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolada: 'cheap FASHIONABLE clothes'.

Uzun sifat → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolada: 'A visit there is always UNFORGETTABLE.'

Ikki bo'g'inli → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolada: 'LA is a MODERN city'.

8-mashqdagi jadvalning '-y' qatori.
Maqolada: 'It's NOISY and crowded'.

Ikki bo'g'inli → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolada: 'It's noisy and CROWDED'.

Uzun sifat → MORE / THE MOST.
Maqolaning oxirgi so'zi: 'but it's also
FASCINATING'.

'-e' bilan tugagan → faqat -R va -ST.
Maqolada: 'they are clean and SAFE'.
7-mashqda sinonimi berilgan: 'not dangerous'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the adjectives in the list to compare LA with the place you live in.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi sifatlardan foydalanib LA ni o'zingiz yashaydigan joy bilan solishtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (13 ta sifat):
  large, clean, noisy, polluted, crowded, small, dirty,
  safe, expensive, old, modern, peaceful, cheap

KITOBDAGI BESh NAMUNA — TO'RT XIL QOLIP:

  1  LA is LARGER THAN my town.
     → qisqa sifat + -ER + THAN

  2  My town is CLEANER THAN LA.
     → qisqa sifat + -ER + THAN (teskari yo'nalishda)

  3  LA is MUCH NOISIER THAN my town.
     → MUCH + qiyosiy daraja (kuchaytirish)

  4  My town is AS NOISY AS LA.
     → AS + oddiy sifat + AS (tenglik)

  5  My town ISN'T AS POLLUTED AS LA.
     → ISN'T AS + oddiy sifat + AS (inkor)


BARCHA 13 SIFAT BILAN NAMUNA GAPLAR
(o'z shahringiz nomini qo'ying):

   large     — LA is larger than my town.
   clean     — My town is cleaner than LA.
   noisy     — LA is much noisier than my town.
   polluted  — My town isn't as polluted as LA.
   crowded   — LA is more crowded than my town.
   small     — My town is smaller than LA.
   dirty     — LA is dirtier than my town.
   safe      — My town is safer than LA.
   expensive — LA is much more expensive than my town.
   old       — My town is older than LA.
   modern    — LA is more modern than my town.
   peaceful  — My town is more peaceful than LA.
   cheap     — My town is cheaper than LA.


QAYSI SIFAT QANDAY YASALADI:

  -ER oladiganlar (bir bo'g'inli):
     large → larger,  small → smaller,
     safe  → safer,   old   → older,
     clean → cleaner, cheap → cheaper

  -IER oladiganlar ('-y' bilan tugagan):
     noisy → noisier,  dirty → dirtier

  MORE oladiganlar (uzun):
     polluted  → more polluted
     crowded   → more crowded
     expensive → more expensive
     modern    → more modern
     peaceful  → more peaceful


DIQQAT — 'MUCH MORE EXPENSIVE':
  'much' + 'more expensive' — ikkalasi birga
  KELISHI mumkin, chunki 'more expensive' —
  bitta qiyosiy shakl, 'much' esa uni kuchaytiradi.

DIQQAT — QARAMA-QARShI JUFTLIKLAR RO'YXATDA:
  large ↔ small        clean ↔ dirty
  noisy ↔ peaceful     expensive ↔ cheap
  old   ↔ modern
  Har juftlikning BIRINI tanlab, gapni
  ikki xil aytish mumkin:
     'LA is larger than my town.'
     'My town is smaller than LA.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL.

YANGI SO'Z:
  peaceful = tinch, osoyishta
             ('peace' — tinchlik dan)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen and put T (true) or F (false) next to each.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va har birining yoniga T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI ShAHAR — rasmlardan:

  LONDON — Angliya poytaxti.
     Rasmda: Big Ben va Parlament binosi, Temza daryosi.
     Katta, gavjum, qimmat, ifloslangan.

  EDINBURGH — Shotlandiya poytaxti.
     Rasmda: gotik uslubdagi cherkov/yodgorlik.
     Ancha kichikroq, tinchroq, arzonroq.


KITOB IKKI JAVOBNI O'ZI BERGAN:
  1  Edinburgh is smaller than London.        →  T
  2  Edinburgh is more dangerous than London. →  F

Bu ikkisi ASOSNI beradi:
  LONDON — ANCHA KATTA va ANCHA XAVFLIROQ shahar.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Edinburgh is smaller than London.        T  (kitob)
  2  Edinburgh is more dangerous than London. F  (kitob)
  3  Edinburgh is noisier than London.        F
  4  London is more polluted than Edinburgh.  T
  5  London is cheaper than Edinburgh.        F


DIQQAT — 3, 4, 5-BANDLAR QANDAY ANIQLANDI:
  Kitob bergan 1 va 2-band bir xil naqshni ko'rsatadi:
  LONDON hamma salbiy ko'rsatkichda oldinda
  (kattaroq, xavfliroq).

  Katta poytaxt = ko'proq odam, ko'proq mashina →
     shovqinliroq (3 → F, chunki LONDON shovqinliroq)
     ifloslanganroq (4 → T)
     qimmatroq (5 → F, chunki London QIMMATROQ)

  Bu — kitobning butun unit davomidagi mantiqiga
  ham mos: 82-betda LA (katta shahar) 'noisier,
  more expensive, more polluted, more crowded',
  Stratford (kichik shaharcha) esa 'cleaner,
  quieter, cheaper' edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Edinburgh   = Edinburg (Shotlandiya poytaxti,
                'EDIN-bara' deb o'qiladi)
  dangerous   = xavfli
  polluted    = ifloslangan

tasks.whyUz:
KITOB BERGAN JAVOB — T.
Edinburg (~500 ming aholi) Londondan (~9 mln)
ancha kichik.
'smaller' — qisqa sifat + -ER.

tasks.prompt: 2  Edinburgh is more dangerous than London.
tasks.whyUz:
KITOB BERGAN JAVOB — F.
Aksincha: LONDON xavfliroq.
Katta shaharda jinoyat ko'proq bo'ladi.
'more dangerous' — uzun sifat + MORE.
tasks.speak: 2  Edinburgh is more dangerous than London.

tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI (F).
LONDON shovqinliroq — u ancha kattaroq,
odam va transport ko'proq.
1-band Edinburgni KIChIKROQ deb tasdiqlagan;
kichik shahar tinchroq bo'ladi.
'noisier' — '-y' → -IER.

tasks.prompt: 4  London is more polluted than Edinburgh.
tasks.whyUz:
TO'G'RI (T).
London ancha kattaroq va transporti zichroq →
havo ifloslanganroq.
DIQQAT: bu bandda gap LONDON dan boshlanadi
(oldingilar Edinburgdan) — diqqat bilan o'qing.
'more polluted' — uzun sifat + MORE.
tasks.speak: 4  London is more polluted than Edinburgh.

tasks.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI (F).
Aksincha: London ANCHA QIMMATROQ —
u Yevropadagi eng qimmat shaharlardan biri.
Edinburgda yashash arzonroq.
'cheaper' — qisqa sifat + -ER.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, agree or disagree with the statements, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, gaplar bilan rozi bo'ling yoki rozi bo'lmang, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI TO'LIQ NAMUNA:

  1  Edinburgh is smaller than London.  T
     'THAT'S TRUE. London ISN'T AS SMALL AS Edinburgh.
      ACTUALLY, Edinburgh is MUCH SMALLER THAN London.'

  2  Edinburgh is more dangerous than London.  F
     'THAT'S FALSE. Edinburgh ISN'T AS DANGEROUS AS
      London. ACTUALLY, London is MUCH MORE DANGEROUS
      THAN Edinburgh.'


JAVOBNING QOLIPI — UCh QISM:

  1-qism:  'That's true.'  yoki  'That's false.'
           (rozi / rozi emas)

  2-qism:  'X ISN'T AS [sifat] AS Y.'
           (tenglikni INKOR qilish)

  3-qism:  'ACTUALLY, X is MUCH [qiyosiy] THAN Y.'
           ('actually' = aslida; 'much' kuchaytiradi)


DIQQAT — 'T' VA 'F' UChUN QOLIP FARQ QILADI:

  T bo'lsa:  gapdagi TARTIB saqlanadi
     (Edinburgh smaller → Edinburgh MUCH smaller)

  F bo'lsa:  tartib TESKARI bo'ladi
     (Edinburgh more dangerous → LONDON much more
      dangerous)


BARCHA BESh JAVOB:

  1  That's true. London isn't as small as Edinburgh.
     Actually, Edinburgh is much smaller than London.

  2  That's false. Edinburgh isn't as dangerous as
     London. Actually, London is much more dangerous
     than Edinburgh.

  3  That's false. Edinburgh isn't as noisy as London.
     Actually, London is much noisier than Edinburgh.

  4  That's true. Edinburgh isn't as polluted as London.
     Actually, London is much more polluted than
     Edinburgh.

  5  That's false. London isn't as cheap as Edinburgh.
     Actually, Edinburgh is much cheaper than London.


YANGI SO'Z:
  actually = aslida, aslini olganda
     Fikrni TUZATISh yoki ANIQLAShTIRISh uchun.
     DIQQAT: 'hozir' ma'nosini BERMAYDI
     (bu ko'p uchraydigan xato).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the superlative forms.
exercises.instructionUz: Orttirma daraja shakllarini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI SAVOL — har birida qavsdagi sifatni
ORTTIRMA darajaga qo'yish kerak.

BARCHA ORTTIRMA ShAKLLAR:
  1  large  →  THE LARGEST
  2  high   →  THE HIGHEST
  3  long   →  THE LONGEST
  4  dry    →  THE DRIEST
  5  small  →  THE SMALLEST
  6  hot    →  THE HOTTEST
  7  tall   →  THE TALLEST


DIQQAT — IKKI MAXSUS HOLAT:

  4-band: DRY → THE DRIEST
     '-y' bilan tugagan → '-y' tushadi, '-IEST'.
     'the dryest' XATO.

  6-band: HOT → THE HOTTEST
     1 unli + 1 undosh → oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI.
     'the hotest' XATO.

  Qolgan beshtasi oddiy: -EST qo'shiladi.


DIQQAT — 'THE' TUShIB QOLMASIN:
  Orttirma daraja DOIM 'THE' bilan keladi.
  'Which is largest desert?' XATO.
  'Which is THE largest desert?' TO'G'RI.

tasks.prompt: 1  Which is ............ (large) desert in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
large → THE LARGEST.
'-e' bilan tugagani uchun faqat -ST qo'shiladi.
tasks.speak: 1  Which is ............ (large) desert in the world?

tasks.prompt: 2  Which is ............ (high) mountain in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
high → THE HIGHEST.
Oddiy -EST qo'shilishi.
'high' = baland (tog', devor haqida).
tasks.speak: 2  Which is ............ (high) mountain in the world?

tasks.prompt: 3  Which is ............ (long) river in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
long → THE LONGEST.
Oddiy -EST qo'shilishi.
tasks.speak: 3  Which is ............ (long) river in the world?

tasks.prompt: 4  Where is ............ (dry) place in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
dry → THE DRIEST.
'-y' tushadi, '-IEST' qo'shiladi.
'the dryest' XATO.
'dry' = quruq.
tasks.speak: 4  Where is ............ (dry) place in the world?

tasks.prompt: 5  Which is ............ (small) country in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
small → THE SMALLEST.
Oddiy -EST qo'shilishi.
tasks.speak: 5  Which is ............ (small) country in the world?

tasks.prompt: 6  Where is ............ (hot) place in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
hot → THE HOTTEST.
1 unli + 1 undosh → 't' IKKILANADI.
'the hotest' XATO.
84-betdagi 'big → biggest' bilan bir xil qoida.
tasks.speak: 6  Where is ............ (hot) place in the world?

tasks.prompt: 7  Which is ............ (tall) building in the USA?
tasks.whyUz:
tall → THE TALLEST.
DIQQAT: 'tall' bino va odam uchun,
'high' esa tog' va devor uchun ishlatiladi.
tasks.speak: 7  Which is ............ (tall) building in the USA?

exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang. So'ng tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI SAVOL — GEOGRAFIK BILIM SINOVI.
Hamma javob ANIQ FAKT, taxmin emas.

TO'LIQ SAVOL-JAVOBLAR:

  1  Which is the largest desert in the world?
     →  A  the Sahara (Sahroi Kabir)

  2  Which is the highest mountain in the world?
     →  C  Mount Everest (Everest tog'i)

  3  Which is the longest river in the world?
     →  C  the Nile (Nil daryosi)

  4  Where is the driest place in the world?
     →  A  in Chile (Chilida — Atakama cho'li)

  5  Which is the smallest country in the world?
     →  C  the State of the Vatican City (Vatikan)

  6  Where is the hottest place in the world?
     →  A  Death Valley (O'lim vodiysi, AQSh)

  7  Which is the tallest building in the USA?
     →  C  the Sears Tower (Sirs minorasi, Chikago)


ESLATMA — 7-BAND HAQIDA:
  Kitob chop etilgan paytda AQShdagi eng baland bino
  Chikagodagi Sears Tower (442 m) edi.
  Keyinchalik u Willis Tower deb qayta nomlangan,
  2013-yildan esa Nyu-Yorkdagi One World Trade Center
  (541 m) undan balandroq.
  Kitobning javobi — o'z davri uchun to'g'ri.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Dunyodagi eng katta cho'l qaysi? — Sahroi Kabir
  2  Dunyodagi eng baland tog' qaysi? — Everest
  3  Dunyodagi eng uzun daryo qaysi? — Nil
  4  Dunyodagi eng quruq joy qayerda? — Chilida
  5  Dunyodagi eng kichik davlat qaysi? — Vatikan
  6  Dunyodagi eng issiq joy qayerda? — O'lim vodiysi
  7  AQShdagi eng baland bino qaysi? — Sirs minorasi

tasks.prompt: 1  Which is the largest desert in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
A — SAHRA (Sahroi Kabir).
Shimoliy Afrikada, ~9 mln km2 —
deyarli AQSh kattaligida.
Gobi (Mo'g'uliston) va Nevada undan ancha kichik.

⚠⚠ MUHIM ANIQLIK: Sahroi Kabir — dunyodagi eng katta ISSIQ cho'l.
Umuman eng katta cho'l esa ANTARKTIDA (~14 mln km2) — u SOVUQ cho'l.
'Cho'l' deganda yomg'ir kam yog'adigan joy tushuniladi, issiq bo'lishi shart emas.
Kitobning javobi maktab darsligi uchun to'g'ri, lekin to'liq javob shu.

tasks.prompt: 2  Which is the highest mountain in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
C — MOUNT EVEREST (8848 m), Nepal/Xitoy chegarasida.
Ben Nevis (1345 m) — Shotlandiyaning eng baland
tog'i.
Mount McKinley (6190 m) — Shimoliy Amerikaning
eng balandi.
DIQQAT: tog' uchun 'HIGH', bino uchun 'TALL'.

⚠ ESLATMA: Mount McKinley 2015-yildan rasman DENALI deb ataladi — bu tog'ning mahalliy (atabask tilidagi) qadimiy nomi.

tasks.prompt: 3  Which is the longest river in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
C — NIL (~6650 km), Afrikada.
Missouri va Mississippi — AQShdagi daryolar,
nisbatan qisqaroq.

⚠⚠ BAHSLI JOY: an'anaviy javob — Nil (~6650 km).
Lekin 2007-yildan beri ba'zi o'lchovlar AMAZONni uzunroq deb ko'rsatadi (~6992 km).
Farq daryoning boshlanish nuqtasi qayerdan hisoblanishiga bog'liq.
Maktab darsliklarida hamon NIL deb beriladi — kitobning javobi shu.

tasks.prompt: 4  Where is the driest place in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
A — CHILIDA: Atakama cho'li.
Ba'zi joylarida yuzlab yil yomg'ir yog'magan.
DIQQAT: uchala variant ham 'C' harfi bilan
boshlanadi — ataylab chalkashtirish uchun.

tasks.prompt: 5  Which is the smallest country in the world?
tasks.answer: the State of the Vatican City
options: the State of the Vatican City
tasks.whyUz:
C — VATIKAN (0,44 km2), Rim ichida joylashgan.
Lyuksemburg (2586 km2) kichik, lekin Vatikandan
ming marta katta.
Uels — Buyuk Britaniya tarkibidagi o'lka,
mustaqil davlat EMAS.

tasks.prompt: 6  Where is the hottest place in the world?
tasks.whyUz:
A — DEATH VALLEY (O'lim vodiysi), Kaliforniya, AQSh.
1913-yilda +56,7 C qayd etilgan —
yer yuzidagi eng yuqori harorat.
Tokio va Malta issiq, lekin bunchalik emas.

tasks.prompt: 7  Which is the tallest building in the USA?
tasks.whyUz:
C — SEARS TOWER (442 m), Chikago.
Empire State Building (381 m) — Nyu-Yorkda,
John Hancock Centre (344 m) — Chikagoda.
ESLATMA: kitob chop etilgan davrda shunday edi.
Hozir Sears Tower 'Willis Tower' deb ataladi va
2013-yildan Nyu-Yorkdagi One World Trade Center
(541 m) undan balandroq.
