exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang, so'ng namunalardagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — BRITANIYADAGI TRANSPORT:

 ┌───────────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┐
 │               │  BUSES  │ TRAINS  │  TAXIS  │
 ├───────────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
 │ expensive     │    ✓    │   ✓✓    │  ✓✓✓    │
 │ safe          │   ✓✓    │  ✓✓✓    │   ✓     │
 │ fast          │    ✓    │  ✓✓✓    │  ✓✓     │
 │ comfortable   │    ✓    │  ✓✓✓    │  ✓✓     │
 └───────────────┴─────────┴─────────┴─────────┘

BELGILARNING MA'NOSI:
  ✓      →  ODDIY shakl        (expensive)
  ✓✓     →  QIYOSIY daraja     (more expensive than)
  ✓✓✓    →  ORTTIRMA daraja    (the most expensive of all)


KITOBDAGI TO'RT NAMUNA (birinchi qator):
  Buses in Britain are EXPENSIVE.
  Trains in Britain are MORE EXPENSIVE THAN buses.
  Taxis in Britain are THE MOST EXPENSIVE OF all.
  Buses in Britain AREN'T AS EXPENSIVE AS taxis.

Demak har bir qator uchun TO'RT gap tuziladi:
  1) ✓ li transport — oddiy shakl
  2) ✓✓ li transport — qiyosiy daraja + THAN
  3) ✓✓✓ li transport — orttirma daraja + OF ALL
  4) ✓ li transport AREN'T AS ... AS ✓✓✓ li transport


BARCHA TO'RT QATOR:

  EXPENSIVE  (buses ✓, trains ✓✓, taxis ✓✓✓)
     Buses in Britain are expensive.
     Trains in Britain are more expensive than buses.
     Taxis in Britain are the most expensive of all.
     Buses in Britain aren't as expensive as taxis.

  SAFE  (taxis ✓, buses ✓✓, trains ✓✓✓)
     Taxis in Britain are safe.
     Buses in Britain are safer than taxis.
     Trains in Britain are the safest of all.
     Taxis in Britain aren't as safe as trains.

  FAST  (buses ✓, taxis ✓✓, trains ✓✓✓)
     Buses in Britain are fast.
     Taxis in Britain are faster than buses.
     Trains in Britain are the fastest of all.
     Buses in Britain aren't as fast as trains.

  COMFORTABLE  (buses ✓, taxis ✓✓, trains ✓✓✓)
     Buses in Britain are comfortable.
     Taxis in Britain are more comfortable than buses.
     Trains in Britain are the most comfortable of all.
     Buses in Britain aren't as comfortable as trains.


DIQQAT — QAYSI SIFAT QANDAY YASALADI:
  expensive   → MORE / THE MOST   (3 bo'g'in)
  comfortable → MORE / THE MOST   (3 bo'g'in)
  safe        → safER / THE safEST ('-e' → faqat -R/-ST)
  fast        → fastER / THE fastEST (bir bo'g'in)

DIQQAT — 'SAFE' QATORI TESKARI:
  Boshqa uch qatorda avtobus eng past ko'rsatkichga
  ega, lekin 'safe' qatorida eng past — TAKSI (✓).
  Shuning uchun bu qatorda gaplar TAKSIdan boshlanadi.

DIQQAT — 'IN BRITAIN' TUShIRIB QOLDIRILMAYDI:
  Kitob har namunada 'in Britain' deb aytadi —
  gap FAQAT Britaniya haqida.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, talk about your city/town using the prompts below, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda, quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib o'z shahringiz haqida gaplashing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN YETTI KO'RSATMA:
  old building, large park, busy road, popular cafe,
  expensive restaurant, famous square, pretty building

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: 'WHICH IS THE OLDEST BUILDING in ...?'
  SB: 'I THINK the Town Hall is the oldest building in
       my city. WHICH IS THE LARGEST PARK?'


QOLIP:
  Savol:  Which is THE [orttirma] [ot] in your city?
  Javob:  I THINK + [nom] is the [orttirma] [ot] in
          my city.  +  keyingi savol

  'I think ...' — o'z FIKRINGIZNI bildiradi
  (aniq fakt emas, shuning uchun yumshoqroq).


HAR BIR KO'RSATMANING ORTTIRMA ShAKLI:

  old building        →  the OLDEST building
  large park          →  the LARGEST park
  busy road           →  the BUSIEST road
  popular cafe        →  the MOST POPULAR cafe
  expensive restaurant→  the MOST EXPENSIVE restaurant
  famous square       →  the MOST FAMOUS square
  pretty building     →  the PRETTIEST building


DIQQAT — YASALISh QOIDALARI:
  old    → oldEST      (bir bo'g'in)
  large  → largEST     ('-e' → faqat -ST)
  busy   → busIEST     ('-y' → -IEST)
  pretty → prettIEST   ('-y' → -IEST)
  popular   → THE MOST popular    (3 bo'g'in)
  expensive → THE MOST expensive  (3 bo'g'in)
  famous    → THE MOST famous     (2 bo'g'in)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a Town Hall = shahar hokimiyati binosi
  a square    = maydon
  pretty      = chiroyli, ko'rkam
  busy        = gavjum, band

exercises.instructionEn: Comparisons — adjective / comparative / superlative
exercises.instructionUz: Qiyoslash — sifat / qiyosiy daraja / orttirma daraja
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI ASOSIY JADVAL:

 ┌───────────────┬───────────┬────────────────┬──────────────────┐
 │               │ ADJECTIVE │  COMPARATIVE   │   SUPERLATIVE    │
 │               │  (sifat)  │   (qiyosiy)    │    (orttirma)    │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ ONE-SYLLABLE  │  cheap    │ cheapER (than) │ THE cheapEST     │
 │  adjectives   │  large    │ largER (than)  │ THE largEST      │
 │ (bir bo'g'inli)│  big      │ bigGER (than)  │ THE bigGEST      │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ -Y adjectives │  noisy    │ noisIER (than) │ THE noisIEST     │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ TWO OR MORE   │ expensive │ MORE expensive │ THE MOST         │
 │  SYLLABLES    │           │      (than)    │      expensive   │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │               │  good     │ better (than)  │ THE best         │
 │  IRREGULAR    │  bad      │ worse  (than)  │ THE worst        │
 │  adjectives   │ much/many │ more   (than)  │ THE most         │
 │ (noto'g'ri)   │  little   │ less   (than)  │ THE least        │
 └───────────────┴───────────┴────────────────┴──────────────────┘


DIQQAT — JADVALDAGI IKKI QAVSNING MA'NOSI:

  QIYOSIY ustunida '(than)' —
     qiyosiy daraja odatda THAN bilan keladi.

  ORTTIRMA ustunida 'the' QALIN yozilgan —
     orttirma daraja DOIM 'THE' bilan keladi.


BU JADVAL Coursebook 84-BETDAGI JADVALNING
AYNAN O'ZI — kitob bir qoidani IKKI KITOBDA
ham beradi. Grammar Book qo'shimcha tafsilotlar
('of/in', bo'g'inlar soni, urg'u) qo'shadi.

tasks.en: Comparisons — adjective / comparative / superlative
tasks.uz: Qiyoslash — sifat / qiyosiy daraja / orttirma daraja

tasks.en: one-syllable adjectives: cheap → cheaper (than) → the cheapest
tasks.uz: bir bo'g'inli sifatlar: arzon → arzonroq → eng arzon
tasks.note: -ER / THE -EST qo'shiladi.

tasks.en: large → larger (than) → the largest
tasks.uz: katta → kattaroq → eng katta
tasks.note: '-e' bilan tugagan → faqat -R va -ST.

tasks.en: big → bigger (than) → the biggest
tasks.uz: katta → kattaroq → eng katta
tasks.note: Oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI.

tasks.en: -y adjectives: noisy → noisier (than) → the noisiest
tasks.uz: -y bilan tugagan sifatlar: shovqinli → shovqinliroq → eng shovqinli
tasks.note: '-y' tushadi, -IER / THE -IEST qo'shiladi.

tasks.en: adjectives with two or more syllables: expensive → more expensive (than) → the most expensive
tasks.uz: ikki yoki undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar: qimmat → qimmatroq → eng qimmat
tasks.note:
Sifatning O'ZI o'zgarmaydi;
oldiga MORE / THE MOST qo'shiladi.

tasks.en: irregular: good → better (than) → the best
tasks.uz: noto'g'ri: yaxshi → yaxshiroq → eng yaxshi
tasks.note: YODLASH kerak. 'gooder' XATO.

tasks.en: irregular: bad → worse (than) → the worst
tasks.uz: noto'g'ri: yomon → yomonroq → eng yomon
tasks.note: YODLASH kerak. 'badder' XATO.

tasks.en: irregular: much / many → more (than) → the most
tasks.uz: noto'g'ri: ko'p → ko'proq → eng ko'p
tasks.note:
'much' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot bilan (much water),
'many' — SANALADIGAN ot bilan (many books).
Qiyosiy shakli ikkalasi uchun bir xil: MORE.

tasks.en: irregular: little → less (than) → the least
tasks.uz: noto'g'ri: kam → kamroq → eng kam
tasks.note: 'much/many' ning AKSI.

exercises.instructionEn: Form
exercises.instructionUz: Yasalishi
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI — BESh QOIDA:


1) BIR BO'G'INLI sifatlar '-(e)r' / '-(e)st'
   qo'shadi.

     large  -  largER (than)  -  THE largEST (of/in)
     cheap  -  cheapER (than) -  THE cheapEST (of/in)

   DIQQAT — '(e)' QAVSNING MA'NOSI:
     Sifat allaqachon '-e' bilan tugasa,
     yana bitta 'e' QO'ShILMAYDI:
        large → largER ('largeer' XATO)
        nice  → nicER
        safe  → safER
     '-e' bilan tugamasa, to'liq '-er' qo'shiladi:
        cheap → cheapER
        old   → oldER


2) BIR BO'G'INLI sifatlar IKKI UNDOSh ORASIDA
   BITTA URG'ULI UNLI bilan tugasa —
   oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI va '-er'/'-est'
   qo'shiladi.

     big  -  bigGER (than)  -  THE bigGEST (of/in)

   QOIDANI QANDAY TEKShIRISh — UCh ShART:
     • bir bo'g'inli
     • oxiri: UNDOSh + UNLI + UNDOSh
     • unli URG'ULI

     b-i-g   →  b (undosh) + i (unli) + g (undosh) ✓
     h-o-t   →  h + o + t  ✓  → hotTER
     f-a-t   →  f + a + t  ✓  → fatTER
     t-h-i-n →  th + i + n ✓  → thinNER
     s-a-d   →  s + a + d  ✓  → sadDER

   ISTISNOLAR (ikkilanmaydi):
     • ikki unli bo'lsa:  cheap (ea) → cheapER
     • ikki undosh bo'lsa: fast (st) → fastER
     • 'w', 'x', 'y' bilan tugasa:
        new  → newER   (newwer XATO)
        slow → slowER


3) IKKI BO'G'INLI sifatlar UNDOSh + '-Y' bilan
   tugasa — '-y' tushadi va '-ier'/'-iest'
   qo'shiladi.

     heavy  -  heavIER (than)  -  THE heavIEST (of/in)

   DIQQAT — 'UNDOSh + Y' ShARTI:
     heavy  → heav + y   → 'v' undosh ✓ → heavIER
     noisy  → nois + y   → 's' undosh ✓ → noisIER
     easy   → eas + y    → 's' undosh ✓ → easIER
     happy  → happ + y   → 'p' undosh ✓ → happIER
     busy   → bus + y    → 's' undosh ✓ → busIER
     pretty → prett + y  → 't' undosh ✓ → prettIER

     Agar '-y' dan oldin UNLI bo'lsa —
     '-y' TUShMAYDI:
        grey → greyER (greier XATO)


4) IKKI VA UNDAN KO'P BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   'MORE' / 'MOST' oladi.

     careful  -  MORE careful (than)
              -  THE MOST careful (of/in)

   Boshqa misollar:
     expensive   → more expensive
     beautiful   → more beautiful
     interesting → more interesting
     comfortable → more comfortable


5) NOTO'G'RI sifatlarning O'Z shakllari bor
   (yuqoridagi jadvalga qarang).

     good/bad/much/many/little


DIQQAT — 3 va 4-QOIDA CHALKAShIShI MUMKIN:
  'heavy' ham IKKI BO'G'INLI, 'careful' ham.
  FARQI:
     heavy   — '-y' bilan tugaydi → -IER
     careful — '-y' bilan tugaMAYDI → MORE
  Ya'ni 3-qoida 4-qoidadan KUCHLIROQ:
  ikki bo'g'inli sifat '-y' bilan tugasa,
  MORE emas, -IER oladi.

tasks.en: Form
tasks.uz: Yasalishi

tasks.en: One-syllable adjectives add -(e)r/-(e)st to form their comparative and superlative forms.
tasks.uz: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar qiyosiy va orttirma darajasini yasash uchun -(e)r/-(e)st qo'shadi.
tasks.note:
'(e)' qavsi shuni bildiradi:
sifat allaqachon '-e' bilan tugasa,
yana 'e' qo'shilmaydi.

tasks.en: large - larger (than) - the largest (of/in), cheap - cheaper (than) - the cheapest (of/in)
tasks.uz: katta - kattaroq - eng katta, arzon - arzonroq - eng arzon
tasks.note:
'large' → 'largeer' EMAS, 'largER'.
Orttirma daraja 'OF' yoki 'IN' bilan keladi.

tasks.en: One-syllable adjectives ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants, double the last consonant and add -er/-est.
tasks.uz: Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bilan tugagan bir bo'g'inli sifatlar oxirgi undoshni ikkilantiradi va -er/-est qo'shadi.
tasks.note:
UCH SHART: bir bo'g'in +
undosh-unli-undosh + urg'uli unli.

tasks.en: big - bigger (than) - the biggest (of/in)
tasks.uz: katta - kattaroq - eng katta
tasks.note:
b + i + g → 'g' IKKILANADI.
Shunday: hot→hotter, fat→fatter, thin→thinner,
sad→sadder.

tasks.en: Two-syllable adjectives ending in a consonant + -y, drop -y and add -ier/-iest.
tasks.uz: Undosh + '-y' bilan tugagan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar '-y' ni tushiradi va '-ier/-iest' qo'shadi.
tasks.note:
DIQQAT: '-y' dan OLDIN UNDOSH bo'lishi shart.
Unli bo'lsa (grey) '-y' tushmaydi.

tasks.en: heavy - heavier (than) - the heaviest (of/in)
tasks.uz: og'ir - og'irroq - eng og'ir
tasks.note:
heav + y → heavIER.
Shunday: noisy→noisier, easy→easier,
happy→happier, busy→busier.

tasks.en: Adjectives of two or more syllables take more/most.
tasks.uz: Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar more/most oladi.
tasks.note: Sifatning O'ZI o'zgarmaydi.

tasks.en: careful - more careful (than) - the most careful (of/in)
tasks.uz: ehtiyotkor - ehtiyotkorroq - eng ehtiyotkor
tasks.note:
DIQQAT: 'careful' ikki bo'g'inli, lekin
'-y' bilan tugamaydi → MORE oladi.
'heavy' bilan SOLISHTIRING.

tasks.en: Irregular adjectives have their own individual comparative and superlative forms.
tasks.uz: Noto'g'ri sifatlarning o'ziga xos qiyosiy va orttirma shakllari bor.
tasks.note:
good/bad/much/many/little —
yuqoridagi jadvalda.

exercises.instructionEn: Note
exercises.instructionUz: Eslatma
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'NOTE' QUTISI — IKKI ESLATMA:


1) Qiyoslashni ko'pincha 'THAN' bilan qilamiz.

     The city is noisier THAN the country.
     An elephant is heavier THAN a mouse.
     Trains are more expensive THAN buses.

   DIQQAT: 'than' o'zbekchada '... dan' ga
   to'g'ri keladi:
     'noisier THAN the country'
     = 'qishloqDAN shovqinliroq'


2) Orttirma daraja oldidan 'THE' qo'yamiz.

     THE cheapest hotel
     THE most expensive restaurant
     THE best

   Bu — ENG KO'P UNUTILADIGAN QOIDA.
   'He is tallest boy' XATO.
   'He is THE tallest boy' TO'G'RI.

   SABABI: orttirma daraja narsani ANIQ
   ko'rsatadi (bittasi, yagona) — shuning uchun
   aniq artikl 'the' kerak.


ESLAB QOLISh UChUN:
     QIYOSIY   →  THAN bilan
     ORTTIRMA  →  THE bilan (va OF/IN bilan)

tasks.en: Note
tasks.uz: Eslatma

tasks.en: We often make comparisons using than.
tasks.uz: Qiyoslashni ko'pincha 'than' bilan qilamiz.
tasks.note:
'than' = o'zbekchadagi '... dan'.
Faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

tasks.en: We use the before the superlative form.
tasks.uz: Orttirma daraja oldidan 'the' qo'yamiz.
tasks.note:
ENG KO'P UNUTILADIGAN QOIDA.
'the cheapest', 'the best', 'the most expensive'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'llanishi
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — TO'RT QOIDA:


1) QIYOSIY DARAJA — IKKI odam, narsa, joyni
   solishtiradi. Odatda 'THAN' bilan.

     'The city is NOISIER THAN the country.'
     (Shahar qishloqdan shovqinliroq.)


2) ORTTIRMA DARAJA — bitta odam yoki narsani
   O'ZI MANSUB BO'LGAN BUTUN GURUH bilan
   solishtiradi.
   'THE ... OF' yoki 'THE ... IN' bilan.

     'The giraffe is THE TALLEST animal OF all.'
     (Jirafa hamma hayvonlardan eng balandi.)

   DIQQAT — 'OF' va 'IN' FARQI:
     OF + guruh:
        the tallest OF all
        the best OF the three
        the oldest OF my friends
     IN + joy:
        the tallest building IN the USA
        the cheapest hotel IN town
        the largest desert IN the world


3) (NOT) AS + sifat + AS — ikki odam, joy yoki
   narsa O'XShASh yoki O'XShASh EMASligini
   aytadi.

     'My brother is AS TALL AS my father.'
     (Akam otam chalik baland bo'yli.)

   IKKI XIL MA'NO:
     AS ... AS      = TENG
        'as tall as' = bir xil bo'yda
     NOT AS ... AS  = KAMROQ
        'not as tall as' = undan pastroq

   DIQQAT: 'as' va 'as' orasiga sifatning
   ODDIY shakli qo'yiladi.
     'as taller as' XATO
     'as tall as' TO'G'RI


4) MUCH + QIYOSIY daraja.

     'An elephant is MUCH HEAVIER than a mouse.'
     (Fil sichqondan ancha og'irroq.)

   'much' farqni KUChAYTIRADI.
   DIQQAT: faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.
     'much heavy' XATO
     'much heavier' TO'G'RI


UMUMIY XULOSA — QAYSI QOLIP QAChON:

  IKKI narsa, farq bor      →  -ER/MORE ... THAN
  IKKI narsa, farq KATTA    →  MUCH -ER/MORE ... THAN
  IKKI narsa, TENG          →  AS ... AS
  IKKI narsa, teng EMAS     →  NOT AS ... AS
  BUTUN GURUHdan eng yuqori →  THE -EST/MOST ... OF/IN

tasks.en: Use
tasks.uz: Qo'llanishi

tasks.en: We use the comparative form to compare two people, things, places, etc. We usually use than with comparative adjectives.
tasks.uz: Qiyosiy darajani ikki odam, narsa, joyni solishtirish uchun ishlatamiz. Odatda 'than' bilan.
tasks.note: IKKITA narsa → QIYOSIY daraja.

tasks.en: The city is noisier than the country.
tasks.uz: Shahar qishloqdan shovqinliroq.
tasks.note:
'noisy' → '-y' tushadi → 'noisIER'.
'the country' bu yerda 'qishloq, shahardan
tashqari joy' ma'nosida ('mamlakat' emas).

tasks.en: We use the superlative form to compare a person or thing with the whole group they belong to. We use the ... of/in with superlative adjectives.
tasks.uz: Orttirma darajani bitta odam yoki narsani o'zi mansub bo'lgan butun guruh bilan solishtirish uchun ishlatamiz. 'the ... of/in' bilan.
tasks.note:
OF + guruh, IN + joy.
DOIM 'THE' bilan.

tasks.en: The giraffe is the tallest animal of all.
tasks.uz: Jirafa hamma hayvonlardan eng balandi.
tasks.note:
'the tallest ... OF all' — guruh bilan OF.
'a giraffe' = jirafa.

tasks.en: We use (not) as + adjective + as to say that two people, places or things are/are not similar.
tasks.uz: Ikki odam, joy yoki narsa o'xshash yoki o'xshash emasligini aytish uchun '(not) as + sifat + as' ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
'as' va 'as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli.
'as taller as' XATO.

tasks.en: My brother is as tall as my father.
tasks.uz: Akam otam chalik baland bo'yli.
tasks.note:
TENGLIK: ikkalasi bir xil bo'yda.
Inkor bo'lsa ('isn't as tall as') —
akasi PASTROQ degani.

tasks.en: We use much + comparative form.
tasks.uz: 'much' ni qiyosiy daraja bilan ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
Farqni KUCHAYTIRADI.
Faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

tasks.en: An elephant is much heavier than a mouse.
tasks.uz: Fil sichqondan ancha og'irroq.
tasks.note:
'heavy' → 'heavIER'.
'a mouse' = sichqon (ko'pligi: MICE).

exercises.instructionEn: Quite/Very/Too
exercises.instructionUz: Quite/Very/Too
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  'very', 'quite' yoki 'too' kabi so'zlarni
  biror narsa yoki odam QANChALIK sovuq/yaxshi/
  qiziqarli ekanini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatamiz.


KITOBNING UCh MISOLI VA IZOHI:

  It is QUITE dark.
     ( = It is A BIT dark. )
     = Ancha qorong'i. (biroz qorong'i)

  It is VERY dark.
     ( = It is EXTREMELY dark. )
     = Juda qorong'i. (o'ta qorong'i)

  It is TOO dark.
     ( = It is SO dark THAT I CAN'T SEE. )
     = Haddan tashqari qorong'i.
       (shunchalik qorong'iki, ko'ra olmayman)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — DARAJA CHIZIG'I:

     quite  <  very  <  too
      (+)       (++)     (−)
     biroz     juda    haddan
                       tashqari

  DIQQAT: 'too' shunchaki 'very' dan kuchliroq
  EMAS. 'too' butunlay BOShQA narsani aytadi —
  u MUAMMO borligini bildiradi.

     'very dark'  → qorong'i, lekin muammo yo'q
     'too dark'   → shunchalik qorong'iki,
                    biror ishni QILA OLMAYMAN

  Kitob buni izohda ANIQ ko'rsatgan:
     'It is SO dark THAT I CAN'T SEE.'
     ('can't' — imkonsizlik)


Coursebook 86-BET BILAN BOG'LIQ:
  U yerda AYNAN shu qoida mehmonxona narxlari
  bilan ko'rsatilgan edi:
     £95 → 'VERY expensive'  (qimmat, lekin
                              £100 ichida)
     £120 → 'TOO expensive'  (£100 dan OShADI —
                              SOTIB OLA OLMAYDI)
  Va kalit qutisida:
     quite noisy (+), very noisy (++),
     much noisier (+++), too noisy (−)


QOIDA — QAYSI SHAKL BILAN KELADI:

  quite + ODDIY sifat    →  quite dark
  very  + ODDIY sifat    →  very dark
  too   + ODDIY sifat    →  too dark
  much  + QIYOSIY daraja →  much darker

  DIQQAT: 'much' bu uchtadan FARQ QILADI —
  u faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan ishlatiladi.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:
  It's quite cold.  = Ancha sovuq.
  It's very cold.   = Juda sovuq.
  It's too cold.    = Haddan tashqari sovuq
                      (tashqariga chiqib bo'lmaydi).

  The film was quite good.  = Film ancha yaxshi edi.
  The film was very good.   = Film juda yaxshi edi.
  The tea is too hot.       = Choy haddan tashqari
                              issiq (ichib bo'lmaydi).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a bit      = biroz
  extremely  = o'ta darajada
  dark       = qorong'i
  so ... that = shunchalik ... ki

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct form of the adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarning to'g'ri shaklini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVALDA HAR QATORDA BITTA yoki IKKI shakl
BERILGAN — qolganini topish kerak.

TO'LDIRILGAN JADVAL:

 ┌─────────────┬──────────────────┬─────────────────────┐
 │  ADJECTIVE  │   COMPARATIVE    │    SUPERLATIVE      │
 ├─────────────┼──────────────────┼─────────────────────┤
 │  expensive  │  MORE EXPENSIVE  │ the most expensive  │
 │  bad        │  worse           │ THE WORST           │
 │  OLD        │  older           │ the oldest          │
 │  SMALL      │  smaller         │ the smallest        │
 │  much/many  │  MORE            │ the most            │
 │  tiny       │  tinier          │ THE TINIEST         │
 │  high       │  HIGHER          │ the highest         │
 │  HOT        │  hotter          │ the hottest         │
 └─────────────┴──────────────────┴─────────────────────┘

(QALIN — kitob bergan shakl; qolganini siz
to'ldirasiz.)


HAR QATOR QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1-qator: 'more expensive' berilgan.
     'more' → uzun sifat → asosiy shakl
     EXPENSIVE, orttirmasi THE MOST EXPENSIVE.

  2-qator: 'the worst' berilgan.
     Bu — NOTO'G'RI sifat. Jadvaldan:
     bad → worse → the worst.

  3-qator: 'old' berilgan.
     Bir bo'g'inli → OLDER, THE OLDEST.

  4-qator: 'small' berilgan.
     Bir bo'g'inli → SMALLER, THE SMALLEST.

  5-qator: 'more' (yolg'iz) berilgan.
     'more' — NOTO'G'RI sifatning qiyosiy shakli:
     much/many → more → the most.
     DIQQAT: 1-qatorda ham 'more' bor, lekin u
     yerda 'more EXPENSIVE' — sifat bilan birga.
     Bu yerda 'more' YOLG'IZ turibdi → 'much/many'.

  6-qator: 'the tiniest' berilgan.
     '-iest' → '-y' bilan tugagan sifat:
     TINY → TINIER → the tiniest.
     'tiny' = juda kichkina.

  7-qator: 'higher' berilgan.
     '-er' → HIGH → THE HIGHEST.

  8-qator: 'hot' berilgan.
     Bir bo'g'inli, undosh+unli+undosh →
     't' IKKILANADI: HOTTER, THE HOTTEST.


DIQQAT — 5-QATORDAGI 'MORE' ALDAMChI:
  Yolg'iz turgan 'more' — 'much' yoki 'many' ning
  qiyosiy shakli.
  Agar 'more + sifat' bo'lsa (1-qatordagidek),
  u uzun sifatning qiyosiy shakli.

DIQQAT — 6 va 8-QATORLAR MAXSUS QOIDALAR:
  tiny → tinIER    ('-y' tushadi)
  hot  → hotTER    (undosh ikkilanadi)

tasks.whyUz:
'more expensive' berilgan →
asosiy shakl EXPENSIVE,
orttirma shakl THE MOST EXPENSIVE.
Uzun sifat (3 bo'g'in) → MORE / THE MOST.

'the worst' — NOTO'G'RI sifatning orttirma shakli.
Jadvaldan: BAD → WORSE → the worst.
'badder' yoki 'baddest' XATO.

Bir bo'g'inli → -ER / THE -EST.
old → OLDER → THE OLDEST.

Bir bo'g'inli → -ER / THE -EST.
small → SMALLER → THE SMALLEST.

'more' YOLG'IZ (sifatsiz) → bu NOTO'G'RI
sifatning qiyosiy shakli.
MUCH / MANY → more → THE MOST.
'much' — sanalmaydigan ot bilan (much water),
'many' — sanaladigan ot bilan (many books).
DIQQAT: 1-qatorda 'more EXPENSIVE' edi —
u yerda 'more' sifat bilan birga.

'-IEST' → '-y' bilan tugagan sifat.
TINY → TINIER → the tiniest.
'tiny' = juda kichkina ('small' dan ham kichik).

'-ER' → qisqa sifat.
HIGH → higher → THE HIGHEST.
'high' = baland (tog', devor uchun;
bino va odam uchun 'tall').

hot = h (undosh) + o (unli) + t (undosh)
→ 't' IKKILANADI.
HOT → HOTTER → THE HOTTEST.
'hoter' / 'hotest' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with in, of, than, the or as ... as.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni in, of, than, the yoki as ... as bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh VARIANT: in, of, than, the, as ... as

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  longer THAN the Mississippi
  2  THE smallest country IN the world
  3  not AS clean AS Stratford
  4  the most comfortable OF all
  5  a famous club IN Los Angeles
  6  cheaper THAN living in the city
  7  the hottest place IN the world
  8  not AS noisy AS Paris


QANDAY ANIQLASh — UCh KALIT BELGI:

  Sifat QIYOSIY shaklda ('-er' yoki 'more ...')
     →  THAN
     (1, 6-bandlar)

  Sifat ORTTIRMA shaklda ('-est' yoki 'most ...')
     →  'THE' oldidan + 'OF' yoki 'IN' keyin
     OF + guruh ('of all', 'of the three')
     IN + joy  ('in the world', 'in town')
     (2, 4, 7-bandlar)

  Sifat ODDIY shaklda va 'not' bor
     →  AS ... AS
     (3, 8-bandlar)

  Oddiy joy ko'rsatish
     →  IN
     (5-band)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Amazonka daryosi Missisipidan uzunroq.
  2  Vatikan davlati dunyodagi eng kichik davlat.
  3  Nyu-York Stratford chalik toza emas.
  4  Mening shahrimda ko'p mehmonxona bor.
     'Chelsea' hammasidan eng qulayi.
  5  'The Whiskey' — Los-Anjelesdagi mashhur klub.
  6  Qishloqda yashash shaharda yashashdan arzonroq.
  7  O'lim vodiysi dunyodagi eng issiq joy.
  8  Oksford Parij chalik shovqinli emas.


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA IKKI BO'ShLIQ:
  'is ...... smallest country ...... the world'
  Birinchisi — THE (orttirma daraja oldidan),
  ikkinchisi — IN (joy bilan).

DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA 'OF ALL':
  'the most comfortable OF ALL'
  'all' — GURUH → 'of'.
  'in all' XATO.

DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'LIVING':
  'LIVING in the country is cheaper THAN LIVING
   in the city.'
  Ikki tomonda ham '-ing' shakli — chunki
  bir xil narsalar solishtirilishi kerak.


BU MAShQDAGI ATOQLI OTLAR — TANIShI:
  the Amazon River, the Mississippi — daryolar
  the State of the Vatican City — Coursebook 85-bet,
     12-mashqning 5-bandidan
  Stratford, Los Angeles — Coursebook 82-87-betlardan
  The Whiskey — Coursebook 83-betdagi maqoladan
  Death Valley — Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqdan
  Oxford, Paris — shaharlar

'the hottEST' — ORTTIRMA daraja,
'the world' — JOY → IN.
Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqning 6-bandi
ham aynan shu fakt.

O'N BAND. Har birida gapdagi KALIT SO'ZGA
qarab daraja tanlanadi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  MORE EXPENSIVE than    (than bor → qiyosiy)
   2  MORE CROWDED than      (than bor → qiyosiy)
   3  isn't as HIGH as       (as...as → oddiy shakl)

   7  THE TALLEST building   (the ... in → orttirma)

O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  Bu do'konlar qishloqdagilardan qimmatroq.
   2  Bu shahar besh yil oldingidan gavjumroq.
   3  Makkinli tog'i Everest chalik baland emas.

      yaxshi restoran.

ENG MUHIM BANDLAR:

  3-BAND ALDAMChI:
     'isn't AS ...... AS Mount Everest'
     'as ... as' orasiga ODDIY shakl:
        AS HIGH AS  ✓
        as higher as  ✗
     Mashq 'to'g'ri shaklga qo'ying' desa ham,
     bu yerda sifat O'ZGARMAYDI.

  9-BAND NOTO'G'RI SIFAT:

  2-BANDDAGI TAQQOSLASh:

     Shahar O'ZINING beshinchi yil oldingi holati

  7-BAND 'TALL' — 'HIGH' EMAS:
     BINO uchun 'tall' ishlatiladi.
     3-bandda esa TOG' uchun 'high'.
     Kitob ikkalasini bir mashqda ataylab bergan.

exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA UCh HAYVON:
  FIL (the elephant)      — eng katta, eng og'ir
  SHER (the lion)         — eng xavfli, eng tez
  ShIMPANZE (the chimpanzee) — eng kichik, eng do'stona


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  The chimpanzee is NOT AS BIG AS (big) the
     elephant.

  Namuna MUHIM narsani ko'rsatadi: javobga
  'as' va 'as' ning IKKALASI ham kiradi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  is not AS BIG AS the elephant        (NAMUNA)
  2  The lion is SMALLER THAN the elephant.
  3  The lion is not AS FRIENDLY AS the chimpanzee.
  4  The elephant is THE HEAVIEST animal of all.
  5  The lion is THE MOST DANGEROUS animal of all.
  6  The chimpanzee is not AS FAST AS the lion.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Shimpanze fil chalik katta emas.
  2  Sher fildan kichikroq.
  3  Sher shimpanze chalik do'stona emas.
  4  Fil hamma hayvonlardan eng og'iri.
  5  Sher hamma hayvonlardan eng xavflisi.
  6  Shimpanze sher chalik tez emas.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — UCh XIL QOLIP:

  'is NOT ...... [ot]' → AS ... AS
     (1, 3, 6-bandlar)
     Bo'shliqdan keyin BIRDAN ot kelsa va 'not'
     bo'lsa — 'as ... as' kerak.

  'is ...... [ot]' (not YO'Q) → QIYOSIY + THAN
     (2-band)
     'The lion is ...... the elephant' —
     'than' ham bo'shliqqa kiradi:
     'SMALLER THAN'.

  'is ...... animal OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA
     (4, 5-bandlar)
     'of all' — ORTTIRMA darajaning belgisi.


SIFATLARNING YASALIShI:
  big       → as BIG as      (oddiy shakl)
  small     → SMALLER than   (1 bo'g'in → -ER)
  friendly  → as FRIENDLY as (oddiy shakl)
  heavy     → THE HEAVIEST   ('-y' → -IEST)
  dangerous → THE MOST DANGEROUS (3 bo'g'in)
  fast      → as FAST as     (oddiy shakl)


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA 'THAN' HAM KERAK:
  'The lion is ...... (small) the elephant.'
  Gapda 'than' BOSILMAGAN — u ham bo'shliqqa
  kiradi: 'SMALLER THAN'.
  Bu — namunadagi 'as big as' bilan bir xil
  mantiq (u yerda ham ikkala 'as' javobga kirgan).

NAMUNA. 'not' bor va bo'shliqdan keyin

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

ENG MUHIM DARS — 'VERY' va 'QUITE' DAN KEYIN
SIFAT O'ZGARMAYDI:

  2-band:  'This city is VERY ...... .'   → NOISY
  5-band:  'That dress is VERY ...... .'  → EXPENSIVE
  9-band:  'Tom Cruise is VERY ...... .'  → FAMOUS
  16-band: 'Joe is QUITE ...... .'        → TALL

  Bu to'rt bandda QIYOSLASh YO'Q — shunchaki
  daraja ko'rsatilyapti.
  Grammar 52-betdagi 'Quite/Very/Too' qoidasi:
  'quite/very/too' + ODDIY sifat.

  Ular gapning OXIRIDA nuqta bilan tugaydi —
  bu ham ip: solishtiriladigan narsa YO'Q.


QANDAY ANIQLASh — TO'RT BELGI:

  'very' / 'quite' bor      →  ODDIY shakl
                               (2, 5, 9, 16)
  gapdan keyin ikkinchi narsa →  QIYOSIY + THAN
                               (1, 3, 8, 12, 13,
                                14, 15)
  'of all' bor              →  THE ... OF
                               (4, 10)
  'in the world/the USA' bor →  THE ... IN
                               (7, 11)
  'of all' yoki 'I know' bor →  THE ...
                               (6, 17)


ALOHIDA IZOHLAR:

  3-BAND: 'She has got ...... TOYS ...... her sister.'
     'many' → 'MORE' (noto'g'ri sifat) + THAN.
     'toys' — SANALADIGAN ot → 'many' to'g'ri edi.

  6-BAND: 'That was ...... film OF ALL.'
     'good' → 'THE BEST' (noto'g'ri sifat).
     'of all' bor, lekin javobda faqat 'the best' —
     'of all' gapda ALLAQAChON bor.

  7-BAND: 'Chile is ...... place ...... the world.'
     'dry' → '-y' tushadi → THE DRIEST + IN.
     Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqning 4-bandi
     ham aynan shu fakt (Atakama cho'li).

  14-BAND: 'Your money is ...... IN THE BANK ......
     it is AT HOME.'
     'safe' → '-e' → SAFER + THAN.
     Bankdagi pul uydagidan xavfsizroq.

  17-BAND: 'My sister is ...... person I KNOW.'
     'I know' — guruhni chegaralaydi
     (men biladigan odamlar orasida) → ORTTIRMA.
     'kind' → THE KINDEST.

  large     → the largEST    ('-e' → faqat -ST)

  dangerous → MORE dangerous (3 bo'g'in)
  safe      → safER          ('-e' → faqat -R)
  crowded   → MORE crowded   (2 bo'g'in, '-y' yo'q)
  kind      → the kindEST    (1 bo'g'in)

exercises.instructionEn: Use the adjectives in the list to write six sentences about your family members, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi sifatlardan foydalanib oila a'zolaringiz haqida oltita gap yozing, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN OLTI SIFAT:
  old, tall, patient, short, good, friendly

KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:
  'My father is TALLER THAN my mother.'
     → QIYOSIY daraja + THAN (ikki odam)
  'My brother is THE TALLEST IN our family.'
     → ORTTIRMA daraja + IN (butun oila)

  Kitob ataylab IKKALA qolipni ham ko'rsatgan —
  siz ham ikkalasidan foydalanishingiz kerak.


HAR SIFATNING SHAKLLARI:
  old      →  older      /  the oldest
  tall     →  taller     /  the tallest
  patient  →  MORE patient / THE MOST patient
                              (2 bo'g'in, '-y' yo'q)
  short    →  shorter    /  the shortest
  good     →  BETTER     /  THE BEST  (noto'g'ri!)
  friendly →  friendlIER /  the friendlIEST  ('-y')


OLTI NAMUNA GAP (o'z oilangizga moslang):

  1  My father is older than my mother.
     (Otam onamdan katta.)

  2  My brother is the tallest in our family.
     (Akam oilamizdagi eng baland bo'yli.)

  3  My mother is more patient than my father.
     (Onam otamdan sabrliroq.)

  4  My sister is the shortest in our family.
     (Singlim oilamizdagi eng past bo'yli.)

  5  My grandmother is a better cook than my mother.
     (Buvim onamdan yaxshiroq oshpaz.)

  6  My cousin is the friendliest person in our
     family.
     (Amakivachcham oilamizdagi eng do'stona odam.)


DIQQAT — 'GOOD' NOTO'G'RI SIFAT:
  'gooder' / 'the goodest' XATO.
  'BETTER' / 'THE BEST' to'g'ri.

DIQQAT — 'PATIENT' 2 BO'G'INLI, '-Y' YO'Q:
  → MORE patient ('patienter' XATO).
  'patient' = sabrli.
  DIQQAT: 'a patient' (ot) = bemor — boshqa so'z.

DIQQAT — 'FRIENDLY' '-Y' BILAN TUGAGAN:
  → friendlIER / the friendlIEST.
  '-ly' bilan tugasa ham bu SIFAT.


OILA A'ZOLARI LUG'ATI:
  father, mother, brother, sister,
  grandfather, grandmother,
  uncle (amaki/tog'a), aunt (amma/xola),
  cousin (amakivachcha/xolavachcha)

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BAND — har birida UCh variant:

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  B  shorter          ('than' bor)

   7  A  exciting         ('very' bor)
   8  B  heavier          ('than' bor)
   9  A  famous           ('very' bor)
  10  C  the most popular ('in my town')


UCh KALIT BELGI — HAMMASI ShU:

  'THAN' bor              →  B (QIYOSIY)
     1, 4, 8-bandlar

  'IN ...' bor            →  C (ORTTIRMA)
     2, 6, 10-bandlar

  'VERY' bor yoki 'a/an'  →  A (ODDIY)
     3, 5, 7, 9-bandlar


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  U akasidan past bo'yli.
   2  Bill sinfidagi eng yaxshi o'quvchi.
   3  Syuzan chiroyli qiz.
   4  Nyu-York Mayamidan qiziqarliroq.
   5  Parij juda qimmat shahar.
   6  Nik oilasidagi eng baland bo'yli.
   7  'Independence Day' juda qiziqarli film.
   8  It sichqondan og'irroq.
   9  'The Roxy' — Bostondagi juda mashhur klub.
  10  'Anthony's' — mening shahrimdagi eng mashhur kafe.


ENG MUHIM — 3-BAND ALDAMChI:
  'Susan is a ...... girl.'
  Bu yerda hech kim bilan solishtirilmayapti va
  'the' ham yo'q — shunchaki TASVIR.
  → ODDIY shakl 'PRETTY'.
  'a prettier girl' ham grammatik jihatdan mumkin,
  lekin gapda 'than' yo'q → to'liq emas.
  'a the prettiest girl' XATO ('a' va 'the' birga
  kelmaydi).

DIQQAT — 9-BANDDA 'VERY' VA 'IN BOSTON' BIRGA:
  'The Roxy is a VERY ...... club IN BOSTON.'
  'in Boston' bor, lekin 'a very' ham bor →
  'a' artikli ORTTIRMA daraja bilan KELMAYDI
  ('a the most famous' XATO).
  → ODDIY shakl 'FAMOUS'.
  'in Boston' bu yerda shunchaki JOY ko'rsatadi.

DIQQAT — 10-BANDDA 'A' YO'Q:
  'Anthony's is ...... cafe in my town.'
  Bo'shliqdan oldin artikl YO'Q → 'the' javobning
  ichida bo'lishi kerak → C 'THE MOST POPULAR'.
  9-band bilan SOLIShTIRING: u yerda 'a very' bor edi.


ATOQLI OTLAR:
  Independence Day — 1996-yilgi amerikacha film
  The Roxy — Coursebook 83-betdagi maqolada
     eslatilgan klub (lekin u LA da; bu yerda Boston)
  Miami, Boston — AQSh shaharlari

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  2  short     →  SHORTER
  3  prettyer  →  PRETTIER

  6  the more famous → THE MOST FAMOUS

O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (tuzatilgan holda):

  8  Bu juda chiroyli ko'ylak.


HAR BIR XATONING TURI:

  1  ORTTIRMA o'rniga QIYOSIY kerak
     'than' bor → 'faster'.

  2  ODDIY shakl o'rniga QIYOSIY kerak
     'than' bor → 'shorter'.

  3  YOZILISh XATOSI
     'pretty' → '-y' TUShADI → 'prettIER'
     ('prettyer' XATO).

  4  ORTTIRMA o'rniga QIYOSIY kerak
     'much' va 'than' bor →
     'much SMALLER than'.
     DIQQAT: 'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

  5  'THE' bor, lekin sifat ODDIY shaklda
     → ORTTIRMA kerak:
     'fascinating' — 4 bo'g'in →
     'THE MOST FASCINATING'.

  6  'MORE' o'rniga 'MOST' kerak
     'the ... tower IN France' → ORTTIRMA.
     'the MORE famous' XATO →
     'the MOST famous'.
     Bu — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

  7  ODDIY shakl o'rniga QIYOSIY kerak
     'than' bor → 'older'.

  8  QIYOSIY o'rniga ODDIY shakl kerak
     'a VERY' bor → sifat O'ZGARMAYDI:
     'a very NICE dress'.
     'a very nicer' XATO.


XATOLARNING IKKI ASOSIY TURI:

  A) NOTO'G'RI DARAJA tanlangan
     (1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8-bandlar)
     Kalit so'zga qarang:
        than → QIYOSIY
        the ... in/of → ORTTIRMA
        very/quite → ODDIY

  B) NOTO'G'RI YOZILGAN
     (3-band: 'prettyer' → 'prettier')

exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarning to'g'ri shaklini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LDIRILGAN JADVAL:

 ┌─────────────┬───────────────┬────────────────────┐
 │  ADJECTIVE  │  COMPARATIVE  │    SUPERLATIVE     │
 ├─────────────┼───────────────┼────────────────────┤
 │  tall       │  taller       │ THE TALLEST        │
 │  safe       │  SAFER        │ the safest         │
 │  SUNNY      │  sunnier      │ the sunniest       │
 │  popular    │  MORE POPULAR │ the most popular   │
 │  good       │  better       │ THE BEST           │
 │  bad        │  WORSE        │ the worst          │
 │  MUCH       │  more         │ the most           │
 │  MANY       │  more         │ THE MOST           │
 │  little     │  LESS         │ the least          │
 └─────────────┴───────────────┴────────────────────┘

(QALIN — kitob bergan shakl.)


HAR QATOR QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  'the tallEST' berilgan → -EST → qisqa sifat:
     TALL → TALLER.

  2  'safER' berilgan → '-e' bilan tugagan sifat:
     SAFE → THE SAFEST (faqat -ST).

  3  'sunny' berilgan → '-y' bilan tugagan:
     SUNNIER → THE SUNNIEST.

  4  'MORE popular' berilgan → uzun sifat:
     POPULAR → THE MOST POPULAR.

  5  'the BEST' berilgan → NOTO'G'RI sifat:
     GOOD → BETTER.

  6  'WORSE' berilgan → NOTO'G'RI sifat:
     BAD → THE WORST.

  7  'much' berilgan → NOTO'G'RI:
     MORE → THE MOST.

  8  'many' berilgan, 'the most' ham berilgan →
     MORE.

  9  'less' berilgan → NOTO'G'RI sifat:
     LITTLE → THE LEAST.


DIQQAT — 'MUCH' va 'MANY' BIR XIL QIYOSIY ShAKL:
  much (sanalmaydigan) → more → the most
  many (sanaladigan)   → more → the most
  Ikkalasining qiyosiy va orttirma shakli AYNAN
  BIR XIL.

DIQQAT — 'LITTLE' — 'MUCH/MANY' NING AKSI:
  little → LESS → the least
  'littler' yoki 'littlest' XATO (bu ma'noda).

DIQQAT — TO'RT NOTO'G'RI SIFAT BU JADVALDA:
  good, bad, much/many, little
  Grammar 52-betdagi jadvalning aynan o'zi.

tasks.whyUz:
'the tallEST' → qisqa sifat.
TALL → TALLER → the tallest.
Bir bo'g'inli sifat -ER / THE -EST oladi.

'safER' → sifat '-e' bilan tugagan.
SAFE → safer → THE SAFEST.
'safeest' XATO — faqat -ST qo'shiladi.

'-y' TUSHADI, '-IER' / '-IEST' qo'shiladi.
sunny → SUNNIER → THE SUNNIEST.
Coursebook 84-bet, 9-mashqdagi namuna.

'MORE popular' → uzun sifat (3 bo'g'in).
POPULAR → more popular → THE MOST POPULAR.
'popularer' XATO.

'the BEST' → NOTO'G'RI sifat.
GOOD → BETTER → the best.
'gooder' / 'the goodest' XATO.

'WORSE' → NOTO'G'RI sifat.
BAD → worse → THE WORST.
'badder' / 'the baddest' XATO.

much → MORE → THE MOST.
'much' — SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan
(much water, much time).

many → MORE → the most.
'many' — SANALADIGAN otlar bilan
(many books, many people).
DIQQAT: 'much' va 'many' ning qiyosiy va
orthirma shakllari AYNAN BIR XIL.

'LESS' → NOTO'G'RI sifat.
LITTLE → less → THE LEAST.
Bu 'much/many' ning AKSI.
'littler' / 'littlest' bu ma'noda XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the information about the two restaurants and make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki restoran haqidagi ma'lumotni o'qing va namunadagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI KARTOChKA:

  PEBBLES RESTAURANT
     • dengizdan 400 metr
     • 1975-yilda ochilgan
     • KIChIK va romantik, 25 stol
     • 15 xodim
     • yaxshi narxlar
     • mazali taomlar: £25 dan £50 gacha

  FISHERMAN'S INN
     • dengizdan 50 metr
     • 1958-yilda ochilgan
     • KATTA, toza ovqat zali, 60 stol
     • 25 xodim
     • a'lo xizmat
     • foydali taomlar: £10 dan £30 gacha


⚠ KITOBDA XATO BOR — 1-BAND:

  Kitob namuna sifatida shunday bergan:
     'Pebbles Restaurant is CLOSER TO THE SEA THAN
      Fisherman's Inn.'

  LEKIN kartochkalarda:
     Pebbles         — dengizdan 400 metr
     Fisherman's Inn — dengizdan 50 metr

  Ya'ni FISHERMAN'S INN dengizga ANChA YAQINROQ.
  Kitobning bosilgan javobi O'Z MA'LUMOTIGA ZID.

  TO'G'RI VARIANTLAR:
     'Fisherman's Inn is CLOSER to the sea than
      Pebbles Restaurant.'
     yoki
     'Pebbles Restaurant is FURTHER FROM the sea
      than Fisherman's Inn.'


BARCHA OLTI GAP (to'g'ri ma'lumot asosida):

  1  Fisherman's Inn is CLOSER to the sea than
     Pebbles Restaurant.        (50 m < 400 m)
     [kitob teskari yozgan — yuqoridagi izohga
      qarang]

  2  Fisherman's Inn has got MORE STAFF THAN
     Pebbles Restaurant.        (25 > 15)   NAMUNA

  3  Pebbles Restaurant is MORE EXPENSIVE THAN
     Fisherman's Inn.           (£25-50 > £10-30)

  4  Fisherman's Inn has got MORE TABLES THAN
     Pebbles Restaurant.        (60 > 25)

  5  Fisherman's Inn is OLDER THAN Pebbles
     Restaurant.                (1958 < 1975)

  6  Pebbles Restaurant is SMALLER THAN
     Fisherman's Inn.           (Small ↔ Large)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  'Fisherman's Inn' dengizga 'Pebbles' dan
     yaqinroq.
  2  'Fisherman's Inn' da 'Pebbles' dan ko'proq
     xodim bor.
  3  'Pebbles' 'Fisherman's Inn' dan qimmatroq.
  4  'Fisherman's Inn' da 'Pebbles' dan ko'proq
     stol bor.
  5  'Fisherman's Inn' 'Pebbles' dan eskiroq.
  6  'Pebbles' 'Fisherman's Inn' dan kichikroq.


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDAGI SANALAR MANTIQI:
  1958 < 1975 → 'Fisherman's Inn' AVVALROQ
  ochilgan → u ESKIROQ.
  Kichikroq sana = eskiroq restoran.

DIQQAT — 2 va 4-BANDLAR 'HAS GOT' BILAN:
  'has got MORE staff/tables THAN ...'
  Bu yerda 'more' — 'many' ning qiyosiy shakli
  (6-mashqdagi jadvaldan), sifat emas.

DIQQAT — 'STAFF' KO'PLIK MA'NOSIDA:
  'staff' = xodimlar. Shakli birlik, ma'nosi
  ko'plik. 'staffs' odatda aytilmaydi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a pebble       = shag'al tosh
  an inn         = mehmonxona-restoran (eski uslub)
  a dining area  = ovqat zali
  service        = xizmat
  healthy        = foydali, sog'lom
  a meal         = ovqat, taom
  further from   = ... dan uzoqroq

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ KITOBDA XATO.
Kitob shunday bosgan: 'Pebbles Restaurant is
CLOSER TO THE SEA THAN Fisherman's Inn.'

LEKIN kartochkalarda:
  Pebbles         — dengizdan 400 metr
  Fisherman's Inn — dengizdan 50 metr
→ FISHERMAN'S INN yaqinroq!

TO'G'RI VARIANTLAR:
  'Pebbles Restaurant is FURTHER FROM the sea
   than Fisherman's Inn.'
  yoki
  'Fisherman's Inn is CLOSER to the sea than
   Pebbles Restaurant.'

(Agar o'qituvchi kitobning javobini so'rasa —
'closer to the sea than' deb yozing, lekin
xatoni bilib turing.)

NAMUNA. 25 xodim > 15 xodim.
'many' → MORE (noto'g'ri sifat).
'staff' = xodimlar (shakli birlik, ma'nosi ko'plik).
'more staffs' XATO.

Pebbles: £25-£50
Fisherman's Inn: £10-£30
→ Pebbles QIMMATROQ.
'expensive' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE EXPENSIVE + THAN.

Fisherman's Inn: 60 stol
Pebbles: 25 stol
→ Fisherman's Inn da KO'PROQ.
'many' → MORE + THAN.
'tables' SANALADIGAN ot.

Fisherman's Inn: 1958-yilda ochilgan
Pebbles: 1975-yilda ochilgan
→ 1958 AVVALROQ → Fisherman's Inn ESKIROQ.
'old' — 1 bo'g'in → OLDER + THAN.
DIQQAT: kichikroq sana = eskiroq.

Pebbles: 'SMALL and romantic'
Fisherman's Inn: 'LARGE, clean dining area'
→ Pebbles KICHIKROQ.
'small' — 1 bo'g'in → SMALLER + THAN.
Stollar soni ham buni tasdiqlaydi (25 < 60).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with in, of, than, the or as.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni in, of, than, the yoki as bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  the tallest building IN New York
  2  faster THAN travelling by train
  3  the most expensive OF all
  4  more comfortable THAN the Paradise Hotel
  5  not AS exciting AS the nightlife in LA
  6  the most famous sights IN London
  7  THE oldest church in the country


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Butunjahon savdo markazi Nyu-Yorkdagi eng
     baland bino.
  2  Samolyotda sayohat qilish poyezdda sayohat
     qilishdan tezroq.
  3  Mening shahrimda beshta restoran bor.
     'Pierre's' hammasidan qimmat.
  4  'Sandy Beach' mehmonxonasi 'Paradise'
     mehmonxonasidan qulayroq.
  5  Bostondagi tungi hayot Los-Anjelesdagi
     tungi hayot chalik qiziqarli emas.
  6  Big Ben Londondagi eng mashhur diqqatga
     sazovor joylardan biri.
  7  Avliyo Meri cherkovi mamlakatdagi eng eski
     cherkov.


QOIDA — QAYSI SO'Z QAChON:

  THAN   — sifat QIYOSIY shaklda
              (faster, more comfortable)
              → 2, 4-bandlar

  IN     — ORTTIRMA daraja + JOY
              (in New York, in London)
              → 1, 6-bandlar

  OF     — ORTTIRMA daraja + GURUH
              (of all)
              → 3-band

  AS...AS — sifat ODDIY shaklda + 'not'
              → 5-band

  THE    — ORTTIRMA daraja OLDIDAN
              → 7-band


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDA IKKI BO'ShLIQ:
  'is not ...... exciting ...... the nightlife'
  Ikkalasi ham 'AS':
  'is NOT AS exciting AS the nightlife in LA'

DIQQAT — 7-BANDDA 'THE' TUShIB QOLGAN:
  'St Mary's is ...... oldest church'
  Bo'shliqdan keyin 'oldEST' — orttirma daraja →
  oldidan 'THE' kerak.
  Bu — eng ko'p unutiladigan qoida.

DIQQAT — 1 va 6-BANDLAR SOLIShTIRING:
  1: 'the tallest building IN New York'
  6: 'one of the most famous sights IN London'
  Ikkalasida ham ORTTIRMA daraja + ShAHAR → IN.
  6-bandda 'one of the ...' → keyin KO'PLIK ot
  ('sightS').


ATOQLI OTLAR:
  The World Trade Center — Nyu-Yorkdagi osmono'par
     binolar (2001-yilda vayron qilingan)
  Big Ben — London parlamenti minorasidagi mashhur
     soat
  St Mary's — Avliyo Meri cherkovi


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a church  = cherkov
  a sight   = diqqatga sazovor joy
  a plane   = samolyot

tasks.prompt: 1  The World Trade Center is the tallest building ............ New York.
tasks.whyUz:
'the tallEST' ORTTIRMA daraja + ShAHAR → IN.
Grammar 52-bet: 'the ... IN' (joy bilan).
tasks.speak: 1  The World Trade Center is the tallest building ............ New York.

tasks.prompt: 2  Travelling by plane is faster ............ travelling by train.
tasks.whyUz:
'fastER' QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
DIQQAT: ikki tomonda ham 'TRAVELLING' —
bir xil narsalar solishtiriladi.
tasks.speak: 2  Travelling by plane is faster ............ travelling by train.

tasks.prompt: 3  There are five restaurants in my town. Pierre's is the most expensive ............ all.
tasks.whyUz:
'the most expensive' ORTTIRMA daraja +
'all' GURUH → OF.
'of all' = hammasidan.
'in all' XATO.
tasks.speak: 3  There are five restaurants in my town. Pierre's is the most expensive ............ all.

tasks.prompt: 4  The Sandy Beach Hotel is more comfortable ............ the Paradise Hotel.
tasks.whyUz:
'MORE comfortable' QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
Ikki mehmonxona solishtirilmoqda.
tasks.speak: 4  The Sandy Beach Hotel is more comfortable ............ the Paradise Hotel.

tasks.prompt: 5  The nightlife in Boston is not ............ exciting ............ the nightlife in Los Angeles.  [ikkala bo'shliq]
tasks.whyUz:
'exciting' ODDIY shaklda va 'not' bor →
AS ... AS.
'is NOT AS exciting AS ...'
= ... chalik qiziqarli emas.
DIQQAT: ikkala bo'shliq ham 'as'.
tasks.speak: 5  The nightlife in Boston is not ............ exciting ............ the nightlife in Los Angeles.  [ikkala bo'shliq]

tasks.prompt: 6  Big Ben is one of the most famous sights ............ London.
tasks.whyUz:
'the most famous' ORTTIRMA daraja + ShAHAR → IN.
DIQQAT: 'one of the ...' dan keyin KO'PLIK ot
('sightS').
Big Ben — London parlamentidagi mashhur soat minorasi.
tasks.speak: 6  Big Ben is one of the most famous sights ............ London.

tasks.prompt: 7  St Mary's is ............ oldest church in the country.
tasks.whyUz:
'oldEST' ORTTIRMA daraja → oldidan DOIM 'THE'.
Bu — eng ko'p UNUTILADIGAN qoida.
'St Mary's is oldest church' XATO.
'a church' = cherkov.
tasks.speak: 7  St Mary's is ............ oldest church in the country.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct form of the adjectives in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qavsdagi sifatlarning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  THE OLDEST city in Europe
  2  WORSE than yesterday
  3  SMALLER than the old one
  4  AS CROWDED as Boston
  5  THE MOST FASHIONABLE area in town
  6  MORE EXPENSIVE than the local shops
  7  THE BEST view of all the rooms
  8  AS POLLUTED as it was ten years ago


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Rim Yevropadagi eng eski shaharmi?
  2  Bugungi tirbandlik kechagidan yomonroq.
  3  Yangi uyimizdagi bog' eskisidan kichikroq.
  4  Los-Anjeles Boston chalik gavjum.
  5  Stivenslar shahardagi eng moda hududda
     yashashadi.
  6  Markazdagi do'konlar mahalliy do'konlardan
     qimmatroqmi?
  7  Bu xonada mehmonxonadagi hamma xonalarnikidan
     eng yaxshi manzara bor.
  8  Shahar o'n yil oldingidek ifloslangan emas.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  'than' bor          →  QIYOSIY daraja
     2, 3, 6-bandlar
  'the ... in/of' bor →  ORTTIRMA daraja
     1, 5, 7-bandlar
  'as' bor            →  ODDIY shakl + AS
     4, 8-bandlar


SIFATLARNING YASALIShI:
  old         → THE OLDEST     (1 bo'g'in)
  bad         → WORSE          (NOTO'G'RI)
  small       → SMALLER        (1 bo'g'in)
  crowded     → as CROWDED as  (ODDIY shakl)
  fashionable → THE MOST FASHIONABLE (4 bo'g'in)
  expensive   → MORE EXPENSIVE (3 bo'g'in)
  good        → THE BEST       (NOTO'G'RI)
  polluted    → as POLLUTED as (ODDIY shakl)


ENG MUHIM BANDLAR:

  2-BAND — NOTO'G'RI SIFAT:
     'bad' → 'WORSE' ('badder' XATO).
     'The traffic today is WORSE than yesterday.'

  4-BAND — 'AS' GAPDA BOR:
     'Los Angeles is ...... (crowded) AS Boston.'
     Ikkinchi 'as' allaqachon bosilgan →
     javobga birinchi 'as' + ODDIY sifat kiradi:
     'AS CROWDED'.
     'more crowded as' XATO.

  7-BAND — NOTO'G'RI SIFAT + ORTTIRMA:
     'good' → 'THE BEST'.
     'the best view OF ALL the rooms' —
     'of' bilan (guruh).

  8-BAND — 4-BAND BILAN BIR XIL:
     'The city ISN'T ...... (polluted) AS it was
      ten years ago.'
     → 'AS POLLUTED'.
     Shahar O'ZINING o'n yil oldingi holati bilan
     solishtirilmoqda.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a view       = manzara, ko'rinish
  local        = mahalliy
  fashionable  = moda
  the Stevens  = Stivenslar (oila familiyasi;
                 'the' + familiya = butun oila)

tasks.whyUz:
'... IN Europe' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'old' — 1 bo'g'in → THE OLDEST.
'THE' TUSHIB QOLMASIN.
Grammar 53-bet, 3-mashqning 4-bandi ham shu
qolipda edi ('Is Athens the oldest city in
Europe?').

tasks.prompt: 2  The traffic today is ............ (bad) than yesterday.
tasks.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'bad' — NOTO'G'RI sifat → WORSE.
'badder' / 'more bad' XATO.
6-mashqdagi jadvalda ham bor.
tasks.speak: 2  The traffic today is ............ (bad) than yesterday.

tasks.prompt: 3  The garden in our new house is ............ (small) than the old one.
tasks.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'small' — 1 bo'g'in → SMALLER.
'the old ONE' = 'the old garden' o'rniga.
tasks.speak: 3  The garden in our new house is ............ (small) than the old one.

tasks.whyUz:
Gapda IKKINCHI 'as' allaqachon bosilgan →
'AS ... AS' qolipi.
Javobga BIRINCHI 'as' + ODDIY sifat kiradi:
'AS CROWDED'.
'more crowded as' XATO.
= LA Boston chalik gavjum (TENG).

tasks.prompt: 5  The Stevens live in ............ (fashionable) area in town.
tasks.whyUz:
'... IN town' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'fashionable' — 4 bo'g'in → THE MOST FASHIONABLE.
'The Stevens' = Stivenslar oilasi
('the' + familiya = butun oila).
tasks.speak: 5  The Stevens live in ............ (fashionable) area in town.

tasks.prompt: 6  Are the shops in the centre ............ (expensive) than the local shops?
tasks.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'expensive' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE EXPENSIVE.
'local' = mahalliy.
tasks.speak: 6  Are the shops in the centre ............ (expensive) than the local shops?

tasks.prompt: 7  This room has got ............ (good) view of all the rooms in the hotel.
tasks.whyUz:
'OF ALL the rooms' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'good' — NOTO'G'RI sifat → THE BEST.
'the goodest' XATO.
'a view' = manzara, ko'rinish.
tasks.speak: 7  This room has got ............ (good) view of all the rooms in the hotel.

tasks.prompt: 8  The city isn't ............ (polluted) as it was ten years ago.
tasks.whyUz:
Gapda IKKINCHI 'as' bosilgan → 'AS ... AS' qolipi.
Javob: 'AS POLLUTED'.
'isn't AS POLLUTED AS it was' = o'n yil
oldingidek ifloslangan emas (ya'ni HOZIR
TOZAROQ).
4-band bilan bir xil qoida.
tasks.speak: 8  The city isn't ............ (polluted) as it was ten years ago.

exercises.instructionEn: Expand the sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni to'ldiring (kengaytiring), namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  The Colosseum is/interesting/sight in Rome
     → 'The Colosseum is THE MOST INTERESTING
        sight in Rome.'

  Ya'ni: chiziqchalar orasidagi so'zlarni to'liq
  gapga aylantirish kerak — kerakli daraja,
  artikl va 'than'/'as' ni O'ZINGIZ qo'shasiz.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  The Colosseum is THE MOST INTERESTING sight
     in Rome.                            (NAMUNA)

  2  Big cities are usually MORE POLLUTED THAN
     small towns.

  3  Swimming in the sea is MORE DANGEROUS THAN
     swimming in a pool.

  4  Is the Nile LONGER THAN the Thames?

  5  Last night was THE MOST ROMANTIC night of my
     life.

  6  The blue one is AS EXPENSIVE AS the white one.

  7  We paid LESS for accommodation THAN for
     entertainment.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Kolizey Rimdagi eng qiziqarli diqqatga
     sazovor joy.
  2  Katta shaharlar odatda kichik shaharchalardan
     ifloslanganroq.
  3  Dengizda suzish hovuzda suzishdan xavfliroq.
  4  Nil Temzadan uzunroqmi?
  5  Kechagi kecha hayotimdagi eng romantik kecha
     edi.
  6  Ikki mashina bir xil narxda. Ko'k mashina oq
     mashina chalik qimmat.
  7  Biz turar joy uchun ko'ngilocharga
     qaraganda kamroq to'ladik.


QAYSI QOLIP QAChON — HAR BANDNI TAHLIL QILING:

  1, 5 — ORTTIRMA daraja
     Belgisi: 'in Rome', 'of my life' —
     guruh yoki joy chegaralangan.
     → THE MOST + sifat

  2, 3, 4 — QIYOSIY daraja + THAN
     Belgisi: ikki narsa qatorda berilgan
     (big cities / small towns;
      the sea / a pool;
      the Nile / the Thames).

  6 — AS ... AS (TENGLIK)
     Belgisi: 'The two cars are THE SAME PRICE.'
     Kitob ataylab aytgan: narx BIR XIL →
     tenglik qolipi.
     'more expensive than' XATO bo'lardi.

  7 — 'LITTLE' NING QIYOSIY ShAKLI + THAN
     'little' → LESS (noto'g'ri sifat,
     6-mashqdagi jadvaldan).
     'We paid LESS ... THAN ...'


ENG MUHIM BAND — 6-BAND:
  'The two cars are THE SAME PRICE.'
  Bu gap javobni ANIQ ko'rsatib turibdi:
  narxlar TENG → 'AS EXPENSIVE AS'.
  Agar bu jumla bo'lmasa, 'more expensive than'
  ham mumkin bo'lardi.

DIQQAT — 7-BANDDAGI SO'Z TARTIBI:
  'We paid LESS for accommodation THAN for
   entertainment.'
  'less' fe'ldan keyin, 'than' esa taqqoslanadigan
  ikkinchi qismdan oldin.


ATOQLI OTLAR:
  the Colosseum — Kolizey (Rim), Coursebook
     84-betdagi rasmda ham bor edi
  the Nile      — Nil daryosi (dunyodagi eng uzun)
  the Thames    — Temza daryosi (London)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a pool           = hovuz
  the same price   = bir xil narx
  accommodation    = turar joy
  entertainment    = ko'ngilochar
  to pay (paid)    = to'lamoq (to'ladi)

tasks.prompt: 1  The Colosseum is / interesting / sight in Rome
tasks.answer: The Colosseum is the most interesting sight in Rome.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA. 'in Rome' → guruh chegaralangan →
ORTTIRMA daraja.
'interesting' — 4 bo'g'in → THE MOST INTERESTING.
Kolizey — Coursebook 84-betdagi rasmda ham bor
(82 AD).
tasks.speak: 1  The Colosseum is / interesting / sight in Rome

tasks.prompt: 2  Big cities are usually / polluted / small towns.
tasks.answer: Big cities are usually more polluted than small towns.
tasks.whyUz:
IKKI narsa (big cities / small towns) →
QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'polluted' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE POLLUTED.
'usually' o'z o'rnida qoladi.
tasks.speak: 2  Big cities are usually / polluted / small towns.

tasks.prompt: 3  Swimming in the sea is / dangerous / swimming in a pool.
tasks.answer: Swimming in the sea is more dangerous than swimming in a pool.
tasks.whyUz:
IKKI harakat solishtirilmoqda →
QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'dangerous' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE DANGEROUS.
DIQQAT: ikki tomonda ham 'SWIMMING' —
bir xil shakl.
tasks.speak: 3  Swimming in the sea is / dangerous / swimming in a pool.

tasks.prompt: 4  Is the Nile / long / the Thames?
tasks.answer: Is the Nile longer than the Thames?
tasks.whyUz:
IKKI daryo → QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'long' — 1 bo'g'in → LONGER.
SAVOL shakli: 'IS the Nile longer than ...?'
Nil — dunyodagi eng uzun daryo (Coursebook
85-bet, 12-mashq), Temza — Londondagi daryo.
tasks.speak: 4  Is the Nile / long / the Thames?

tasks.prompt: 5  Last night was / romantic / night of my life.
tasks.answer: Last night was the most romantic night of my life.
tasks.whyUz:
'OF my life' → guruh chegaralangan →
ORTTIRMA daraja.
'romantic' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST ROMANTIC.
1-band bilan bir xil qolip.
tasks.speak: 5  Last night was / romantic / night of my life.

tasks.prompt: 6  The two cars are the same price. The blue one is / expensive / the white one.
tasks.answer: The blue one is as expensive as the white one.
tasks.promptUz: DIQQAT — 'the same price' javobni ko'rsatib turibdi
tasks.whyUz:
BIRINCHI JUMLA KALIT: 'The two cars are THE SAME
PRICE' — narxlar TENG.
→ TENGLIK qolipi: AS ... AS.
'AS EXPENSIVE AS' (sifat ODDIY shaklda).
'more expensive than' XATO bo'lardi —
narxlar bir xil-ku.
tasks.speak: 6  The two cars are the same price. The blue one is / expensive / the white one.

tasks.prompt: 7  We paid / little / for accommodation than for entertainment.
tasks.answer: We paid less for accommodation than for entertainment.
tasks.whyUz:
'than' allaqachon gapda bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'little' — NOTO'G'RI sifat → LESS
(6-mashqdagi jadvaldan).
'littler' XATO.
SO'Z TARTIBI: 'We paid LESS for accommodation
THAN for entertainment.'
= turar joyga ko'ngilochardan kamroq to'ladik.
tasks.speak: 7  We paid / little / for accommodation than for entertainment.

exercises.instructionEn: Expand the sentences, as in the example. (items 8-10)
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni to'ldiring (kengaytiring), namunadagidek. (8-10-bandlar)
exercises.explanationUz:
49-BETDAGI 10-MAShQNING DAVOMI.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   8  Travelling by train ISN'T AS EXPENSIVE AS
      travelling by plane.

   9  Isn't this THE DULLEST place OF ALL?

  10  When I lived here it was MUCH QUIETER THAN
      it is today.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   8  Poyezdda sayohat qilish samolyotda sayohat
      qilish chalik qimmat emas.
   9  Bu hammasidan zerikarli joy emasmi?
  10  Men bu yerda yashaganimda, u bugungidan
      ancha tinchroq edi.


HAR BIRINING TAHLILI:

  8  'ISN'T' bor → INKOR → AS ... AS qolipi.
     'isn't AS EXPENSIVE AS'
     ('expensive' ODDIY shaklda qoladi).
     Poyezd samolyotdan arzonroq — bu haqiqat ham
     mos keladi.

  9  'OF ALL' bor → ORTTIRMA daraja.
     'dull' — 1 bo'g'in → THE DULLEST.
     DIQQAT: savol INKOR shaklda
     ('ISN'T this ...?') — bu ajablanish yoki
     shikoyatni bildiradi.
     'dull' = zerikarli (48-betdagi 4-mashqda
     sinonimi 'boring').

  10  'MUCH' bor → QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
      'quiet' — 1 bo'g'in → QUIETER.
      'much quieter THAN it is today'
      = bugungidan ancha tinchroq.
      DIQQAT: 'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan
      (Grammar 52-bet).


UCh XIL QOLIP — BIR MAShQDA:
   8  → AS ... AS      (tenglik inkori)
   9  → THE ... OF ALL (orttirma)
  10  → MUCH ... THAN  (kuchaytirilgan qiyosiy)

tasks.prompt: 8  Travelling by train isn't / expensive / travelling by plane.
tasks.answer: Travelling by train isn't as expensive as travelling by plane.
tasks.whyUz:
'ISN'T' bor → INKOR → AS ... AS qolipi.
'expensive' ODDIY shaklda qoladi.
'isn't more expensive as' XATO.
DIQQAT: ikki tomonda ham 'TRAVELLING' —
bir xil shakl.
tasks.speak: 8  Travelling by train isn't / expensive / travelling by plane.

tasks.prompt: 9  Isn't this / dull / place of all?
tasks.answer: Isn't this the dullest place of all?
tasks.whyUz:
'OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'dull' — 1 bo'g'in → THE DULLEST.
'THE' TUSHIB QOLMASIN.
Savol INKOR shaklda ('Isn't this ...?') —
ajablanish yoki shikoyat.
'dull' = zerikarli (= boring).
tasks.speak: 9  Isn't this / dull / place of all?

tasks.prompt: 10  When I lived here it was much / quiet / it is today.
tasks.answer: When I lived here it was much quieter than it is today.
tasks.whyUz:
'MUCH' bor → QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
'quiet' — 1 bo'g'in → QUIETER.
'much quiet' XATO — 'much' faqat qiyosiy
daraja bilan.
O'tmish HOZIR bilan solishtirilmoqda:
'it WAS ... than it IS today'.
tasks.speak: 10  When I lived here it was much / quiet / it is today.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the three people in the pictures and the information below. Then, fill in the gaps in the sentences with the correct form of the adjectives in the brackets, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlardagi uch odamga va quyidagi ma'lumotga qarang. So'ng gaplardagi bo'shliqlarni qavsdagi sifatlarning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL:

 ┌──────────┬────────────┬────────────┬────────────┐
 │  Name:   │  SANDRA    │  TERESA    │  RUTH      │
 ├──────────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────────┤
 │  Age:    │  8         │  26        │  58        │
 │  Height: │ 1.30 metres│ 1.75 metres│ 1.60 metres│
 │  Weight: │  35 kilos  │  60 kilos  │  75 kilos  │
 └──────────┴────────────┴────────────┴────────────┘

RASMDA (chapdan o'ngga):
  SANDRA — kichkina qiz, uzun sochli
  TERESA — yosh ayol, uzun sochli
  RUTH   — keksa ayol, kalta sochli, ko'zoynakli


HAR KO'RSATKICh BO'YIChA TARTIB:

  YOSh:     Sandra 8  <  Teresa 26  <  Ruth 58
            → RUTH eng katta

  BO'Y:     Sandra 1.30 < Ruth 1.60 < Teresa 1.75
            → TERESA eng baland
            → SANDRA eng past

  VAZN:     Sandra 35 < Teresa 60 < Ruth 75
            → RUTH eng og'ir
            → SANDRA eng ozg'in


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  Ruth is OLDER (old) than Teresa but she's
     MUCH OLDER THAN (old) Sandra.

  Namuna QOLIPNI ko'rsatadi:
     birinchi bo'shliq  → oddiy QIYOSIY daraja
     ikkinchi bo'shliq  → MUCH + QIYOSIY + THAN
  ('much' — farq KATTAROQ ekanini bildiradi:
   Ruth 58 va Teresa 26 farqi 32 yil,
   Ruth 58 va Sandra 8 farqi esa 50 yil)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  Ruth is OLDER than Teresa but she's
     MUCH OLDER THAN Sandra.            (NAMUNA)
     (58 > 26;  58 >> 8)

  2  Sandra is SHORTER than Ruth but she's
     MUCH SHORTER THAN Teresa.
     (1.30 < 1.60, farq 0.30;
      1.30 < 1.75, farq 0.45)

  3  Ruth is HEAVIER than Teresa but she's
     MUCH HEAVIER THAN Sandra.
     (75 > 60, farq 15;  75 > 35, farq 40)

  4  Teresa has LONGER hair than Ruth but Sandra
     has got THE LONGEST hair of all.
     (rasmga qarang: Rut kalta sochli)

  5  Ruth is TALLER THAN Sandra but Teresa is
     THE TALLEST of all.
     (1.60 > 1.30;  1.75 — eng baland)

  6  Teresa is THINNER THAN Ruth but Sandra is
     THE THINNEST of all.
     (60 < 75;  35 — eng yengil)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Rut Teresadan katta, lekin Sandradan ancha
     katta.
  2  Sandra Rutdan past, lekin Teresadan ancha
     past.
  3  Rut Teresadan og'ir, lekin Sandradan ancha
     og'ir.
  4  Teresaning sochi Rutnikidan uzun, lekin
     Sandraning sochi hammasidan uzun.
  5  Rut Sandradan baland, lekin Teresa
     hammasidan baland.
  6  Teresa Rutdan ozg'in, lekin Sandra
     hammasidan ozg'in.


DIQQAT — 5 va 6-BANDLARDA 'THAN' YO'Q:
  'Ruth is ...... (tall) Sandra'
  Gapda 'than' BOSILMAGAN → u ham javobga kiradi:
  'TALLER THAN Sandra'.
  Xuddi shunday 6-bandda: 'THINNER THAN Ruth'.

DIQQAT — 5 va 6-BANDLARNING IKKINChI QISMI
ORTTIRMA:
  'but Teresa is ...... (tall) OF ALL'
  'of all' → ORTTIRMA daraja: THE TALLEST.
  1, 2, 3-bandlardan FARQ QILADI (u yerda
  ikkinchi qism ham QIYOSIY edi).

DIQQAT — 4-BAND JADVALDA YO'Q:
  Soch uzunligi jadvalda berilmagan —
  faqat RASMDAN ko'rinadi:
     Sandra — eng uzun soch
     Teresa — uzun soch
     Ruth   — kalta soch


SIFATLARNING YASALIShI:
  old   → older     (1 bo'g'in)
  short → shorter   (1 bo'g'in)
  heavy → heavIER   ('-y' → -IER)
  long  → longer / THE LONGEST
  tall  → taller / THE TALLEST
  thin  → thinNER / THE thinNEST
          (undosh IKKILANADI!)

tasks.prompt: 1  Ruth is ............ (old) than Teresa but she's ............ (old) Sandra.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA.
Rut 58, Teresa 26, Sandra 8.
Birinchi bo'shliq: oddiy QIYOSIY → OLDER.
Ikkinchi bo'shliq: farq ANCHA katta →
MUCH OLDER THAN.
tasks.speak: 1  Ruth is ............ (old) than Teresa but she's ............ (old) Sandra.

tasks.prompt: 2  Sandra is ............ (short) than Ruth but she's ............ (short) than Teresa.
tasks.whyUz:
Sandra 1.30, Rut 1.60, Teresa 1.75.
Sandra Rutdan 0.30 past → SHORTER.
Sandra Teresadan 0.45 past (ANCHAKO'P) →
MUCH SHORTER.
'short' — 1 bo'g'in → -ER.
tasks.speak: 2  Sandra is ............ (short) than Ruth but she's ............ (short) than Teresa.

tasks.prompt: 3  Ruth is ............ (heavy) than Teresa but she's ............ (heavy) than Sandra.
tasks.whyUz:
Rut 75, Teresa 60, Sandra 35.
Rut Teresadan 15 kg og'ir → HEAVIER.
Rut Sandradan 40 kg og'ir (ANCHAKO'P) →
MUCH HEAVIER.
'heavy' — '-y' TUSHADI → HEAVIER.
tasks.speak: 3  Ruth is ............ (heavy) than Teresa but she's ............ (heavy) than Sandra.

tasks.prompt: 4  Teresa has ............ (long) hair than Ruth but Sandra has got ............ (long) hair of all.
tasks.whyUz:
Bu ma'lumot JADVALDA YO'Q — faqat RASMDAN
ko'rinadi:
  Rut — KALTA soch (keksa ayol, ko'zoynakli)
  Teresa — uzun soch
  Sandra — ENG uzun soch

Birinchi: 'than' bor → QIYOSIY → LONGER.
Ikkinchi: 'OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA → THE LONGEST.
tasks.speak: 4  Teresa has ............ (long) hair than Ruth but Sandra has got ............ (long) hair of all.

tasks.prompt: 5  Ruth is ............ (tall) Sandra but Teresa is ............ (tall) of all.
tasks.whyUz:
Rut 1.60 > Sandra 1.30 → TALLER.
DIQQAT: gapda 'than' BOSILMAGAN →
u ham javobga kiradi: 'TALLER THAN Sandra'.

Ikkinchi: 'OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA.
Teresa 1.75 — eng baland → THE TALLEST.
tasks.speak: 5  Ruth is ............ (tall) Sandra but Teresa is ............ (tall) of all.

tasks.prompt: 6  Teresa is ............ (thin) Ruth but Sandra is ............ (thin) of all.
tasks.whyUz:
Teresa 60 kg < Rut 75 kg → THINNER.
DIQQAT: 'than' ham javobga kiradi.

Ikkinchi: 'OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA.
Sandra 35 kg — eng yengil → THE THINNEST.

YOZILISH: 'thin' = th + i + n
(undosh + unli + undosh) → 'n' IKKILANADI:
THINNER, THE THINNEST.
'thiner' XATO.
tasks.speak: 6  Teresa is ............ (thin) Ruth but Sandra is ............ (thin) of all.

exercises.instructionEn: Write sentences using the words in brackets, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi so'zlardan foydalanib gaplar yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  It's only 5°C. Can the children play in the
     garden?  (cold)
     → 'NO, THEY CAN'T. IT'S TOO COLD.'

  QOLIP — IKKI QISM:
     1) 'No, [olmosh] can't.'
     2) '[olmosh] + is/are TOO + sifat.'

  'TOO' = HADDAN TAShQARI — ya'ni biror ishni
  QILIB BO'LMAYDI (Grammar 52-bet qoidasi).


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  No, they can't. It's too cold.        (NAMUNA)
     (5°C — bog'da o'ynash uchun juda sovuq)

  2  No, we can't. It's too heavy.
     (quti to'la — ko'tarib bo'lmaydi)

  3  No, he can't. He's too old.
     (80 yosh — vindserfing uchun juda keksa)

  4  No, I can't. It's too expensive.
     (£300 — sotib olish uchun juda qimmat)

  5  No, she can't. She's too young.
     (10 yosh — mashina haydash uchun juda yosh)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Yo'q, o'ynay olmaydilar. Juda sovuq.
  2  Yo'q, ko'tara olmaymiz. Juda og'ir.
  3  Yo'q, qila olmaydi. U juda keksa.
  4  Yo'q, sotib ololmayman. U juda qimmat.
  5  Yo'q, hayday olmaydi. U juda yosh.


DIQQAT — OLMOShLARGA E'TIBOR BERING:
  Savoldagi ega → javobdagi olmosh:

  'Can THE CHILDREN play ...?'  → THEY
  'Can WE carry it?'            → WE
  'Can HE windsurf?'            → HE
  'Can YOU buy it?'             → I
  'Can SHE drive a car?'        → SHE

  DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA OLMOSh O'ZGARADI:
  Savolda 'YOU' → javobda 'I'
  (chunki javob beruvchi o'zi haqida gapiradi).


DIQQAT — 'IT' yoki OLMOSh:
  Gapning ikkinchi qismida NIMA 'too ...' ekaniga
  qarang:

  1  ob-havo sovuq  → IT'S too cold
  2  quti og'ir     → IT'S too heavy
  3  ODAM keksa     → HE'S too old
  4  narsa qimmat   → IT'S too expensive
  5  ODAM yosh      → SHE'S too young

  1, 2, 4 — NARSA/holat haqida → 'IT'
  3, 5 — ODAM haqida → 'HE'/'SHE'


DIQQAT — 'TOO' va 'VERY' FARQI:
  'It's VERY cold' — sovuq, lekin o'ynash mumkin
  'It's TOO cold'  — shunchalik sovuqki, O'YNAB
                     BO'LMAYDI
  Bu mashqda DOIM 'too' — chunki javob 'No, ...
  can't' (imkonsizlik).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to carry     = ko'tarib yurmoq, tashimoq
  to windsurf  = vindserfing bilan shug'ullanmoq
  full         = to'la
  young        = yosh
  °C (degrees Celsius) = Selsiy gradusi

tasks.prompt: 1  It's only 5°C. Can the children play in the garden?  (cold)
tasks.answer: No, they can't. It's too cold.
tasks.whyUz:
NAMUNA.
'the children' → 'THEY'.
Ob-havo haqida → 'IT'S'.
5°C — bog'da o'ynash uchun juda sovuq →
'TOO cold' (imkonsizlik).
tasks.speak: 1  It's only 5°C. Can the children play in the garden?  (cold)

tasks.prompt: 2  The box is full. Can we carry it?  (heavy)
tasks.answer: No, we can't. It's too heavy.
tasks.whyUz:
'Can WE ...?' → 'No, WE can't.'
Quti haqida → 'IT'S too heavy'.
'full' = to'la → shuning uchun og'ir.
'to carry' = ko'tarib yurmoq.
tasks.speak: 2  The box is full. Can we carry it?  (heavy)

tasks.prompt: 3  He is 80 years old. Can he windsurf?  (old)
tasks.answer: No, he can't. He's too old.
tasks.whyUz:
'Can HE ...?' → 'No, HE can't.'
ODAM haqida → 'HE'S too old' ('it's' EMAS).
80 yosh — vindserfing uchun juda keksa.
'to windsurf' = vindserfing bilan shug'ullanmoq.
tasks.speak: 3  He is 80 years old. Can he windsurf?  (old)

tasks.prompt: 4  It costs £300. Can you buy it?  (expensive)
tasks.answer: No, I can't. It's too expensive.
tasks.whyUz:
DIQQAT: savolda 'YOU' → javobda 'I'
(javob beruvchi O'ZI haqida gapiradi).
'No, I can't.'
Narsa haqida → 'IT'S too expensive'.
£300 — sotib olish uchun juda qimmat.
tasks.speak: 4  It costs £300. Can you buy it?  (expensive)

tasks.prompt: 5  She's ten years old. Can she drive a car?  (young)
tasks.answer: No, she can't. She's too young.
tasks.whyUz:
'Can SHE ...?' → 'No, SHE can't.'
ODAM haqida → 'SHE'S too young'.
10 yosh — mashina haydash uchun juda yosh.
'young' = yosh ('old' ning aksi).
tasks.speak: 5  She's ten years old. Can she drive a car?  (young)

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, present continuous or past simple. (Dialogue a)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, present continuous yoki past simple ga qo'ying. (a-dialog)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Paul: DID YOU BUY a new car, John?
  John: Yes. I BOUGHT it last week. I'M GOING for
        a drive now. DO YOU WANT to come?
  Paul: Yes, please.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Pol: Yangi mashina sotib oldingmi, Jon?
  Jon: Ha. O'tgan hafta sotib oldim. Hozir
       sayrga chiqyapman. Kelishni xohlaysanmi?
  Pol: Ha, iltimos.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) '...... (you/buy) a new car?'
     → 'DID YOU BUY'
     PAST SIMPLE so'roq — mashina ALLAQAChON
     sotib olingan (javobdan ma'lum: 'last week').
     DID + you + BUY (ASOSIY shakl).

  2) 'I ...... (buy) it last week.'
     → 'BOUGHT'
     'last week' → PAST SIMPLE.
     buy → BOUGHT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

  3) 'I ...... (go) for a drive NOW.'
     → "'M GOING" (am going)
     'NOW' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
     'go for a drive' = mashinada sayr qilmoq.

  4) '...... (you/want) to come?'
     → 'DO YOU WANT'
     'want' — HIS-TUYG'U fe'li → PRESENT
     CONTINUOUS OLMAYDI.
     'Are you wanting' XATO.
     PRESENT SIMPLE so'roq: DO + you + WANT.


DIQQAT — 3 va 4-BANDLAR ALDAMChI:
  Ikkalasi ham HOZIRGI vaqt haqida, lekin
  turli zamonlarda:
     'I'M GOING for a drive'   (harakat → -ing)
     'DO YOU WANT to come?'    (his-tuyg'u → -ing YO'Q)


NOTO'G'RI FE'L:
  buy → BOUGHT

tasks.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE so'roq.
Javobdan ma'lum: mashina 'LAST WEEK' sotib
olingan.
DID + you + BUY (ASOSIY shakl).
'Did you bought' XATO.

tasks.prompt: John: Yes. I 2) ............ (buy) it last week.
tasks.whyUz:
'last week' → PAST SIMPLE.
buy → BOUGHT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
tasks.speak: John: Yes. I 2) ............ (buy) it last week.

tasks.prompt: John: I 3) ............ (go) for a drive now.
tasks.whyUz:
'NOW' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'I' → AM + GOING.
'go for a drive' = mashinada sayr qilmoq.
tasks.speak: John: I 3) ............ (go) for a drive now.

tasks.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE so'roq: DO + you + WANT.
'want' — HIS-TUYG'U fe'li → '-ing' OLMAYDI.
'Are you wanting' XATO.
DIQQAT: 3-band bilan solishtiring —
u yerda 'going' (harakat), bu yerda 'want'
(his-tuyg'u).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (Dialogue b)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. (b-dialog)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Sheila: What ARE YOU DOING this afternoon?
  Diana:  I'M GOING to the supermarket.
          DO YOU NEED anything?
  Sheila: Could you get me two cartons of milk and
          a kilo of sugar, please?


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Sheyla: Bugun tushdan keyin nima qilyapsan?
  Diana:  Supermarketga ketyapman.
          Senga biror narsa kerakmi?
  Sheyla: Menga ikki paket sut va bir kilo shakar
          olib kela olasanmi, iltimos?


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) 'What ...... (you/do) THIS AFTERNOON?'
     → 'ARE YOU DOING'
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS — REJALAShTIRILGAN
     yaqin kelajak.
     'this afternoon' — bugun tushdan keyin
     (hali kelmagan, lekin reja bor).

  2) 'I ...... (go) to the supermarket.'
     → "'M GOING" (am going)
     Yana PRESENT CONTINUOUS — reja.

  3) '...... (you/need) anything?'
     → 'DO YOU NEED'
     'need' — HIS-TUYG'U/HOLAT fe'li →
     '-ing' OLMAYDI.
     'Are you needing' XATO.
     PRESENT SIMPLE so'roq: DO + you + NEED.


DIQQAT — 'ANYTHING' SO'ROQ GAPDA:
  'Do you need ANYTHING?'
  So'roq va inkor gaplarda 'any-' shakli
  ishlatiladi ('something' emas).

DIQQAT — 'COULD YOU ...?' — MULOYIM ILTIMOS:
  'COULD you get me ...?' = ... olib kela
  olasanmi?
  'Can you ...?' dan MULOYIMROQ.

DIQQAT — 'TWO CARTONS OF MILK':
  'milk' SANALMAYDIGAN ot → to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
  sanab bo'lmaydi.
  Shuning uchun O'LChOV so'zi ishlatiladi:
     two CARTONS OF milk  (ikki paket sut)
     a KILO OF sugar      (bir kilo shakar)
  Unit 8 ('Enjoy your Meal') dan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a carton = paket, quti (sut, sharbat uchun)
  sugar    = shakar
  to need  = kerak bo'lmoq

tasks.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — REJALASHTIRILGAN yaqin
kelajak.
'this afternoon' hali kelmagan, lekin reja bor.
ARE + you + DOING.

PRESENT CONTINUOUS — reja.
'I' → AM + GOING.
Savolga mos zamonda javob berilmoqda.

PRESENT SIMPLE so'roq: DO + you + NEED.
'need' — HOLAT fe'li → '-ing' OLMAYDI.
'Are you needing' XATO.
DIQQAT: 'ANYTHING' — so'roq gapda 'any-' shakli.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Tonia: DO YOU KNOW where my blue jacket is, Mum?
  Mum:   ISN'T IT in your wardrobe?


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Toniya: Ko'k kurtkam qayerdaligini bilasanmi,
          oyi?
  Onasi:  U shkafingda emasmi?


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) '...... (you/know) where my blue jacket is?'
     → 'DO YOU KNOW'
     'know' — HOLAT fe'li → '-ing' OLMAYDI.
     'Are you knowing' XATO.
     PRESENT SIMPLE so'roq: DO + you + KNOW.

  2) '...... (it/not be) in your wardrobe?'
     → "ISN'T IT"
     'be' fe'lining INKOR SO'ROQ shakli.
     'it' → is → isn't → 'ISN'T IT ...?'
     DIQQAT: 'did' yoki 'do' KERAK EMAS —
     'be' fe'li o'zi oldinga chiqadi.


DIQQAT — INKOR SO'ROQ NIMA UChUN:
  'Isn't it in your wardrobe?'
  = 'Shkafingda emasmi?'
  Onasi kurtka o'sha yerda DEB O'YLAYDI va
  buni tasdiqlashni so'rayapti.
  Inkor savol shunday ma'noda ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — SO'Z TARTIBI:
  'Do you know WHERE MY BLUE JACKET IS?'
  Bu — ERGASh gap, savol EMAS.
  Shuning uchun tartib TASDIQ gapdagidek:
     'where my jacket IS'  ✓
     'where IS my jacket'  ✗ (bu to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
                              savolda ishlatiladi)


HOLAT FE'LLARI — '-ING' OLMAYDIGANLAR:
  know, need, want, like, love, hate,
  understand, believe, remember, seem

  13-mashqning UChALA dialogida ham shu qoida
  sinalgan:
     a) want  → 'Do you want ...?'
     b) need  → 'Do you need ...?'
     c) know  → 'Do you know ...?'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a jacket   = kurtka, pidjak
  a wardrobe = kiyim shkafi
