exercises.explanationUz:
ANTIGUA HAQIDAGI MATN — sakkiz xato.

TO'LIQ MATN (tuzatilgan holda):

  The small, sunny island of Antigua is one of
  THE MOST beautiful islands in the Caribbean.

  Two hundred years ago, many of the large
  buildings were houses or shops. Today, they ARE
  nice hotels with comfortable rooms.

  The Carlisle Bay club is close TO a beautiful
  beach and is MUCH less expensive than some of
  the other hotels.

  There are many interesting places to visit.
  The most popular WITH tourists are the Ebenezer
  Church and the Admiral's Museum.

  You can buy great gifts for your friends and
  family. The souvenir shops in English Harbour
  are THE CHEAPEST and the best.

  There are also many wonderful restaurants. For
  some of the MOST delicious Caribbean dishes, go
  to the Calypso Cafe in Redcliffe Street.

  For a romantic and peaceful holiday, there is
  nowhere nicer THAN Antigua.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Antiguaning kichik, quyoshli oroli Karib
  dengizidagi eng go'zal orollardan biri.

  Ikki yuz yil oldin katta binolarning ko'pi uy
  yoki do'kon edi. Bugun esa ular qulay xonalari
  bo'lgan yaxshi mehmonxonalar.

  'Carlisle Bay' klubi go'zal plyajga yaqin va
  boshqa ba'zi mehmonxonalardan ancha arzonroq.

  Borib ko'radigan qiziqarli joylar ko'p.
  Sayyohlar orasida eng mashhurlari — Ebenezer
  cherkovi va Admiral muzeyi.

  Do'stlaringiz va oilangiz uchun zo'r sovg'alar
  sotib olishingiz mumkin. English Harbour dagi
  sovg'a do'konlari eng arzon va eng yaxshisi.

  Shuningdek ko'plab ajoyib restoranlar bor. Eng
  mazali Karib taomlari uchun Redcliffe
  ko'chasidagi 'Calypso' kafesiga boring.

  Romantik va tinch ta'til uchun Antiguadan
  yaxshiroq joy yo'q.


SAKKIZ XATONING TAHLILI:

  1  'one of the MORE beautiful islands'
     → 'one of the MOST beautiful islands'
     'one of the ...' — ORTTIRMA daraja qolipi.
     'MORE' — qiyosiy, 'THE MOST' — orttirma.
     Bu ENG KO'P UChRAYDIGAN xato.

  2  'Today, they WERE nice hotels'
     → 'Today, they ARE nice hotels'
     'TODAY' → HOZIRGI zamon.
     Oldingi gap o'tgan zamonda edi ('Two hundred
     years ago ... were'), lekin bu gap BUGUN
     haqida.

  3  'is close BY a beautiful beach'
     → 'is close TO a beautiful beach'
     'close TO' — turg'un birikma.
     'close by' boshqa ma'noda ishlatiladi
     ('yaqin atrofda'), lekin ot bilan 'to' kerak.

  4  'is VERY less expensive'
     → 'is MUCH less expensive'
     'less expensive' — QIYOSIY daraja.
     'very' ODDIY sifat bilan, 'MUCH' esa
     QIYOSIY daraja bilan ishlatiladi.
     Grammar 52-bet qoidasi.

  5  'The most popular FOR tourists'
     → 'The most popular WITH tourists'
     'popular WITH ...' — turg'un birikma.
     48-betdagi 5-mashqning 2-bandi ham shu.

  6  'are the MOST CHEAP and the best'
     → 'are THE CHEAPEST and the best'
     'cheap' — 1 bo'g'inli sifat → '-EST'.
     'the most cheap' XATO.
     DIQQAT: yonidagi 'the BEST' to'g'ri —
     u noto'g'ri sifatning orttirma shakli.

  7  'some of the MUCH delicious dishes'
     → 'some of the MOST delicious dishes'
     'some of the ...' — ORTTIRMA daraja.
     'delicious' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST.
     'much' bu yerda umuman mos emas.

  8  'there is nowhere nicer AS Antigua'
     → 'there is nowhere nicer THAN Antigua'
     'nicER' — QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
     'as' faqat 'as ... as' qolipida.


XATOLARNING TURLARI:
  DARAJA xatosi:   1, 6, 7  (more/most, cheapest)
  KUChAYTIRUVChI:  4        (very → much)
  BOG'LOVChI:      8        (as → than)
  PREDLOG:         3, 5     (by → to, for → with)
  ZAMON:           2        (were → are)


ANTIGUA HAQIDA:
  Antigua — Karib dengizidagi kichik orol davlat
  (Antigua va Barbuda). Plyajlari va quyoshli
  ob-havosi bilan mashhur.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an island    = orol ('s' O'QILMAYDI: 'AY-land')
  the Caribbean = Karib dengizi hududi
  a harbour    = port, bandargoh
  nowhere      = hech qayerda
  a gift       = sovg'a

'one of the MOST beautiful islands'.
Bu ENG KO'P UCHRAYDIGAN xato
(Grammar 54-bet, 8-mashqning 6-bandida ham bor edi).

tasks.prompt: 7  For some of the MUCH delicious Caribbean dishes, go to the Calypso Cafe.
tasks.whyUz:
'some of the ...' → ORTTIRMA daraja.

'much' bu yerda umuman mos emas —

tasks.prompt: 8  For a romantic and peaceful holiday, there is nowhere nicer AS Antigua.
tasks.whyUz:
'nicER' — QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
'as' faqat 'as ... as' qolipida ishlatiladi.

IKKI TOVUSh — JUDA O'XShASh, LEKIN FARQI BOR:

  /tf/  —  JARANGSIZ (ovoz paychalari titramaydi)
           o'zbekchadagi 'Ch' tovushi
           misol: CHOY, CHIROQ
           yozilishi: ch- (chin, chair, cheese)

  /dz/  —  JARANGLI (ovoz paychalari titraydi)
           o'zbekchadagi 'J' tovushi (jurnal dagi J)
           misol: JON, JAHON
           yozilishi: j- (Jane, Jerry, jam)
                      yumshoq g- (gin, gym, giant)


QANDAY TEKShIRISh:
  Bo'g'zingizga qo'lingizni qo'ying va ayting:
     'ch' — titrash YO'Q  → /tf/
     'j'  — TITRAYDI      → /dz/


KITOBDAGI OLTI SO'Z:

  CHIN    /tfin/     →  /tf/     (iyak)
  GIN     /dzin/     →  /dz/     (jin — ichimlik)
  JANE    /dzein/    →  /dz/     (Jeyn — ism)
  CHAIN   /tfein/    →  /tf/     (zanjir)
  CHERRY  /tferi/    →  /tf/     (gilos)
  JERRY   /dzeri/    →  /dz/     (Jerri — ism)


DIQQAT — UCh MINIMAL JUFTLIK:
  Kitob so'zlarni ataylab JUFT qilib bergan —
  faqat BITTA tovush bilan farq qiladi:

     CHIN   /tfin/    ↔  GIN    /dzin/
     CHAIN  /tfein/   ↔  JANE   /dzein/
     CHERRY /tferi/   ↔  JERRY  /dzeri/

  Har juftlikda qolgan tovushlar BIR XIL —
  faqat birinchi tovush farq qiladi.
  Bunday juftliklar 'minimal pairs' deyiladi va
  talaffuzni mashq qilish uchun eng foydali usul.


DIQQAT — 'GIN' ALDAMChI:
  'g' harfi bilan yozilsa ham, /dz/ deb o'qiladi.
  QOIDA: 'g' dan keyin e, i yoki y kelsa —
  odatda /dz/ deb o'qiladi:
     GIN, GYM, GIANT, GENTLE, PAGE, AGE
  Boshqa hollarda /g/:
     GO, GARDEN, GUN, BAG
  ISTISNOLAR: GET, GIVE, GIRL — /g/ bilan.


O'ZBEK O'QUVChILARI UChUN:
  Bu ikki tovush o'zbek tilida ham bor ('ch' va 'j'),
  shuning uchun ularni aytish QIYIN EMAS.
  Asosiy qiyinchilik — YOZILIShIDAN tovushni
  to'g'ri aniqlash ('gin' kabi so'zlarda).

exercises.explanationUz:
UCh QISQA DIALOG — SAYOHAT HAQIDA FIKR BILDIRISh.

  a)  David: What was New York like?
      Julie: Great! The people were really friendly and
             there were lots of interesting places to
             visit!

  b)  Mary: Did you like Ibiza?
      Tony: No, I hated it. It was too crowded and the
            hotel was too noisy.

  c)  John:  What did you think of Paris?
      Sarah: It was fantastic! It had some excellent
             shops and we ate at some wonderful
             restaurants.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  a)  Devid: Nyu-York qanday edi?
      Juli:  Ajoyib! Odamlar juda do'stona edi va
             borib ko'radigan qiziqarli joylar ko'p edi!

  b)  Meri: Ibitsa senga yoqdimi?
      Toni: Yo'q, yomon ko'rdim. U juda gavjum edi va
            mehmonxona juda shovqinli edi.

  c)  Jon:  Parij haqida nima deb o'ylading?
      Sara: Ajoyib edi! U yerda a'lo do'konlar bor edi
            va biz zo'r restoranlarda ovqatlandik.


UCh XIL FIKR SO'RASh QOLIPI — ENG MUHIMI:

  1)  'What was + joy + LIKE?'
         = ... qanday edi?
      DIQQAT: bu yerda 'like' 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS.
      Bu — TASVIRLASh so'raydi.
      Javob: sifat bilan ('Great!', 'It was fantastic!')

  2)  'DID YOU LIKE + joy?'
         = ... senga yoqdimi?
      Bu — HA/YO'Q savoli.
      Javob: 'Yes, I loved it.' / 'No, I hated it.'

  3)  'What did you THINK OF + joy?'
         = ... haqida nima deb o'ylading?
      DIQQAT: 'think OF' — predlog OF.
      Javob: fikr + sabab.


JAVOB BERISh — IJOBIY va SALBIY:

  IJOBIY:
     Great!            = Ajoyib!
     It was fantastic! = Zo'r edi!
     I loved it.       = Juda yoqdi.
     really friendly   = juda do'stona
     excellent shops   = a'lo do'konlar
     wonderful restaurants = zo'r restoranlar

  SALBIY:
     I hated it.       = Yomon ko'rdim.
     too crowded       = juda gavjum
     too noisy         = juda shovqinli


DIQQAT — 'TOO' NING MA'NOSI:
  'too' = HADDAN TAShQARI (salbiy ma'no).
     'too crowded' = juda gavjum (yomon)
     'very crowded' = juda gavjum (betaraf)
  'too' doim MUAMMO borligini bildiradi.

DIQQAT — HAMMA GAP O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
  was / were / did / had / ate / hated
  Sayohat TUGAGAN, shuning uchun past simple.

DIQQAT — 'SOME' IJOBIY GAPDA:
  'some excellent shops', 'some wonderful restaurants'
  Tasdiq gapda 'some' ishlatiladi ('any' emas).

DIQQAT: 'like' bu yerda 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS —

SALBIY javob.
'to hate' = yomon ko'rmoq ('to love' ning aksi).
'TOO crowded' — 'too' HADDAN TASHQARI degani,
doim salbiy ma'noda.

tasks.en: c) John: What did you think of Paris?

'What did you think OF ...?' — predlog OF.
Fikr so'rashning uchinchi usuli.
'think about' ham bor, lekin fikr so'raganda
'think OF' ishlatiladi.

tasks.en: c) Sarah: It was fantastic! It had some excellent shops and we ate at some wonderful restaurants.
tasks.uz: Sara: Ajoyib edi! U yerda a'lo do'konlar bor edi va biz zo'r restoranlarda ovqatlandik.

exercises.instructionEn: To make suggestions we use expressions like: Let's ..., Shall we ...?, Why don't we ...?
exercises.instructionUz: Taklif qilish uchun quyidagi iboralardan foydalanamiz: Let's ..., Shall we ...?, Why don't we ...?
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — TAKLIF QILIShNING UCh USULI:

  1)  LET'S + asosiy fe'l
      'LET'S GO to Rome this year.'
      = Kelinglar bu yil Rimga boraylik.
      → TASDIQ gap, savol EMAS.
      → 'Let's' = 'let us' ning qisqargani.

  2)  SHALL WE + asosiy fe'l ... ?
      'SHALL WE GO to Rome this year?'
      = Bu yil Rimga boraylikmi?
      → SAVOL, oxirida savol belgisi.
      → Eng MUlOYIM shakl.

  3)  WHY DON'T WE + asosiy fe'l ... ?
      'WHY DON'T WE GO to Rome this year?'
      = Nega bu yil Rimga bormaymiz?
      → SAVOL shaklida, lekin TAKLIF.
      → So'zma-so'z 'nega ... qilmaymiz', lekin
        ma'nosi 'kel ... qilaylik'.


UCh IBORANING UMUMIY QOIDASI:
  Hammasidan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli keladi
  ('to' YO'Q, '-ing' YO'Q):
     Let's GO       (Let's to go XATO)
     Shall we GO    (Shall we going XATO)
     Why don't we GO


TAKLIFGA JAVOB BERISh:
  ROZI:
     Okay! / OK, let's go.
     That's a good idea.
     Yes, why not?
  ROZI EMAS:
     I'd rather not.
     I don't think so.
     No, let's ... instead.


DIQQAT — 'LET'S' VA 'SHALL WE' FARQI:
  'Let's go.'      — qaror deyarli qabul qilingan
  'Shall we go?'   — fikr so'raladi (muloyimroq)
  'Why don't we go?' — sabab yo'qligini ta'kidlaydi

tasks.en: To make suggestions we use expressions like: Let's ..., Shall we ...?, Why don't we ...?
tasks.uz: Taklif qilish uchun quyidagi iboralardan foydalanamiz: Let's ..., Shall we ...?, Why don't we ...?

tasks.en: Let's go to Rome this year.
tasks.uz: Kelinglar bu yil Rimga boraylik.
tasks.note:
TASDIQ gap.
'Let's' = 'let us'.
Keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

tasks.en: Shall we go to Rome this year?
tasks.uz: Bu yil Rimga boraylikmi?
tasks.note:
SAVOL shaklida — eng muloyim taklif.
'Shall we' + asosiy fe'l.

tasks.en: Why don't we go to Rome this year?
tasks.uz: Nega bu yil Rimga bormaymiz?
tasks.note:
Savol shaklida, lekin TAKLIF ma'nosida.
'Why don't we' + asosiy fe'l.

tasks.en: Okay! Let's go there then. / That's a good idea.
tasks.uz: Yaxshi! Unda o'sha yerga boraylik. / Bu yaxshi fikr.
tasks.note:
Taklifga ROZI bo'lish javoblari.
16-mashqdagi dialogda ham ishlatilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples and the key language.
exercises.instructionUz: Namunalarni va kalit iboralarni o'rganing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI KALIT QUTI — TO'RT KUChAYTIRUVChI:

     QUITE noisy    ( + )     = ancha shovqinli
     VERY noisy     ( ++ )    = juda shovqinli
     MUCH noisiER   ( +++ )   = ancha shovqinliroq
     TOO noisy      ( - )     = haddan tashqari
                                 shovqinli (YOMON)


ENG MUHIM FARQLAR:

  QUITE — o'rtacha daraja ('ancha', 'ancha-muncha')
     Eng ZAIF kuchaytiruvchi.

  VERY — kuchli daraja ('juda')
     'quite' dan kuchliroq.

  MUCH — FAQAT qiyosiy daraja bilan!
     'much noisIER' TO'G'RI
     'much noisy'   XATO
     Bu — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

  TOO — SALBIY: haddan tashqari, MUAMMO bor
     'too noisy' = shunchalik shovqinliki, chidab
     bo'lmaydi.
     'very noisy' esa shunchaki tasvir.


KITOBDAGI MEHMONXONA MISOLLARI:

  'John has got £100 and wants to spend a weekend
   at a hotel by the sea.'
  (Jonda 100 funt bor va u dengiz bo'yidagi
   mehmonxonada dam olish kunini o'tkazmoqchi.)

     HOTEL A — £30   →  It's VERY cheap.
                        (juda arzon)
     HOTEL B — £50   →  It's QUITE cheap.
                        (ancha arzon)
     HOTEL C — £40   →  It's MUCH CHEAPER than hotel B.
                        (B mehmonxonadan ancha arzonroq)
     HOTEL D — £70   →  It's QUITE expensive.
                        (ancha qimmat)
     HOTEL E — £95   →  It's VERY expensive.
                        (juda qimmat)
     HOTEL F — £120  →  It's TOO expensive.
                        (haddan tashqari qimmat)
                        'He's only got £100.'


NARXLAR NIMANI KO'RSATADI — ENG MUHIM MANTIQ:

  £30 (A)  — eng arzon        → VERY cheap
  £40 (C)  — B dan 10 arzon   → MUCH cheaper THAN B
  £50 (B)  — o'rtacha arzon   → QUITE cheap
  £70 (D)  — biroz qimmat     → QUITE expensive
  £95 (E)  — juda qimmat      → VERY expensive
  £120 (F) — 100 dan OShADI   → TOO expensive

  DIQQAT — 'TOO' NEGA FAQAT F UChUN:
  Jonda faqat £100 bor. £120 — uning PULIDAN
  KO'P, ya'ni u sotib OLA OLMAYDI.
  Shuning uchun 'too'.
  £95 esa qimmat, lekin hali ham MUMKIN → 'very'.

  Bu qoidani ko'rsatadi:
     'TOO' = imkonsiz, muammo bor
     'VERY' = shunchaki yuqori daraja

exercises.instructionEn: Then read the dialogue and fill in quite, very, much or too. Listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng dialogni o'qing va quite, very, much yoki too bilan to'ldiring. Tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: Shall we go to Mykonos for our summer holidays?
  B: Well, it looks VERY nice, but I think it's TOO
     expensive for us.
  A: Why don't we go to Santorini then? It's QUITE
     cheap and VERY pretty.
  B: Okay! Let's go there then. It's MUCH cheaper than
     Mykonos.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Yozgi ta'tilga Mikonosga boraylikmi?
  B: Ha, u juda chiroyli ko'rinadi, lekin menimcha
     biz uchun haddan tashqari qimmat.
  A: Unda nega Santoriniga bormaymiz? U ancha arzon
     va juda go'zal.
  B: Yaxshi! Unda o'sha yerga boraylik. U Mikonosdan
     ancha arzonroq.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ QANDAY ANIQLANADI —
KITOB BELGINI O'ZI BERGAN:

  1)  (++) nice        →  VERY
  2)  (−)  expensive   →  TOO
  3)  (+)  cheap       →  QUITE
  4)  (++) pretty      →  VERY
  5)  (+++) cheapER    →  MUCH

  Belgilar kalit qutisidan:
     (+) = quite,  (++) = very,
     (+++) = much,  (−) = too


ENG MUHIM TEKShIRUV — 5-BAND:
  Bo'shliqdan keyin 'CHEAPER' (qiyosiy daraja) va
  'THAN Mykonos' turibdi.
  'much' FAQAT qiyosiy daraja bilan ishlatiladi →
  boshqa hech qaysi variant mos kelmaydi.
  Ya'ni belgi bo'lmasa ham, javob ANIQ.

  Qolgan to'rt bandda esa sifat ODDIY shaklda
  ('nice', 'expensive', 'cheap', 'pretty') →
  'much' MUMKIN EMAS.


DIALOGDAGI TAKLIF IBORALARI:
  'SHALL WE go to Mykonos ...?'   (1-usul)
  'WHY DON'T WE go to Santorini?' (2-usul)
  'LET'S go there then.'          (3-usul)
  Kitob uchala usulni ham BITTA dialogda ko'rsatgan.


JOY NOMLARI:
  Mykonos   — Mikonos, Yunonistondagi orol
              (qimmat, mashhur)
  Santorini — Santorini, Yunonistondagi orol
              (arzonroq, go'zal)

tasks.whyUz:
(++) → VERY (kalit qutisidan).
'very nice' = juda chiroyli.
DIQQAT: 'nice' ODDIY shaklda → 'much' MUMKIN EMAS.

tasks.prompt: B: ... but I think it's 2) ............ (−) expensive for us.
tasks.whyUz:
(−) → TOO.
'too expensive FOR US' = biz uchun haddan tashqari
qimmat, ya'ni SOTIB OLA OLMAYMIZ.
Mehmonxona F misolidagi bilan bir xil mantiq.
tasks.speak: B: ... but I think it's 2) ............ (−) expensive for us.

tasks.prompt: A: Why don't we go to Santorini then? It's 3) ............ (+) cheap ...
tasks.whyUz:
(+) → QUITE.
'quite cheap' = ancha arzon (juda emas).
'Why don't we ...?' — ikkinchi taklif usuli.
tasks.speak: A: Why don't we go to Santorini then? It's 3) ............ (+) cheap ...

tasks.whyUz:
(++) → VERY.
'very pretty' = juda go'zal.
1-band bilan bir xil belgi.

tasks.prompt: B: Okay! Let's go there then. It's 5) ............ (+++) cheaper than Mykonos.
tasks.whyUz:
(+++) → MUCH.
IKKI DALIL:
  1) belgi (+++) kalit qutisidan
  2) bo'shliqdan keyin 'cheapER ... THAN' —
     QIYOSIY daraja. 'much' FAQAT qiyosiy daraja
     bilan ishlatiladi.
Shuning uchun bu band belgisiz ham ANIQ.
'Let's go there then' — uchinchi taklif usuli.
tasks.speak: B: Okay! Let's go there then. It's 5) ............ (+++) cheaper than Mykonos.

KITOB BERGAN TO'RT ShAHAR (rasmlar bilan):

  ITALIYA (ITALY):
     ROME   —  pretty (++),  noisy (−)
     VENICE —  quiet (+),    beautiful (++)

  FRANSIYA (FRANCE):
     PARIS  —  beautiful (++),  crowded (−)
     NICE   —  sunny (+),       exciting (++)

  Rasmlarda:
     Rim    — Treviy fontani (haykallar bilan)
     Venesiya — kanal va gondolalar
     Parij  — Eyfel minorasi va fontanlar
     Nitstsa — dengiz bo'yidagi oq mehmonxona,
               palma daraxtlari


DIALOG QOLIPI (16a dagidek):

  A: Shall we go to [1-shahar] for our summer holidays?
  B: Well, it looks [++] , but I think it's [−] for us.
  A: Why don't we go to [2-shahar] then?
     It's [+] and [++].
  B: Okay! Let's go there then.
     It's much [qiyosiy] than [1-shahar].


IKKI TAYYOR DIALOG:

ITALIYA:
  A: Shall we go to Rome for our summer holidays?
  B: Well, it looks VERY PRETTY, but I think it's
     TOO NOISY for us.
  A: Why don't we go to Venice then? It's QUITE QUIET
     and VERY BEAUTIFUL.
  B: Okay! Let's go there then. It's MUCH QUIETER
     than Rome.

FRANSIYA:
  A: Shall we go to Paris for our summer holidays?
  B: Well, it looks VERY BEAUTIFUL, but I think it's
     TOO CROWDED for us.
  A: Why don't we go to Nice then? It's QUITE SUNNY
     and VERY EXCITING.
  B: Okay! Let's go there then. It's MUCH SUNNIER
     than Paris.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (ITALIYA):
  A: Yozgi ta'tilga Rimga boraylikmi?
  B: Ha, u juda chiroyli ko'rinadi, lekin menimcha
     biz uchun haddan tashqari shovqinli.
  A: Unda nega Venesiyaga bormaymiz? U ancha tinch
     va juda go'zal.
  B: Yaxshi! Unda o'sha yerga boraylik. U Rimdan
     ancha tinchroq.


DIQQAT — OXIRGI GAPDAGI QIYOSIY DARAJA:
  quiet  → quietER   (bir bo'g'in)
  sunny  → sunnIER   ('-y' → -IER)
  Ikkalasi ham 'much' bilan keladi.

DIQQAT — HAR ShAHARDA BITTA (−) BOR:
  Rome — noisy (−),  Paris — crowded (−)
  Bu KATTA shaharlar, shuning uchun ular
  RAD ETILADI. Venesiya va Nitstsa esa
  tanlanadi — ularda (−) yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Patsy and Bob are trying to choose a hotel to stay at during their holiday. Read the dialogue and fill in the comparative and superlative forms, then listen and check. In pairs, read out the dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: Petsi va Bob ta'til paytida turish uchun mehmonxona tanlashmoqchi. Dialogni o'qing va qiyosiy hamda orttirma daraja shakllarini to'ldiring, so'ng tinglang va tekshiring. Juftlikda dialogni ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh MEHMONXONA HAQIDA SUHBAT:
  THE SUNSET  — qulay, arzonroq, lekin bosh yo'lda
                (shovqinli)
  THE SEAVIEW — eng arzon, tinchroq, lekin
                iflosroq; xodimlari eng do'stona
  THE GRAND   — eng hashamatli, plyajga eng yaqin,
                lekin juda qimmat


TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Bob:   What are you doing, Patsy?
  Patsy: I'm looking at the holiday brochure again.
         There are three hotels in the town, but I
         can't decide which one we should stay at.
  Bob:   Let me see. Hmm ... why don't we stay at the
         Sunset? It looks the MOST COMFORTABLE of the
         three, and it's not as EXPENSIVE as the Grand.
  Patsy: That's true, but it's on the main road, next
         to all the discos and cafes.
  Bob:   So? That means it's in the MOST CONVENIENT
         part of town.
  Patsy: But I'm sure it's much NOISIER than the other
         hotels.
  Bob:   What about the Seaview, then?
  Patsy: Well, it is the CHEAPEST hotel in town, and
         it's probably QUIETER than the Sunset.
  Bob:   Shall we stay at the Seaview, then?
  Patsy: I don't know. It looks quite dirty, don't you
         think?
  Bob:   Perhaps it's not as CLEAN as the others, but
         the brochure says it's got the "FRIENDLIEST
         staff in town."
  Patsy: I like the Grand. It's the MOST LUXURIOUS of
         the three hotels, and it's the CLOSEST to the
         beach.
  Bob:   But it's too expensive! We can't afford it,
         Patsy!
  Patsy: Oh, I suppose you're right. Okay, let's stay
         at the Seaview. I'm sure it will be fine ...


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Bob:   Nima qilyapsan, Petsi?
  Petsi: Yana ta'til bukletiga qarayapman. Shaharda
         uchta mehmonxona bor, lekin qaysi birida
         turishimiz kerakligini hal qila olmayapman.
  Bob:   Qani ko'ray-chi. Hmm ... nega 'Sunset' da
         turmaymiz? U uchtasining eng qulayiga
         o'xshaydi, va 'Grand' chalik qimmat emas.
  Petsi: To'g'ri, lekin u bosh yo'lda, hamma disko va
         kafelarning yonida.
  Bob:   Xo'sh? Demak, u shaharning eng qulay
         qismida joylashgan.
  Petsi: Lekin ishonchim komilki, u boshqa
         mehmonxonalardan ancha shovqinliroq.
  Bob:   Unda 'Seaview' chi?
  Petsi: Ha, u shahardagi eng arzon mehmonxona, va
         ehtimol 'Sunset' dan tinchroq.
  Bob:   Unda 'Seaview' da turaylikmi?
  Petsi: Bilmadim. U ancha iflos ko'rinadi, shunday
         emasmi?
  Bob:   Ehtimol u boshqalar chalik toza emasdir,
         lekin bukletda 'shahardagi eng do'stona
         xodimlar' deyilgan.
  Petsi: Menga 'Grand' yoqadi. U uchta mehmonxonaning
         eng hashamatlisi, va plyajga eng yaqini.
  Bob:   Lekin u haddan tashqari qimmat! Bizning
         imkonimiz yetmaydi, Petsi!
  Petsi: Ha, sen haqsan shekilli. Mayli, 'Seaview' da
         turaylik. Ishonamanki, yaxshi bo'ladi ...


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1)  'the ...... OF THE THREE'
      → 'the ... of' = ORTTIRMA daraja (3 narsa).
      comfortable — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST COMFORTABLE

  2)  'not as ...... AS the Grand'
      → 'as ... as' orasiga ODDIY shakl!
      → EXPENSIVE ('more expensive' XATO)

  3)  'in the ...... PART of town'
      → 'the ...' = ORTTIRMA.
      convenient — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST CONVENIENT

  4)  'much ...... THAN the other hotels'
      → 'much' + 'than' = QIYOSIY daraja.
      noisy — '-y' → NOISIER

  5)  'the ...... HOTEL IN TOWN'
      → 'the ... in' = ORTTIRMA.
      cheap — 1 bo'g'in → THE CHEAPEST

  6)  'probably ...... THAN the Sunset'
      → 'than' = QIYOSIY daraja.
      quiet — 1 bo'g'in → QUIETER

  7)  'not as ...... AS the others'
      → 'as ... as' orasiga ODDIY shakl!
      → CLEAN ('cleaner' XATO)

  8)  'the "...... STAFF IN TOWN"'
      → 'the ... in' = ORTTIRMA.
      friendly — '-y' → THE FRIENDLIEST

  9)  'the ...... OF THE THREE hotels'
      → ORTTIRMA (3 narsa).
      luxurious — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST LUXURIOUS

 10)  'it's the ...... TO THE BEACH'
      → 'the ...' = ORTTIRMA.
      close — '-e' → THE CLOSEST


ENG MUHIM DARS — 2 va 7-BANDLAR ALDAMChI:
  Mashq nomi 'qiyosiy va orttirma shakllarni
  to'ldiring' bo'lsa ham, bu ikki bandda
  sifatning ODDIY shakli kerak —
  chunki 'as ... as' qolipi ishlatilgan.
     'not as EXPENSIVE as'  ✓
     'not as more expensive as'  ✗
     'not as CLEAN as'  ✓
     'not as cleaner as'  ✗


QANDAY ANIQLASh — UCh KALIT SO'Z:
     THAN    bor  →  QIYOSIY daraja
     THE ... OF/IN →  ORTTIRMA daraja
     AS ... AS     →  ODDIY shakl


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a brochure   = buklet, reklama kitobchasi
  to decide    = hal qilmoq
  convenient   = qulay (joylashuv haqida)
  staff        = xodimlar (KO'PLIK ma'nosida)
  luxurious    = hashamatli
  to afford    = imkoni yetmoq
  I suppose    = menimcha, shekilli
  probably     = ehtimol
  perhaps      = ehtimol, balki

Bu — mashqning ENG MUHIM darsi.
tasks.speak: Bob: Perhaps it's not as 7) ............ (clean) as the others, ...

tasks.prompt: Bob: ... but the brochure says it's got the "8) ............ (friendly) staff in town."
tasks.whyUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'THE ... staff IN town'.
'friendly' — '-y' bilan tugagan → THE FRIENDLIEST.
DIQQAT: 'friendly' '-ly' bilan tugasa ham SIFAT,
ravish emas.
'staff' = xodimlar (ko'plik ma'nosida, lekin
fe'l birlikda: 'it's GOT').
tasks.speak: Bob: ... but the brochure says it's got the "8) ............ (friendly) staff in town."

tasks.prompt: Patsy: I like the Grand. It's the 9) ............ (luxurious) of the three hotels, ...
tasks.whyUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'the ... OF the three hotels'.
'luxurious' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST LUXURIOUS.
'luxurious' = hashamatli.
tasks.speak: Patsy: I like the Grand. It's the 9) ............ (luxurious) of the three hotels, ...

tasks.prompt: Patsy: ... and it's the 10) ............ (close) to the beach.
tasks.whyUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'it's THE ... to the beach'.
'close' — '-e' bilan tugagan → faqat -ST →
THE CLOSEST.
'closeest' XATO.
84-betdagi 7-mashqda sinonimi berilgan: 'near'.
tasks.speak: Patsy: ... and it's the 10) ............ (close) to the beach.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the questions below to fill in the blanks.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni to'ldirish uchun quyidagi savollardan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (4 ta savol, 4 ta bo'shliq):
  What did you see there,
  What was China like,
  Did you enjoy the nightlife,
  What did you think of Chinese food


TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: WHAT WAS CHINA LIKE?
  B: It was great! There were lots of interesting
     places to visit and excellent shops.

  A: WHAT DID YOU SEE THERE?
  B: We saw the Great Wall of China and the
     Terracotta Army, a group of large statues that
     are the size of real people, next to the Li
     River.

  A: WHAT DID YOU THINK OF CHINESE FOOD?
  B: It was delicious and quite cheap.

  A: DID YOU ENJOY THE NIGHTLIFE?
  B: Yes, very much. We went to some very
     fashionable nightclubs, but the pubs were
     friendlier and not as expensive as the clubs.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Xitoy qanday edi?
  B: Ajoyib edi! Borib ko'radigan qiziqarli joylar
     va a'lo do'konlar ko'p edi.
  A: U yerda nima ko'rdinglar?
  B: Xitoy devorini va Terrakota armiyasini ko'rdik
     — bu haqiqiy odam kattaligidagi katta
     haykallar guruhi, Li daryosi yonida.
  A: Xitoy taomlari haqida nima deb o'ylading?
  B: Mazali va ancha arzon edi.
  A: Tungi hayot senga yoqdimi?
  B: Ha, juda. Biz juda moda tungi klublarga
     bordik, lekin pablar samimiyroq va klublar
     chalik qimmat emas edi.


HAR BIR JAVOB QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1) Javob: 'It was GREAT! There were lots of
     interesting places ...'
     → UMUMIY taassurot → 'What was China LIKE?'
     DIQQAT: 'like' bu yerda TASVIRLASh so'raydi.

  2) Javob: 'We SAW the Great Wall ...'
     → KO'RILGAN narsalar → 'What did you SEE
       there?'

  3) Javob: 'It was DELICIOUS and quite cheap.'
     → OVQAT haqida fikr → 'What did you think OF
       Chinese FOOD?'

  4) Javob: 'YES, very much. We went to some very
     fashionable NIGHTCLUBS ...'
     → 'Yes' bilan boshlanadi → HA/YO'Q savoli →
       'DID you enjoy the nightlife?'


DIQQAT — Coursebook 85-BETDAGI 15-MAShQ BILAN
BIR XIL QOLIPLAR:
     'What was ... LIKE?'         (tasvir)
     'What did you THINK OF ...?' (fikr)
     'DID you like/enjoy ...?'    (ha/yo'q)
  Uchala fikr so'rash usuli ham shu dialogda.


JAVOBDAGI GRAMMATIKA (Unit 12 mavzusi):
  'the pubs were FRIENDLIER'
     → QIYOSIY daraja ('-y' → -IER)
  'NOT AS EXPENSIVE AS the clubs'
     → tenglik INKORI


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the Great Wall of China = Xitoy devori
  the Terracotta Army     = Terrakota armiyasi
                            (Xitondagi mashhur
                             haykallar)
  a statue                = haykal
  the size of             = ... kattaligida
  real                    = haqiqiy
  a nightclub             = tungi klub
  a pub                   = pab

tasks.whyUz:
Javob UMUMIY taassurot beradi:
'It was GREAT! There were lots of interesting
places to visit and excellent shops.'
→ 'What was China LIKE?'
DIQQAT: 'like' bu yerda TASVIRLASH so'raydi
('yoqtirmoq' EMAS).

Javob KO'RILGAN narsalarni sanaydi:
'We SAW the Great Wall of China and the
Terracotta Army ...'
→ 'What did you SEE there?'
Savolda 'see' (asosiy shakl), javobda 'saw'.

tasks.answer: What did you think of Chinese food
tasks.whyUz:
Javob OVQAT haqida fikr:
'It was DELICIOUS and quite cheap.'
→ 'What did you THINK OF Chinese FOOD?'
DIQQAT: 'think OF' — predlog OF.

Javob 'YES, very much' bilan boshlanadi →
HA/YO'Q savoli → 'DID you enjoy ...?'
Javobda 'nightclubs' va 'clubs' bor →
mavzu TUNGI HAYOT.
DIQQAT: javobda Unit 12 grammatikasi:
'the pubs were FRIENDLIER' (qiyosiy) va
'NOT AS EXPENSIVE AS the clubs' (tenglik inkori).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the phrases in the list. You can use some twice.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan to'ldiring. Ba'zilarini IKKI marta ishlatishingiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta ibora, 10 ta bo'shliq):
  let's, shall, very romantic, more expensive,
  why don't, quite far, the best, most popular

  DIQQAT: 10 bo'shliq, lekin 8 ibora →
  IKKITASI IKKI MARTA ishlatiladi.


TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: SHALL we go out on Saturday? It's my birthday.
  B: Great! LET'S go somewhere special.
     WHY DON'T we go to a nice restaurant like
     Tiffany's?
  A: Well, it's the MOST POPULAR place in town, so
     it's always very busy on Saturdays.
  B: Hmm. You're right. Then, LET'S go to the Cave.
     It's VERY ROMANTIC and it's never too crowded.
  A: Yes, but it's very expensive, and it's QUITE
     FAR. We'll need a car.
  B: I know it's MORE EXPENSIVE than many of the
     other places, but it's also more luxurious and
     the food there is THE BEST in town. And I've
     got my dad's car! So, SHALL we go there then?
  A: Okay, let's go to the Cave.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  A: Shanbada sayrga chiqaylikmi? Bu mening
     tug'ilgan kunim.
  B: Zo'r! Kel biror maxsus joyga boraylik.
     Nega 'Tiffany's' kabi yaxshi restoranga
     bormaymiz?
  A: Ha, lekin u shahardagi eng mashhur joy,
     shuning uchun shanbalarda doim juda gavjum.
  B: Hmm. Sen haqsan. Unda kel 'Cave' ga boraylik.
     U juda romantik va hech qachon haddan tashqari
     gavjum bo'lmaydi.
  A: Ha, lekin u juda qimmat va ancha uzoqda.
     Bizga mashina kerak bo'ladi.
  B: Bilaman, u boshqa ko'p joylardan qimmatroq,
     lekin u hashamatliroq ham va u yerdagi ovqat
     shahardagi eng yaxshisi. Va menda dadamning
     mashinasi bor! Xo'sh, unda o'sha yerga
     boraylikmi?
  A: Mayli, kel 'Cave' ga boraylik.


IKKI MARTA IShLATILGANLAR:
  LET'S  →  2-band va 5-band
  SHALL  →  1-band va 10-band


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

   1) '...... we go out on Saturday?'
      → SHALL (taklif savoli)
      'Shall we ...?' — eng muloyim taklif.

   2) 'Great! ...... go somewhere special.'
      → LET'S (taklif, TASDIQ gap)
      'Let's go somewhere special.'

   3) '...... we go to a nice restaurant?'
      → WHY DON'T (taklif savoli)
      'Why don't we ...?'

   4) 'it's the ...... place in town'
      → MOST POPULAR (orttirma daraja)
      'the most popular place IN town'.

   5) 'Then, ...... go to the Cave.'
      → LET'S (ikkinchi marta)

   6) 'It's ...... and it's never too crowded.'
      → VERY ROMANTIC
      'very' + ODDIY sifat.

   7) 'it's very expensive, and it's ...... .'
      → QUITE FAR
      'quite' + ODDIY sifat.
      Keyingi gap tasdiqlaydi: 'We'll need a car.'

   8) 'I know it's ...... than many of the other
      places'
      → MORE EXPENSIVE
      'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.

   9) 'the food there is ...... in town'
      → THE BEST
      'IN town' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
      'good' → THE BEST (noto'g'ri sifat).

  10) 'So, ...... we go there then?'
      → SHALL (ikkinchi marta)
      Yakuniy taklif savoli.


UCh TAKLIF USULI — HAMMASI ShU DIALOGDA
(Coursebook 86-betdagi quti):
     SHALL we ...?        (1, 10-bandlar)
     LET'S ...            (2, 5-bandlar)
     WHY DON'T we ...?    (3-band)


DIQQAT — DARAJALAR:
  most popular   → ORTTIRMA ('the ... in town')
  very romantic  → ODDIY ('very' bilan)
  quite far      → ODDIY ('quite' bilan)
  more expensive → QIYOSIY ('than' bilan)
  the best       → ORTTIRMA ('in town')

  Ya'ni ro'yxatdagi 4 ta sifat iborasi HAR XIL
  darajada — gapdagi kalit so'zga qarab tanlanadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  somewhere special = biror maxsus joy
  far               = uzoq
  luxurious         = hashamatli
  a cave            = g'or (bu yerda restoran nomi)

tasks.prompt: A: 1) ............ we go out on Saturday? It's my birthday.
tasks.whyUz:
'SHALL we ...?' — eng muloyim taklif savoli.
Coursebook 86-betdagi taklif qutisidan.
Keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli: 'go'.
tasks.speak: A: 1) ............ we go out on Saturday? It's my birthday.

tasks.whyUz:
'LET'S ...' — taklifning TASDIQ shakli
(savol emas, nuqta bilan tugaydi).
'Let's' = 'let us'.
'somewhere special' — sifat 'somewhere' dan KEYIN.

tasks.prompt: B: 3) ............ we go to a nice restaurant like Tiffany's?
tasks.whyUz:
'WHY DON'T we ...?' — taklifning uchinchi usuli.
Savol shaklida, lekin ma'nosi TAKLIF.
'like' bu yerda 'masalan' ma'nosida.
tasks.speak: B: 3) ............ we go to a nice restaurant like Tiffany's?

tasks.prompt: A: Well, it's the 4) ............ place in town, so it's always very busy on Saturdays.
tasks.whyUz:
'the ... IN town' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'popular' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST POPULAR.
'the' gapda allaqachon bosilgan.
tasks.speak: A: Well, it's the 4) ............ place in town, so it's always very busy on Saturdays.

tasks.prompt: B: Hmm. You're right. Then, 5) ............ go to the Cave.
tasks.whyUz:
'LET'S ...' — IKKINCHI marta (2-bandda ham edi).
Kitob aytgan: 'You can use some twice.'
Taklifning TASDIQ shakli.
tasks.speak: B: Hmm. You're right. Then, 5) ............ go to the Cave.

tasks.prompt: B: It's 6) ............ and it's never too crowded.
tasks.whyUz:
'VERY ROMANTIC' — 'very' + ODDIY sifat.
QIYOSLASH YO'Q.
Grammar 52-bet: 'very' + oddiy sifat.
tasks.speak: B: It's 6) ............ and it's never too crowded.

tasks.prompt: A: Yes, but it's very expensive, and it's 7) ............ . We'll need a car.
tasks.whyUz:
'QUITE FAR' — 'quite' + ODDIY sifat.
Keyingi gap TASDIQLAYDI:
'We'll need a CAR' → demak UZOQ.
'far' = uzoq.
tasks.speak: A: Yes, but it's very expensive, and it's 7) ............ . We'll need a car.

tasks.prompt: B: I know it's 8) ............ than many of the other places, ...
tasks.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'expensive' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE EXPENSIVE.
A ning 'it's very expensive' fikrini
tasdiqlamoqda.
tasks.speak: B: I know it's 8) ............ than many of the other places, ...

tasks.prompt: B: ... but it's also more luxurious and the food there is 9) ............ in town.
tasks.whyUz:
'IN town' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'good' — NOTO'G'RI sifat → THE BEST.
'the goodest' XATO.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'the' javobning IChIDA
(4-banddan farqli).
tasks.speak: B: ... but it's also more luxurious and the food there is 9) ............ in town.

tasks.prompt: B: And I've got my dad's car! So, 10) ............ we go there then?
tasks.whyUz:
'SHALL we ...?' — IKKINCHI marta
(1-bandda ham edi).
Yakuniy taklif savoli — B endi A ni
ko'ndirdi va tasdiqlash so'ramoqda.
tasks.speak: B: And I've got my dad's car! So, 10) ............ we go there then?

exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoaga bo'linib ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'zlarni tanlang va gaplar tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochko to'plagan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'YIN QOIDASI:
  • Ikki jamoa
  • Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan bitta so'z tanlanadi
  • O'sha so'z bilan TO'G'RI gap tuziladi
  • Har bir to'g'ri gap = 1 ochko
  • Eng ko'p ochkoli jamoa g'olib


KITOB BERGAN 15 SO'Z:
  clean, quieter, more polluted, oldest, interesting,
  street performers, designer clothes, nightlife,
  sunny weather, heavy traffic, fashionable clothes,
  delicious, noisier, more expensive, crowded


RO'YXAT TUZILIShI — DIQQAT:

  ODDIY SIFATLAR (5 ta):
     clean, interesting, delicious, crowded
     (+ 'sunny weather' ichidagi 'sunny')

  QIYOSIY DARAJADA BERILGANLAR (4 ta):
     quieter, more polluted, noisier, more expensive
     → bularni THAN bilan ishlatish kerak

  ORTTIRMA DARAJADA BERILGAN (1 ta):
     oldest
     → 'THE oldest ... IN/OF' bilan ishlatish kerak

  OT BIRIKMALARI (5 ta):
     street performers, designer clothes, nightlife,
     sunny weather, heavy traffic, fashionable clothes

  HAMMASI Unit 12 ning 82-86-betlaridan.


NAMUNA GAPLAR — HAR BIR SO'Z UChUN:

exercises.instructionEn: Which is the oldest building, the largest park, the busiest road, the most popular cafe, the most expensive restaurant, the most famous square/building in your town/city? Write a short paragraph about your town/city. Start like this: I live in ... . It is in ...
exercises.instructionUz: Shahringizdagi eng eski bino, eng katta park, eng gavjum yo'l, eng mashhur kafe, eng qimmat restoran, eng mashhur maydon/bino qaysi? Shahringiz haqida qisqa xatboshi yozing. Shunday boshlang: I live in ... . It is in ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN BOShLANISh:
  'I live in ... . It is in ...'

OLTI ORTTIRMA DARAJANI ISHLATISh KERAK:
  the oldest building
  the largest park
  the busiest road
  the most popular cafe
  the most expensive restaurant
  the most famous square/building


TO'LIQ NAMUNA (Toshkent haqida):

  I live in Tashkent. It is in the east of Uzbekistan
  and it is the capital city of my country. It is a
  large, modern and very busy city.

  The oldest building in my city is the Kukeldash
  Madrasah. The largest park is the Ecopark and the
  busiest road is Amir Temur Street. There is heavy
  traffic there every morning.

  The most popular cafe is in the city centre and the
  most expensive restaurant is in a big hotel near
  the square. The most famous square in Tashkent is
  Independence Square.

  Tashkent is noisy and crowded, but it is also
  fascinating. I love living here!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Men Toshkentda yashayman. U O'zbekistonning
  sharqida joylashgan va mamlakatimning poytaxti.
  Bu katta, zamonaviy va juda gavjum shahar.

  Shahrimdagi eng eski bino — Ko'kaldosh madrasasi.
  Eng katta park — Ekopark, eng gavjum yo'l esa
  Amir Temur ko'chasi. U yerda har kuni ertalab
  zich transport oqimi bo'ladi.

  Eng mashhur kafe shahar markazida, eng qimmat
  restoran esa maydon yonidagi katta mehmonxonada.
  Toshkentdagi eng mashhur maydon — Mustaqillik
  maydoni.

  Toshkent shovqinli va gavjum, lekin ayni paytda
  maftunkor. Men bu yerda yashashni yaxshi ko'raman!


DIQQAT — 83-BETDAGI MAQOLADAN NAMUNA OLING:
  Oxirgi jumla LA maqolasining oxiri bilan bir xil
  qolipda: 'It's noisy and crowded, BUT it's also
  fascinating.'
  Kamchilikni aytib, ijobiy nota bilan tugatish.

DIQQAT — 'THE' TUShIB QOLMASIN:
  Har bir orttirma daraja oldida 'THE' bo'lishi shart.

sections.title: Writing — a description of a place

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article for a magazine describing a place ...
exercises.instructionUz: Jurnal uchun joyni tasvirlovchi maqola yozganimizda ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — JOY TASVIRLAB MAQOLA YOZISh:

  1) Jurnal uchun joyni tasvirlovchi maqola
     yozganda ma'lumotni MOS KIChIK SARLAVHALAR
     ostida berish mumkin.

  2) BOShLAYMIZ:
        joyning NOMI + JOYLAShUVI
        keyin QISQA umumiy TASVIR

  3) SHUNDAN KEYIN gaplashamiz:
        sayyohlar qayerda TURIShI mumkin
           (accommodation)
        BORIB KO'RISh yoki OVQATLANISh mumkin
           bo'lgan joylar
        qayerda XARID qilish mumkin
        TUNGI HAYOT

  4) TUGATAMIZ:
        joy haqidagi UMUMIY TAASSUROT

  5) SIFATLAR tasvirni QIZIQARLIROQ qiladi.

  6) Bunday yozuvda odatda HOZIRGI zamon
     ishlatiladi.


SXEMA — MAQOLANING TUZILIShI:

   ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
   │  NOMI + JOYLAShUVI + qisqa tasvir    │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  ACCOMMODATION   (turar joy)         │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  PLACES TO VISIT (ko'riladigan joy)  │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  EATING OUT      (ovqatlanish)       │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  SHOPPING        (xarid)             │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  NIGHTLIFE       (tungi hayot)       │
   ├──────────────────────────────────────┤
   │  UMUMIY TAASSUROT                    │
   └──────────────────────────────────────┘


BU SXEMA IKKI MARTA KO'RSATILGAN:
  83-bet — Los Angeles maqolasi
  87-bet — Stratford-upon-Avon maqolasi
  Ikkalasi ham AYNAN shu tartibda yozilgan.


DIQQAT — ZAMON:
  'We normally use PRESENT TENSES in this type of
   writing.'
  Sabab: joy tasviri DOIMIY holatni bildiradi
  ('The town IS ...', 'You CAN visit ...').
  Hikoyada esa (Unit 11) O'TGAN zamon ishlatilgan edi.

DIQQAT — SIFATLAR ENG MUHIM:
  'Adjectives make our description more interesting.'
  romantic, lovely, quiet, friendly, beautiful,
  fascinating, fantastic, delicious, excellent, ideal
  — Stratford maqolasidagi sifatlar.

tasks.en: When we write an article for a magazine describing a place ...
tasks.uz: Jurnal uchun joyni tasvirlovchi maqola yozganimizda ...

tasks.en: When we write an article for a magazine describing a place, we may give the information under suitable sub-headings.
tasks.uz: Jurnal uchun joyni tasvirlovchi maqola yozganimizda ma'lumotni mos kichik sarlavhalar ostida berishimiz mumkin.
tasks.note: 83 va 87-betdagi ikkala maqola ham shunday.

tasks.en: We start by stating the name of the place and its location, then we give a short general description of the place.
tasks.uz: Joyning nomi va joylashuvini aytishdan boshlaymiz, so'ng joyning qisqacha umumiy tasvirini beramiz.
tasks.note:
Stratford: 'This romantic town is in the south-west
of England and is Shakespeare's birthplace.'

tasks.en: After that, we talk about where visitors can stay (accommodation), places to visit or eat at, where to go shopping and the nightlife.
tasks.uz: Shundan keyin sayyohlar qayerda turishi (turar joy), borib ko'rish yoki ovqatlanish mumkin bo'lgan joylar, qayerda xarid qilish va tungi hayot haqida gapiramiz.
tasks.note: BESH kichik sarlavha — 19b-mashqdagi tartib.

tasks.en: We end by giving an overall impression of the place. Adjectives make our description more interesting.
tasks.uz: Joy haqidagi umumiy taassurot bilan tugatamiz. Sifatlar tasvirimizni qiziqarliroq qiladi.
tasks.note:
Stratford: 'Stratford is the ideal place for an
interesting holiday. Don't miss the chance to
visit it.'

tasks.en: We normally use present tenses in this type of writing.
tasks.uz: Bunday yozuvda odatda hozirgi zamondan foydalanamiz.
tasks.note:
Joy tasviri DOIMIY holat →
hozirgi zamon ('is', 'are', 'you can').
Unit 11 dagi hikoyada esa O'TGAN zamon edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the information in the Photo File section, then write an article about Antwerp. Give the information under suitable sub-headings (120 - 150 words).
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi ma'lumotga qarang, so'ng Antverpen haqida maqola yozing. Ma'lumotni mos kichik sarlavhalar ostida bering (120-150 so'z).
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — HALOL OGOHLANTIRISh:
  Bu topshiriq kitobning OXIRIDAGI 'Photo File'
  bo'limidagi Antverpen haqidagi ma'lumotga
  tayanadi. Bizdagi skanda o'sha bo'lim YO'Q.

  Shuning uchun quyida:
    • maqolaning TUZILIShI va QOLIPLARI
      (bular kitobdan — 100% aniq)
    • Antverpen haqidagi UMUMIY ma'lumotga
      asoslangan NAMUNA
      (kitobning Photo File dagi aniq mehmonxona,
       restoran va do'kon nomlari BOShQAChA
       bo'lishi mumkin)

  Kitobingizning orqa qismidagi Photo File
  bo'limini ochib, o'sha yerdagi ANIQ nomlarni
  quyidagi qoliplarga qo'ying.


ANTVERPEN HAQIDA (umumiy ma'lumot):
  Antwerp (golland tilida Antwerpen) —
  Belgiyaning ikkinchi eng katta shahri,
  Shelda (Scheldt) daryosi bo'yida.
  Dunyodagi eng yirik OLMOS savdosi markazi.
  Rassom Piter Paul Rubens shu yerda yashagan.
  Grote Markt (Bosh maydon) va Bizanti uslubidagi
  Onamiz sobori (Cathedral of Our Lady) mashhur.
  Shuningdek moda va dizayn markazi.


TO'LIQ NAMUNA MAQOLA (138 so'z):

  ANTWERP

  This beautiful city is in the north of Belgium,
  on the River Scheldt. It is famous for its
  diamonds and its fashion.

  ACCOMMODATION
  There are many comfortable hotels near the main
  square. The hotels in the centre are more
  expensive than those near the station, but they
  are quiet and friendly.

  PLACES TO VISIT
  Don't miss the Cathedral of Our Lady, one of the
  most beautiful churches in Europe. You can also
  visit the Rubens House and walk around the Grote
  Markt, the old main square.

  EATING OUT
  There are some excellent restaurants near the
  river. Try the Belgian chocolate — it is
  delicious!

  SHOPPING
  For designer clothes, go to the Meir. For
  diamonds, the shops near the station are the best.

  NIGHTLIFE
  The nightlife is exciting. There are lots of
  friendly cafes and clubs in the old town.

  Antwerp is the ideal place for a short holiday.
  Don't miss the chance to visit it!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  ANTVERPEN

  Bu go'zal shahar Belgiyaning shimolida, Shelda
  daryosi bo'yida joylashgan. U olmoslari va
  modasi bilan mashhur.

  TURAR JOY
  Bosh maydon yaqinida ko'plab qulay mehmonxonalar
  bor. Markazdagi mehmonxonalar vokzal yonidagilardan
  qimmatroq, lekin ular tinch va samimiy.

  BORISh KERAK BO'LGAN JOYLAR
  Yevropadagi eng go'zal cherkovlardan biri —
  Onamiz soborini boy bermang. Shuningdek Rubens
  uyiga borib, eski bosh maydon Grote Markt
  bo'ylab sayr qilishingiz mumkin.

  TAShQARIDA OVQATLANISh
  Daryo yaqinida a'lo restoranlar bor. Belgiya
  shokoladini tatib ko'ring — u mazali!

  XARID QILISh
  Dizayner kiyimlar uchun Meir ko'chasiga boring.
  Olmoslar uchun esa vokzal yonidagi do'konlar
  eng yaxshisi.

  TUNGI HAYOT
  Tungi hayot juda qiziqarli. Eski shaharda
  ko'plab samimiy kafe va klublar bor.

  Antverpen — qisqa ta'til uchun ideal joy.
  Unga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang!


SO'Z SONI: 138 — kitob so'ragan 120-150 oralig'ida.


QANDAY QILIB O'ZINGIZNIKINI YOZASIZ:
  1) Photo File dagi ANIQ nomlarni yozib oling
  2) Har birini mos sarlavha ostiga qo'ying
  3) Quyidagi qoliplardan foydalaning
  4) Kamida 6-8 ta SIFAT ishlating
  5) HOZIRGI zamonda yozing
  6) 'Don't miss the chance to visit it!' bilan
     tugating

tasks.answer: This beautiful city is in the north of Belgium, on the River Scheldt. It is famous for its diamonds and its fashion.
There are many comfortable hotels near the main square. The hotels in the centre are more expensive than those near the station, but they are quiet and friendly.
Don't miss the Cathedral of Our Lady, one of the most beautiful churches in Europe. You can also visit the Rubens House and walk around the Grote Markt, the old main square.
There are some excellent restaurants near the river. Try the Belgian chocolate — it is delicious!
For designer clothes, go to the Meir. For diamonds, the shops near the station are the best.
The nightlife is exciting. There are lots of friendly cafes and clubs in the old town.
Antwerp is the ideal place for a short holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it!

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the letter and the chart in Ex. 17 to write an article about Boston.
exercises.instructionUz: 17-mashqdagi xat va jadvaldagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Boston haqida maqola yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOPShIRIQ: XATni MAQOLAga aylantirish.

FARQI NIMADA:

  XAT (Hannah yozgani):
     • shaxsiy ('I', 'we')
     • O'TGAN zamon ('we stayed', 'we went')
     • 'Dear Jennifer' / 'Love, Hannah'

  MAQOLA:
     • umumiy ('you can')
     • HOZIRGI zamon ('there are', 'you can visit')
     • kichik SARLAVHALAR bilan
     • umumiy taassurot bilan tugaydi

  Coursebook 87-betdagi Writing qutisi:
  'We normally use PRESENT TENSES in this type of
   writing.'


TO'LIQ NAMUNA MAQOLA (147 so'z):

  BOSTON

  Boston is a very interesting city on the east
  coast of the USA. It is famous for its colleges,
  like Harvard University.

  ACCOMMODATION
  You can stay at the Ritz-Carlton Hotel, which has
  excellent service, but it is quite expensive. The
  Bertram Inn is cheaper and very clean.

  PLACES TO VISIT
  There are many fascinating places to visit, like
  the Old North Church and the Public Gardens,
  where you can go for a ride in a boat. Don't miss
  the New England Aquarium, where you can see seals
  and a lot of different fish.

  RESTAURANTS
  Boston has hundreds of good restaurants. The best
  one is Monica's, which has delicious pasta
  dishes.

  SHOPPING
  Newbury Street is the best area for shopping. The
  Sunflower and Filene's Basement have much cheaper
  prices than the others.

  NIGHTLIFE
  The nightlife is very exciting. You can dance to
  live pop music at The Roxy or enjoy the great
  atmosphere of the Corner Cafe.

  Boston is the ideal place for an interesting
  holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  BOSTON

  Boston — AQShning sharqiy sohilidagi juda
  qiziqarli shahar. U kollejlari bilan mashhur —
  masalan, Garvard universiteti.

  TURAR JOY
  Siz 'Ritz-Carlton' mehmonxonasida turishingiz
  mumkin — uning xizmati a'lo, lekin ancha qimmat.
  'Bertram Inn' arzonroq va juda toza.

  BORISh KERAK BO'LGAN JOYLAR
  Borib ko'radigan ko'plab maftunkor joylar bor —
  masalan, Eski Shimoliy cherkov va Jamoat bog'i,
  u yerda qayiqda sayr qilishingiz mumkin.
  'New England' akvariumini boy bermang — u yerda
  tyulenlar va ko'plab turli baliqlarni
  ko'rishingiz mumkin.

  RESTORANLAR
  Bostonda yuzlab yaxshi restoran bor. Eng yaxshisi
  — 'Monica's', u yerda mazali makaron taomlari
  bor.

  XARID QILISh
  Nyubari ko'chasi — xarid uchun eng yaxshi hudud.
  'Sunflower' va 'Filene's Basement' narxlari
  boshqalarnikidan ancha arzonroq.

  TUNGI HAYOT
  Tungi hayot juda qiziqarli. 'The Roxy' da jonli
  pop musiqa ostida raqsga tushishingiz yoki
  'Corner Cafe' ning ajoyib muhitidan
  zavqlanishingiz mumkin.

  Boston — qiziqarli ta'til uchun ideal joy.
  Unga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang!


SO'Z SONI: 147.


XATDAN MAQOLAGA — O'ZGARIShLAR:

  'We stayed in the Ritz-Carlton'
     → 'You can stay at the Ritz-Carlton'
  'I took a lot of photographs there'
     → 'you can take photographs there'
  'we went to the Public Gardens'
     → 'you can visit the Public Gardens'
  'The best one SO FAR is Monica's'
     → 'The best one is Monica's'
       ('so far' shaxsiy tajribani bildiradi)
  'On Tuesday I went to The Roxy'
     → 'You can dance ... at The Roxy'


DIQQAT — OXIRGI JUMLA:
  Coursebook 87-betdagi Stratford maqolasi bilan
  bir xil:
     'Stratford is the ideal place for an
      interesting holiday. Don't miss the chance to
      visit it.'

tasks.answer: Boston is a very interesting city on the east coast of the USA. It is famous for its colleges, like Harvard University.
You can stay at the Ritz-Carlton Hotel, which has excellent service, but it is quite expensive. The Bertram Inn is cheaper and very clean.

There are many fascinating places to visit, like the Old North Church and the Public Gardens, where you can go for a ride in a boat. Don't miss the New England Aquarium, where you can see seals and a lot of different fish.
Boston has hundreds of good restaurants. The best one is Monica's, which has delicious pasta dishes.
Newbury Street is the best area for shopping. The Sunflower and Filene's Basement have much cheaper prices than the others.
The nightlife is very exciting. You can dance to live pop music at The Roxy or enjoy the great atmosphere of the Corner Cafe.
Boston is the ideal place for an interesting holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it!

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh MAQOL — HAMMASI 'YO'QLIK' VA 'SAYOHAT'
HAQIDA.


1)  SEE NEW PLACES, MEET NEW FACES.
    = Yangi joylarni ko'r, yangi odamlarni uchrat.

    Bu — UNIT 12 NING NOMI.
    Ma'nosi: sayohat qilish odamni boyitadi —
    yangi joylar yangi tanishlar, yangi tajriba
    va yangi fikrlar olib keladi.

    'faces' (yuzlar) = 'people' (odamlar).
    'places' va 'faces' QOFIYALANADI.

    O'ZBEKChA MAQOL: 'Ko'p yurgan ko'p biladi.'


2)  ABSENCE MAKES THE HEART GROW FONDER.
    = Ayriliq qalbni mehribonroq qiladi.

    So'zma-so'z: 'Yo'qlik yurakni ko'proq
    sevadigan qiladi.'

    Ma'nosi: kimnidir uzoq vaqt ko'rmasangiz,
    uni YANADA KO'PROQ sog'inasiz va qadrini
    bilasiz.

    'absence' = yo'qlik, uzoqda bo'lish
    'fond of sb' = kimnidir yaxshi ko'radigan
    'fonder' = 'fond' ning QIYOSIY darajasi
               (Unit 12 ning grammatikasi!)
    'make sb/sth + sifat' = ... ni ... qilmoq

    O'ZBEKChA MAQOL: 'Ayriliq muhabbatni
    kuchaytiradi.'


3)  OUT OF SIGHT, OUT OF MIND.
    = Ko'zdan yiroq — ko'ngildan yiroq.

    So'zma-so'z: 'Ko'rinishdan tashqarida —
    xayoldan tashqarida.'

    Ma'nosi: kimnidir ko'rmasangiz, asta-sekin
    UNUTASIZ.

    'out of sight' = ko'rinmaydigan joyda
    'out of mind'  = xayoldan chiqib ketgan
    'sight' — 83-betda 'diqqatga sazovor joy'
              ma'nosida edi; bu yerda 'ko'rish'.

    O'ZBEKChA MAQOL: 'Ko'zdan yiroq —
    ko'ngildan yiroq.'


ENG QIZIQ NUQTA — 2 VA 3-MAQOL QARAMA-QARShI!

  2-maqol:  ko'rmasang — KO'PROQ sevasan
  3-maqol:  ko'rmasang — UNUTASAN

  Ikkalasi ham ingliz tilida keng ishlatiladi,
  lekin BUTUNLAY TESKARI narsani aytadi.

  Bu — maqollarning tabiati: ular umumiy
  HAYOTIY HAQIQATNI emas, MA'LUM BIR HOLATNI
  ifodalaydi. Qaysi biri to'g'ri ekani
  vaziyatga bog'liq.

  Xuddi o'zbekchadagi kabi:
     'Yetti o'lchab bir kes' ↔ 'Tez qilgan ishning
      tezi chiqadi'


DIQQAT — 'FONDER' GRAMMATIKASI:
  'fond' (mehribon, yaxshi ko'radigan) —
  BIR BO'G'INLI sifat → 'fondER'.
  Bu — 84-betdagi qoidaning amaliy misoli.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (Dialogue 1)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. (1-dialog)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: WERE you at home last night?
  B: No, I WASN'T. I WENT to hospital.
  A: What HAPPENED?
  B: I FELL off my bicycle and BROKE my arm.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Kecha kechqurun uydamiding?
  B: Yo'q, emasdim. Kasalxonaga bordim.
  A: Nima bo'ldi?
  B: Velosipeddan yiqilib, qo'limni sindirdim.


ZAMON: PAST SIMPLE — hammasi.
  Belgisi: 'LAST NIGHT'.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) '...... (be) you at home last night?'
     'be' fe'lining SO'ROQ shakli:
     WERE + you + ... ?
     'did' KERAK EMAS — 'be' fe'li o'zi
     oldinga chiqadi.

  2) 'No, I ...... (not/be).'
     QISQA javob: 'No, I WASN'T.'
     'I' → was → wasn't.
     DIQQAT: savolda 'were', javobda 'wasn't' —
     chunki savolda 'you' (siz), javobda 'I' (men).

  3) 'I ...... (go) to hospital.'
     go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
     DIQQAT: 'TO HOSPITAL' — artikl YO'Q
     (davolanish uchun borganda).
     'to the hospital' — binoga borganda
     (masalan, kimnidir ko'rgani).

  4) 'What ...... (happen)?'
     happen → HAPPENED (to'g'ri fe'l).
     DIQQAT: 'What' bu yerda EGA →
     'did' KERAK EMAS!
     'What DID happen?' XATO.
     Bu — Unit 11 (Workbook 46-bet) dagi
     EGA/TO'LDIRUVChI savollari qoidasi.

  5) 'I ...... (fall) off my bicycle'
     fall → FELL (noto'g'ri fe'l).
     'fall OFF' = ... dan yiqilmoq.

  6) 'and ...... (break) my arm'
     break → BROKE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
     'break one's arm' = qo'lini sindirmoq.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  be    → was / were
  go    → went
  fall  → fell
  break → broke

tasks.prompt: A: 1) ............ (be) you at home last night?
tasks.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE SO'ROQ, 'be' fe'li bilan.
'you' → WERE.
'be' fe'li so'roqda O'ZI oldinga chiqadi —
'did' KERAK EMAS.
'last night' → o'tgan zamon.
tasks.speak: A: 1) ............ (be) you at home last night?

tasks.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB: 'No, I WASN'T.'
'I' → was → WASN'T.
DIQQAT: savolda 'were' (you), javobda
'wasn't' (I) — ega o'zgargani uchun.

go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: 'TO HOSPITAL' — artikl YO'Q,
chunki davolanish uchun borilgan.
('to THE hospital' — binoga tashrif uchun.)

happen → HAPPENED (to'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: 'What' EGA o'rnida turibdi →
'DID' KERAK EMAS.
'What DID happen?' XATO.
Bu — Unit 11 dagi ega/to'ldiruvchi savollari
qoidasi (Workbook 46-bet).

fall → FELL (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'fall OFF' = ... dan yiqilmoq (predlog OFF).

break → BROKE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'break my arm' = qo'limni sindirmoq.
DIQQAT: 'and' dan keyin ega takrorlanmaydi
(I fell ... and [I] broke ...).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (Dialogue 2)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. (2-dialog)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: ARE YOU GOING out?
  B: Yes, I AM.
  A: Where ARE YOU GOING?
  B: To the sports centre.
  A: Take an umbrella. I think it WILL RAIN.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Tashqariga chiqyapsanmi?
  B: Ha.
  A: Qayerga ketyapsan?
  B: Sport markaziga.
  A: Soyabon ol. Menimcha yomg'ir yog'adi.


ZAMONLAR — IKKI XIL:

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (1, 2, 3-bo'shliqlar)
     Hozir sodir bo'layotgan yoki
     REJALAShTIRILGAN yaqin kelajak.
     'Are you going out?' — hozir chiqyaptimi
     yoki chiqmoqchimi.

  WILL (4-bo'shliq)
     TAXMIN, oldindan REJA EMAS.
     'I THINK it WILL rain' —
     'I think' dan keyin DOIM 'will'.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) '...... (you/go) out?'
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS SO'ROQ:
     ARE + you + GOING?
     → 'ARE YOU GOING out?'

  2) 'Yes, I ...... (be).'
     QISQA JAVOB: 'Yes, I AM.'
     Present continuous savoliga qisqa javob
     faqat 'be' fe'li bilan beriladi
     ('Yes, I am going' emas).

  3) 'Where ...... (you/go)?'
     Yana PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     → 'Where ARE YOU GOING?'

  4) 'I think it ...... (rain).'
     → 'it WILL RAIN'
     'I think' + WILL — TAXMIN qolipi.
     DIQQAT: 'I think it is raining' bo'lsa —
     hozir yog'ayotgan bo'lardi. Lekin gapda
     'Take an umbrella' bor → hali yog'magan,
     KELAJAK haqida gap.


DIQQAT — 'GOING TO' EMAS, 'GOING':
  'Are you going OUT?' — bu yerda 'go out' =
  tashqariga chiqmoq (turg'un ibora).
  'be going to' (kelajak qolipi) BOShQA narsa.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to go out       = tashqariga chiqmoq
  a sports centre = sport markazi
  an umbrella     = soyabon
  to rain         = yomg'ir yog'moq

tasks.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS SO'ROQ:
ARE + you + GOING.
Hozir sodir bo'layotgan yoki rejalashtirilgan
yaqin kelajak.
'go out' = tashqariga chiqmoq.

QISQA JAVOB: 'Yes, I AM.'
Present continuous savoliga faqat 'be' fe'li
bilan javob beriladi.
'Yes, I am going' — to'liq, lekin qisqa javobda
faqat 'am'.

PRESENT CONTINUOUS SO'ROQ:
'Where ARE YOU GOING?'
Savol so'zi ('Where') eng oldinda,
keyin 'are you going'.

tasks.prompt: A: Take an umbrella. I think it 4) ............ (rain).
tasks.whyUz:
'I THINK' + WILL — TAXMIN qolipi.
'it WILL RAIN' = yomg'ir yog'adi (menimcha).
DIQQAT: 'is raining' bo'lsa — hozir yog'ayotgan
bo'lardi. Lekin 'Take an umbrella' aytilgan →
hali yog'magan, KELAJAK haqida gap.
'will' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
tasks.speak: A: Take an umbrella. I think it 4) ............ (rain).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (Dialogue 3)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. (3-dialog)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: CAN I HAVE a cheese sandwich, please?
  B: Yes, here you ARE.
  A: Thanks. How much IS IT?
  B: It IS one pound thirty. Anything else?
  A: No, thanks.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Pishloqli buterbrod bering, iltimos.
  B: Ha, mana.
  A: Rahmat. Qancha turadi?
  B: Bir funt o'ttiz. Boshqa narsa kerakmi?
  A: Yo'q, rahmat.


ZAMON: HOZIRGI — do'kon/kafedagi suhbat.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) '...... (I/have) a cheese sandwich, please?'
     → 'CAN I HAVE a cheese sandwich, please?'

     DIQQAT: bu — buyurtma berish/so'rashning
     standart iborasi.
     'CAN I HAVE ...?' = ... bering, iltimos.
     'May I have ...?' ham to'g'ri, lekin
     rasmiyroq.
     'I have a sandwich, please?' — grammatik
     jihatdan NOTO'G'RI, shuning uchun 'can'
     kerak.

  2) 'Yes, here you ...... (be).'
     → 'Here you ARE.'
     Bu — TURG'UN IBORA: 'Mana' (biror narsani
     uzatganda aytiladi).
     'you' → ARE.
     'Here you go' ham aytiladi (norasmiy).

  3) 'How much ...... (it/be)?'
     → 'How much IS IT?'
     Narx so'rashning standart savoli.
     'it' → IS.
     SO'ROQ tartibi: IS + IT.

  4) 'It ...... (be) one pound thirty.'
     → 'It IS one pound thirty.'
     ('It's one pound thirty.')
     'one pound thirty' = 1 funt 30 tiyin
     (£1.30).


DIQQAT — SO'ROQ VA TASDIQ TARTIBI:
  SAVOL:  'How much IS IT?'   (is + it)
  JAVOB:  'IT IS one pound thirty.' (it + is)
  Tartib TESKARI.


DO'KON IBORALARI:
  Can I have ...?   = ... bering, iltimos
  Here you are.     = Mana.
  How much is it?   = Qancha turadi?
  Anything else?    = Boshqa narsa kerakmi?
  No, thanks.       = Yo'q, rahmat.

  Bu iboralar Unit 8 ('Enjoy your Meal') da
  o'rganilgan edi.

tasks.whyUz:
'CAN I HAVE ...?' — buyurtma berish/so'rashning
standart iborasi = '... bering, iltimos'.
DIQQAT: faqat 'I have a sandwich, please?'
grammatik jihatdan NOTO'G'RI — 'can' kerak.
'May I have ...?' ham to'g'ri, lekin rasmiyroq.
Unit 8 ('Enjoy your Meal') da o'rganilgan.

'HERE YOU ARE.' — TURG'UN IBORA:
'Mana' (biror narsani uzatganda).
'you' → ARE.
'Here you go' ham aytiladi (norasmiy).

'How much IS IT?' — narx so'rashning standart
savoli.
SO'ROQ tartibi: IS + IT (fe'l oldinda).
'it' → IS.

tasks.prompt: B: It 4) ............ (be) one pound thirty. Anything else?
tasks.whyUz:
'It IS one pound thirty.' ('It's ...')
TASDIQ tartibi: IT + IS (ega oldinda).
3-band bilan SOLISHTIRING — tartib TESKARI.
'one pound thirty' = £1.30.
'Anything else?' = Boshqa narsa kerakmi?

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (Dialogue 4)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. (4-dialog)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: When WAS the last time you WENT out for
     dinner?
  B: Last Saturday.
  A: Where DID YOU GO?
  B: To Pierre's, the new French restaurant.
  A: Who DID YOU GO with?
  B: I WENT with Terry and Sandra.
  A: DID YOU HAVE a good time?
  B: Yes, it WAS great.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Oxirgi marta qachon kechki ovqatga
     chiqqan eding?
  B: O'tgan shanbada.
  A: Qayerga bording?
  B: 'Pierre's' ga — yangi fransuz restoraniga.
  A: Kim bilan bording?
  B: Terri va Sandra bilan bordim.
  A: Yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdingmi?
  B: Ha, ajoyib edi.


ZAMON: PAST SIMPLE — hammasi.
  Belgisi: 'the LAST TIME', 'LAST Saturday'.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) 'When ...... (be) the last time ...'
     → 'When WAS the last time ...?'
     'the last time' — BIRLIK → WAS.

  2) '... you ...... (go) out for dinner?'
     → 'you WENT out for dinner'
     DIQQAT: 'did' KERAK EMAS!
     Bu qism SAVOL emas — 'the last time' otini
     aniqlaydigan ergash gap.
     'the last time (WHEN) you WENT out'
     ('when' tushirib qoldirilgan).
     'you did go' XATO.

  3) 'Where ...... (you/go)?'
     → 'Where DID YOU GO?'
     Bu ESA to'liq SAVOL → 'did' KERAK.
     DID + you + GO (asosiy shakl).

  4) 'Who ...... (you/go) with?'
     → 'Who DID YOU GO with?'
     TO'LDIRUVChI savoli → 'did' KERAK.
     'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
     Unit 11 (Workbook 46-bet) qoidasi.

  5) 'I ...... (go) with Terry and Sandra.'
     → 'I WENT with ...'
     TASDIQ gap → 'did' YO'Q,
     fe'l O'TGAN shaklda: WENT.

  6) '...... (you/have) a good time?'
     → 'DID YOU HAVE a good time?'
     SAVOL → DID + you + HAVE (asosiy shakl).
     'Did you had' XATO.
     'have a good time' = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq.

  7) 'Yes, it ...... (be) great.'
     → 'it WAS great.'
     'it' → WAS.


ENG MUHIM DARS — 2-BAND ALDAMChI:
  'When was the last time you ...... out?'

  Bu gapda IKKI qism bor:
     SAVOL:      'When was the last time ...?'
     ERGASh GAP: '... you WENT out for dinner'

  Savol qismi allaqachon 'was' bilan berilgan,
  shuning uchun ikkinchi qismda 'did' KERAK EMAS.

  SOLIShTIRING:
     'the last time you WENT out'   ✓ (ergash gap)
     'Where DID YOU GO?'            ✓ (to'liq savol)


'DID' QAChON KERAK — XULOSA:
  TO'LIQ savolda        →  DID + ega + asosiy fe'l
     (3, 4, 6-bandlar)
  TASDIQ gapda          →  'did' YO'Q, o'tgan shakl
     (5-band)
  ERGASh gapda          →  'did' YO'Q, o'tgan shakl
     (2-band)
  'BE' fe'li bilan      →  'did' YO'Q
     (1, 7-bandlar)

tasks.whyUz:
'the last time' — BIRLIK → WAS.
'be' fe'li bilan savolda 'did' KERAK EMAS.

tasks.promptUz: DIQQAT — bu SAVOL emas, ergash gap
tasks.whyUz:
'did' KERAK EMAS!
Bu qism SAVOL emas — 'the last time' otini
aniqlaydigan ERGASH GAP:
'the last time (when) you WENT out'.
Savol qismi allaqachon 'When WAS ...?' bilan
berilgan.
go → WENT.
'you did go' XATO.

TO'LIQ SAVOL → 'did' KERAK.
DID + you + GO (ASOSIY shakl).
'did you went' XATO.
2-band bilan SOLISHTIRING — u yerda 'did' yo'q edi.

TO'LDIRUVCHI savoli ('kim BILAN') → 'did' KERAK.
DID + you + GO.
'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
Unit 11 (Workbook 46-bet, 14-mashq):
'Who did you go with?'

tasks.prompt: B: I 5) ............ (go) with Terry and Sandra.
tasks.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap → 'did' YO'Q,
fe'l O'TGAN shaklda: WENT.
tasks.speak: B: I 5) ............ (go) with Terry and Sandra.

tasks.whyUz:
HA/YO'Q SAVOLI → DID + you + HAVE (asosiy shakl).
'Did you had' XATO.
'have a good time' = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq.

'it' → WAS.
'be' fe'li — 'did' KERAK EMAS.
Coursebook 85-betdagi 15-mashq bilan bir xil
qolip: 'It was fantastic!'

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, past simple or present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, past simple yoki present continuous ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
FLORA NING IRENGA YOZGAN XATI.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Dear Irene,

  I'm in Edinburgh now, in Scotland! We 1) LEFT
  London last week and 2) TRAVELLED north. Some
  people 3) SAY Edinburgh is the most beautiful
  city in Britain. Well, it's certainly very clean!

  We 4) ARE STAYING in a small, but comfortable
  hotel in the centre, near the castle. It's quite
  expensive, but much cheaper than hotels in
  London. The people here are friendlier and more
  helpful, too.

  There are many interesting places to visit and a
  lot of old buildings. We 5) VISITED the castle
  and Holyroodhouse last week. Yesterday, we
  6) WENT to Edinburgh zoo and did some shopping.

  The Royal Mile has lots of souvenir shops that
  7) SELL traditional Scottish souvenirs and there
  are big department stores on Princes Street, too.

  I really 8) LOVE the food here! There are very
  cosy cafes everywhere that 9) SERVE delicious
  cakes and hot soups. The only problem is the
  weather. It is very cold and it 10) RAINS a lot.

  See you soon,
  Flora


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Iren,

  Men hozir Shotlandiyaning Edinburg shahridaman!
  Biz o'tgan hafta Londonni tark etdik va shimolga
  yo'l oldik. Ba'zi odamlar Edinburgni Britaniyadagi
  eng go'zal shahar deyishadi. Ha, u albatta juda
  toza!

  Biz markazda, qal'a yonidagi kichkina, lekin
  qulay mehmonxonada turibmiz. U ancha qimmat,
  lekin Londondagi mehmonxonalardan ancha arzonroq.
  Bu yerdagi odamlar ham do'stonaroq va
  yordamchiroq.

  Borib ko'radigan qiziqarli joylar va ko'plab eski
  binolar bor. O'tgan hafta biz qal'aga va
  Holirudhausga bordik. Kecha esa Edinburg
  hayvonot bog'iga borib, biroz xarid qildik.

  Royal Mile ko'chasida an'anaviy shotland
  esdaliklarini sotadigan ko'plab sovg'a do'konlari
  bor, Prinses ko'chasida esa katta savdo
  markazlari ham bor.

  Bu yerdagi ovqat menga juda yoqadi! Hamma joyda
  mazali tortlar va issiq sho'rvalar beradigan juda
  shinam kafelar bor. Yagona muammo — ob-havo.
  Juda sovuq va tez-tez yomg'ir yog'adi.

  Tez orada ko'rishguncha,
  Flora


UCh ZAMON — QANDAY TANLANADI:

  PAST SIMPLE — TUGAGAN o'tgan voqea
     Belgisi: last week, yesterday
     Bandlar: 1, 2, 5, 6

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan
     yoki VAQTINChA holat
     Belgisi: 'now', ta'til davomida
     Band: 4

  PRESENT SIMPLE — DOIMIY haqiqat, odat yoki
     his-tuyg'u
     Bandlar: 3, 7, 8, 9, 10


ENG MUHIM BANDLAR:

  4-BAND — 'We ...... (stay) in a hotel'
     Flora ta'tilda va HOZIR o'sha mehmonxonada
     turibdi → VAQTINChA holat →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS: 'ARE STAYING'.
     Xatning boshida 'I'M IN Edinburgh NOW' —
     bu ham hozirgi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

  7 va 9-BANDLAR — 'that' bilan boshlangan qism
     'shops THAT ...... (sell) souvenirs'
     'cafes THAT ...... (serve) cakes'
     Bu do'kon va kafelarning DOIMIY xususiyati →
     PRESENT SIMPLE.
     'shops' va 'cafes' KO'PLIK → '-s' YO'Q:
     SELL, SERVE.

  8-BAND — 'I really ...... (love) the food'
     'love' — HIS-TUYG'U fe'li →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS OLMAYDI.
     'I am loving' XATO → 'I LOVE'.

  10-BAND — 'it ...... (rain) A LOT'
     'a lot' = tez-tez → DOIMIY holat →
     PRESENT SIMPLE: 'it RAINS'.
     'it' BIRLIK → '-S' qo'shiladi.
     DIQQAT: 'it is raining' bo'lsa —
     hozir yog'ayotgan bo'lardi.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  leave → LEFT
  go    → WENT

DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED' YOZILIShI:
  Britaniya inglizchasida 'l' IKKILANADI:
     travel → travELLED
  Amerikada: traveled (bitta 'l').
  Kitob britancha — 'travelled'.


XATDAGI QIYOSIY DARAJALAR (Unit 12 mavzusi):
  'the most beautiful city in Britain'  (orttirma)
  'much cheaper than hotels in London'  (much + qiyosiy)
  'The people here are FRIENDLIER and MORE HELPFUL'
                                        (ikki qiyosiy)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to leave (left)     = tark etmoq
  to travel           = sayohat qilmoq
  north               = shimol
  certainly           = albatta
  a castle            = qal'a
  helpful             = yordamchi, ko'makchi
  a zoo               = hayvonot bog'i
  a souvenir          = esdalik sovg'a
  traditional         = an'anaviy
  a department store  = katta savdo markazi
  cosy                = shinam
  to serve            = (ovqat) bermoq, xizmat qilmoq
  a soup              = sho'rva
  the only problem    = yagona muammo

tasks.whyUz:
'last week' → PAST SIMPLE.
leave → LEFT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'to leave' = tark etmoq.

PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan hafta).
travel → TRAVELLED.
DIQQAT: britancha yozilishida 'l' IKKILANADI
('traveled' — amerikacha).
'travel NORTH' — predlog YO'Q.

tasks.prompt: Some people 3) ............ (say) Edinburgh is the most beautiful city in Britain.
tasks.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE — bu odamlarning DOIMIY fikri,
o'tgan zamondagi bitta voqea emas.
'people' — KO'PLIK → '-s' YO'Q: SAY.
'says' XATO.
tasks.speak: Some people 3) ............ (say) Edinburgh is the most beautiful city in Britain.

tasks.prompt: We 4) ............ (stay) in a small, but comfortable hotel in the centre.
tasks.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — VAQTINCHA holat.
Flora ta'tilda va HOZIR o'sha mehmonxonada
turibdi.
Xatning boshida 'I'm in Edinburgh NOW' —
bu ham hozirgi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.
'we' → ARE + STAYING.
tasks.speak: We 4) ............ (stay) in a small, but comfortable hotel in the centre.

tasks.prompt: We 5) ............ (visit) the castle and Holyroodhouse last week.
tasks.whyUz:
'last week' → PAST SIMPLE.
visit → VISITED (to'g'ri fe'l).
Holyroodhouse — Edinburgdagi qirollik saroyi.
tasks.speak: We 5) ............ (visit) the castle and Holyroodhouse last week.

tasks.prompt: Yesterday, we 6) ............ (go) to Edinburgh zoo and did some shopping.
tasks.whyUz:
'Yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE.
go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: gapda 'DID some shopping' ham bor —
bu ham past simple, tasdiqlaydi.
tasks.speak: Yesterday, we 6) ............ (go) to Edinburgh zoo and did some shopping.

tasks.prompt: The Royal Mile has lots of souvenir shops that 7) ............ (sell) traditional Scottish souvenirs.
tasks.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE — do'konlarning DOIMIY
xususiyati.
'shops' — KO'PLIK → '-s' YO'Q: SELL.
'sells' XATO.
'The Royal Mile' — Edinburgdagi mashhur ko'cha.
tasks.speak: The Royal Mile has lots of souvenir shops that 7) ............ (sell) traditional Scottish souvenirs.

tasks.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE.
'love' — HIS-TUYG'U fe'li → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
OLMAYDI.
'I am loving' XATO.
'I' → '-s' YO'Q: LOVE.

tasks.prompt: There are very cosy cafes everywhere that 9) ............ (serve) delicious cakes and hot soups.
tasks.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE — kafelarning DOIMIY xususiyati.
'cafes' — KO'PLIK → '-s' YO'Q: SERVE.
7-band bilan bir xil qoida.
'to serve' = (ovqat) bermoq.
tasks.speak: There are very cosy cafes everywhere that 9) ............ (serve) delicious cakes and hot soups.

tasks.prompt: It is very cold and it 10) ............ (rain) a lot.
tasks.whyUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE — 'a lot' = tez-tez, DOIMIY
holat.
'it' — BIRLIK → '-S' QO'SHILADI: RAINS.
DIQQAT: 'it is raining' bo'lsa — HOZIR
yog'ayotgan bo'lardi.
Bu yerda esa Edinburgning umumiy ob-havosi
haqida gap.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table, then make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang, so'ng namunadagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL:

 ┌───────────────┬─────────┬──────────┬───────────┐
 │               │  FLATS  │  HOUSES  │  CASTLES  │
 ├───────────────┼─────────┼──────────┼───────────┤
 │ big           │    ✓    │   ✓✓     │   ✓✓✓     │
 │ expensive     │    ✓    │   ✓✓     │   ✓✓✓     │
 │ spacious      │    ✓    │   ✓✓     │   ✓✓✓     │
 │ comfortable   │   ✓✓✓   │   ✓✓     │    ✓      │
 └───────────────┴─────────┴──────────┴───────────┘

BELGILARNING MA'NOSI:
  ✓      →  ODDIY shakl
  ✓✓     →  QIYOSIY daraja + THAN
  ✓✓✓    →  ORTTIRMA daraja + OF ALL


KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (birinchi qator):
  Flats are BIG.
  Houses are BIGGER THAN flats.
  Castles are THE BIGGEST OF all.


BARCHA TO'RT QATOR:

  BIG  (flats ✓, houses ✓✓, castles ✓✓✓)
     Flats are big.                     (NAMUNA)
     Houses are bigger than flats.      (NAMUNA)
     Castles are the biggest of all.    (NAMUNA)

  EXPENSIVE  (flats ✓, houses ✓✓, castles ✓✓✓)
     Flats are expensive.
     Houses are more expensive than flats.
     Castles are the most expensive of all.

  SPACIOUS  (flats ✓, houses ✓✓, castles ✓✓✓)
     Flats are spacious.
     Houses are more spacious than flats.
     Castles are the most spacious of all.

  COMFORTABLE  (castles ✓, houses ✓✓, flats ✓✓✓)
     Castles are comfortable.
     Houses are more comfortable than castles.
     Flats are the most comfortable of all.


DIQQAT — OXIRGI QATOR TESKARI!
  Birinchi uch qatorda:
     flats ✓  <  houses ✓✓  <  castles ✓✓✓
  Oxirgi ('comfortable') qatorda esa:
     castles ✓  <  houses ✓✓  <  flats ✓✓✓

  MANTIQ: qal'alar KATTA, QIMMAT va KENG,
  lekin QULAY EMAS (sovuq, katta, isitish qiyin).
  Kvartiralar esa kichik, lekin ENG QULAY.

  Shuning uchun bu qatorda gaplar QAL'ADAN
  boshlanadi va KVARTIRA bilan tugaydi.


SIFATLARNING YASALIShI:
  big         → bigGER / the bigGEST
                (undosh IKKILANADI)
  expensive   → MORE / THE MOST  (3 bo'g'in)
  spacious    → MORE / THE MOST  (3 bo'g'in)
  comfortable → MORE / THE MOST  (3 bo'g'in)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a flat    = kvartira (Amerikada: apartment)
  a house   = uy
  a castle  = qal'a ('t' O'QILMAYDI)
  spacious  = keng, kengqamrovli

Flats are the most comfortable of all.
