exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BESh BAND — 1-12 unitlarning UMUMIY
TAKRORI.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  C  than
   2  A  older
   3  B  in
   4  A  at
   5  A  carefully
   6  C  because
   7  B  Did
   8  A  ago
   9  B  when
  10  A  could
  11  B  How many
  12  C  some
  13  C  at the moment
  14  A  goes
  15  C  How often


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  Bizning uyimiz siznikidan kattaroq.
   2  Buvim bobomdan katta.
   3  Dunyodagi eng issiq joy qaysi?
   4  Shanba kechasi xitoy restoranida ovqatlandik.
   5  Otam doim juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
   6  Derazani yopdim, chunki tashqarida sovuq edi.
   7  O'tgan yozda ta'tilga bordingmi?
   8  Oxirgi marta televizor ko'rganim ikki soat
      oldin edi.
   9  U olti yoshida birinchi marta futbol o'ynadi.
  10  O'n yoshingda chang'i ucha olardingmi?
  11  Pitsa uchun qancha pomidor kerak?
  12  Kechki ovqatga biroz spagetti sotib olishimiz
      kerak.
  13  Ular hozir nonushta qilishyapti.
  14  Onam har chorshanba supermarketga boradi.
  15  Oilangiz bilan qanchalik tez-tez sayrga
      chiqasiz?


HAR BIR BAND QAYSI MAVZUNI TEKShIRADI:

   1  QIYOSIY daraja + THAN         (Unit 12)
   2  QIYOSIY daraja shakli         (Unit 12)
   3  ORTTIRMA daraja + IN          (Unit 12)
   4  Predlog: eat AT a restaurant  (Unit 8, 12)
   5  RAVISh (-ly)                  (Unit 11)
   6  Bog'lovchi: BECAUSE (sabab)   (Unit 11)
   7  PAST SIMPLE so'roq: DID       (Unit 9-11)
   8  Vaqt ifodasi: ... AGO         (Unit 9)
   9  Bog'lovchi: WHEN (vaqt)       (Unit 11)
  10  COULD (o'tmishdagi qobiliyat) (Unit 9)
  11  HOW MANY (sanaladigan)        (Unit 8)
  12  SOME (tasdiq gapda)           (Unit 8)
  13  PRESENT CONTINUOUS belgisi    (Unit 5-6)
  14  PRESENT SIMPLE, 3-shaxs '-s'  (Unit 5)
  15  HOW OFTEN (chastota)          (Unit 5)


ENG MUHIM BANDLAR:

  5-BAND — SIFAT emas, RAVISh:
     'My father always DRIVES very ...... .'
     'drives' — FE'L, uni RAVISh aniqlaydi:
     CAREFULLY ('carefully' = ehtiyotkorlik bilan).
     'careful' — SIFAT, fe'lni aniqlay olmaydi.
     Unit 11 ning asosiy mavzusi.

  10-BAND — O'TGAN zamon:
     'When you WERE ten ...... you ski?'
     'were' — o'tgan zamon → 'CAN' emas, 'COULD'.
     'couldn't' ham o'tgan, lekin savol shakli
     'Could you ski?' bo'lishi kerak
     (inkor savol mantiqan mos emas).

  11 va 12-BANDLAR — SANALADIGAN / SANALMAYDIGAN:
     'tomatoes' — SANALADIGAN (ko'plik) →
        HOW MANY
     'spaghetti' — SANALMAYDIGAN →
        'a' MUMKIN EMAS, 'any' so'roq/inkorda,
        tasdiq gapda → SOME

  13 va 14-BANDLAR — ZAMON BELGISI:
     'They ARE HAVING breakfast ......'
        present continuous → 'AT THE MOMENT'
        ('yesterday' — o'tgan, 'every day' —
         present simple bilan keladi)
     'My mother ...... every Wednesday.'
        'every Wednesday' → present simple,
        'my mother' BIRLIK → GOES ('-es')

  15-BAND — 'HOW OFTEN':
     'do you go out with your family?' —
     javob 'twice a week' kabi CHASTOTA bo'ladi →
     'HOW OFTEN' (qanchalik tez-tez).
     'How long' — davomiylik,
     'How many' — son.

tasks.whyUz:
C — 'biggER' QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
'as' faqat 'as ... as' qolipida ishlatiladi.
'yours' = 'your house' o'rniga.

tasks.prompt: 2  My grandmother is ............ than my grandfather.
tasks.whyUz:
A — 'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'old' — 1 bo'g'in → OLDER.
'the oldest' 'than' bilan KELMAYDI.

tasks.prompt: 3  Which is the hottest place ............ the world?
tasks.whyUz:
B — 'the hottEST' ORTTIRMA daraja +
'the world' JOY → IN.
Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqning 6-bandi ham
aynan shu savol (javob: Death Valley).

tasks.prompt: 4  We ate ............ a Chinese restaurant on Saturday night.
tasks.whyUz:
A — 'eat AT a restaurant' — turg'un birikma.
Coursebook 84-bet, 6-mashqda ham shu qoida.
'ate' — 'eat' ning o'tgan shakli.

tasks.promptUz: Otam doim juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
tasks.whyUz:
A — 'drives' FE'L, uni RAVISH aniqlaydi.
careful (SIFAT) → carefulLY (RAVISH).
'drives careful' XATO.
Unit 11 ning asosiy mavzusi.

tasks.prompt: 6  I closed the window ............ it was cold outside.
tasks.promptUz: Derazani yopdim, chunki tashqarida sovuq edi.
tasks.whyUz:
C — SABAB ko'rsatilmoqda → BECAUSE.
Nega yopdi? — chunki sovuq edi.
'when' — vaqt, 'but' — qarama-qarshilik.
Unit 11 (Workbook 45-bet) bog'lovchilaridan.

tasks.prompt: 7  ............ you go on holiday last summer?
tasks.whyUz:
B — 'LAST summer' → PAST SIMPLE so'roq → DID.
'Do' — hozirgi zamon,
'Don't' — inkor (savol emas).

tasks.prompt: 8  The last time I watched TV was two hours ............ .
tasks.promptUz: Oxirgi marta televizor ko'rganim ikki soat oldin edi.
tasks.whyUz:
A — 'two hours AGO' = ikki soat oldin.
'ago' vaqt miqdoridan KEYIN turadi.
'before two hours' XATO.
'early' = erta (vaqt miqdori bilan kelmaydi).

tasks.prompt: 9  He first played football ............ he was six.
tasks.promptUz: U olti yoshida birinchi marta futbol o'ynadi.
tasks.whyUz:
B — VAQT ko'rsatilmoqda → WHEN.
'when he was six' = olti yoshida.
'until' = ... gacha (ma'no mos emas),
'but' — qarama-qarshilik.

tasks.prompt: 10  When you were ten ............ you ski?
tasks.whyUz:
A — 'you WERE ten' → O'TGAN zamon →
'can' emas, 'COULD'.
'Could you ski?' = ucha olarmiding?
'couldn't' — inkor (savolda mos emas).
'could' = o'tmishdagi qobiliyat.

tasks.prompt: 11  ............ tomatoes do you need for the pizza?
tasks.whyUz:
B — 'tomatoes' SANALADIGAN (ko'plik) →
HOW MANY.
'How much' — SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan
(how much water).
'How long' — davomiylik.

tasks.prompt: 12  We need to buy ............ spaghetti for dinner.
tasks.promptUz: Kechki ovqatga biroz spagetti sotib olishimiz kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
C — 'spaghetti' SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' MUMKIN EMAS.
TASDIQ gapda → SOME.
'any' so'roq va inkor gaplarda ishlatiladi.
Unit 8 ('Enjoy your Meal') dan.

C — 'ARE HAVING' — PRESENT CONTINUOUS →
'AT THE MOMENT' (hozir).
'yesterday' — o'tgan zamon talab qiladi,
'every day' — present simple talab qiladi.

tasks.prompt: 14  My mother ............ to the supermarket every Wednesday.
tasks.whyUz:
A — 'every Wednesday' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'my mother' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → '-ES': GOES.
'go' XATO ('-s' yo'q),
'is going' XATO (odat uchun continuous emas).

tasks.prompt: 15  ............ do you go out with your family?
tasks.promptUz: Oilangiz bilan qanchalik tez-tez sayrga chiqasiz?
tasks.whyUz:
C — javob CHASTOTA bo'ladi ('twice a week',
'every Sunday') → HOW OFTEN.
'How long' — davomiylik ('for two hours'),
'How many' — son (otdan oldin turadi).

sentencePatterns.formula: A is [qisqa sifat]-ER THAN B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: LA is noisier than Stratford. Stratford is cheaper than LA.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: LA Stratforddan shovqinliroq. Stratford LA dan arzonroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QISQA (1 bo'g'inli) sifat + -ER.
'-y' bilan tugasa → -IER.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is MORE + [uzun sifat] + THAN B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: LA is more expensive than Stratford. LA is more crowded than Stratford.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: LA Stratforddan qimmatroq. LA Stratforddan gavjumroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
UZUN (2+ bo'g'inli) sifat + MORE.
'more cheaper' yoki 'more noisier' XATO —
ikkalasini birga ishlatib bo'lmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is ... , WHILE B is ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Stratford is a quiet place, while LA is a noisy place.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Stratford tinch joy, LA esa shovqinli joy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'while' — qarama-qarshi qo'yish bog'lovchisi ('esa').
Undan OLDIN vergul qo'yiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: The [ot] IN [shahar] are/is + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The streets in Stratford are clean. The hotels in LA are expensive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Stratforddagi ko'chalar toza. LA dagi mehmonxonalar qimmat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Shahar ichidagi narsa uchun 'IN' predlogi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are + sifat + KO'PLIK ot + you can + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are many interesting places you can visit. There are fantastic restaurants you can eat at.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Borishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab qiziqarli joylar bor. Ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ajoyib restoranlar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'you can visit' otni aniqlaydi.
Predlog ('at') gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are + sifat + KO'PLIK ot + you can + fe'l ( + predlog).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are many interesting places you can visit. There are famous restaurants you can eat at.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Borishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab qiziqarli joylar bor. Ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan mashhur restoranlar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat maqolalarining asosiy qolipi.
Predlog ('at') gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: You can + fe'l + ... , LIKE + misol.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can buy cheap fashionable clothes on Melrose Avenue, like designer clothes on Rodeo Drive.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Melrouz avenyusida arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib olishingiz mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'like' bu yerda 'masalan' ma'nosida
('yoqtirmoq' EMAS).

sentencePatterns.formula: one of THE MOST + sifat + KO'PLIK ot
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: one of the most exciting museums in the world
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: dunyodagi eng qiziqarli muzeylardan biri
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'one of the ...' dan keyin DOIM KO'PLIK ot.
ORTTIRMA daraja 'THE' bilan keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is + sifat, BUT it's also + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's noisy and crowded, but it's also fascinating.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U shovqinli va gavjum, lekin ayni paytda maftunkor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Maqolani XULOSA bilan tugatish qolipi:
kamchilikni aytib, keyin ijobiy nota bilan yakunlash.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is home TO + ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's also home to film stars, sunny weather, tall buildings and heavy traffic.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U shuningdek kino yulduzlari, quyoshli ob-havo, baland binolar va zich transport oqimining makoni.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'be home TO' = ... ning makoni bo'lmoq.
Shahar yoki mamlakat tasvirlashda ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is [sifat]-ER / MORE [sifat] THAN B.   (IKKI narsa)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Parthenon is older than the Colosseum. LA is more expensive than my town.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Parfenon Kolizeydan eskiroq. LA mening shahrimdan qimmatroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QIYOSIY daraja — IKKITA narsani solishtiradi.
Doim 'THAN' bilan.
Qisqa sifat → -ER, uzun sifat → MORE.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is THE [sifat]-EST / THE MOST [sifat] OF/IN ... .   (IKKIDAN KO'P)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Great Pyramid of Cheops is the oldest of all. It's one of the most exciting museums in the world.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xeops piramidasi hammasidan eng eski. Bu dunyodagi eng qiziqarli muzeylardan biri.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja — IKKIDAN KO'P narsani solishtiradi.
DOIM 'THE' bilan.
'THE ... OF' yoki 'THE ... IN'.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is AS [oddiy sifat] AS B.   /   A ISN'T AS [oddiy sifat] AS B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My town is as noisy as LA. Stratford-upon-Avon isn't as noisy as LA.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening shahrim LA chalik shovqinli. Stratford LA chalik shovqinli emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TENGLIK qolipi.
'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli
('as noisier as' XATO).
Inkor shakli — A ning B dan KAM ekanini bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is MUCH + [qiyosiy daraja] THAN B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Stratford is much quieter than LA. LA is much more expensive than my town.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Stratford LA dan ancha tinchroq. LA mening shahrimdan ancha qimmatroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'much' farqni KUCHAYTIRADI ('ancha', 'juda').
Faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan ('much quiet' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: ot + ot birikmasi (birinchi ot SIFAT vazifasida)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: film stars, designer clothes, 24-hour cafes, bus-stops
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: kino yulduzlari, dizayner kiyimlar, 24 soatlik kafelar, avtobus bekatlari
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birinchi ot KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI:
'24-hour cafes' ('24-hours' XATO),
'film stars' ('films stars' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: That's true/false. X isn't as [sifat] as Y. Actually, Y is much [qiyosiy] than X.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: That's false. Edinburgh isn't as dangerous as London. Actually, London is much more dangerous than Edinburgh.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Noto'g'ri. Edinburg London chalik xavfli emas. Aslida, London Edinburgdan ancha xavfliroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Rozi bo'lish / bo'lmaslikning UCH qismli qolipi.
'actually' = aslida (fikrni tuzatadi).

sentencePatterns.formula: Which is THE [orttirma] [ot] in the world?  —  THE [orttirma] [ot] in the world IS + nom.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Which is the largest desert in the world? — The largest desert in the world is the Sahara.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dunyodagi eng katta cho'l qaysi? — Dunyodagi eng katta cho'l Sahroi Kabir.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Javobda savol TAKRORLANADI —
og'zaki mashqda to'liq gap talab qilinadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is the [orttirma] OF ALL.   /   X isn't AS [sifat] AS Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Taxis in Britain are the most expensive of all. Buses in Britain aren't as expensive as taxis.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Britaniyadagi taksilar hammasidan qimmat. Britaniyadagi avtobuslar taksilar chalik qimmat emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'the ... OF ALL' — uch va undan ko'p narsadan
eng yuqorisi.
'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: I THINK + [nom] is the [orttirma] [ot] in my city.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think the Town Hall is the oldest building in my city.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, shahar hokimiyati binosi shahrimdagi eng eski bino.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'I think ...' javobni YUMShATADI —
aniq fakt emas, shaxsiy fikr.

sentencePatterns.formula: What was + joy + LIKE?   /   What did you THINK OF + joy?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What was New York like? What did you think of Paris?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nyu-York qanday edi? Parij haqida nima deb o'ylading?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat haqida fikr so'rash.
'What was ... like?' da 'like' — 'qanday',
'yoqtirmoq' EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: It was TOO + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was too crowded and the hotel was too noisy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U juda gavjum edi va mehmonxona juda shovqinli edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'too' = HADDAN TASHQARI — doim MUAMMO borligini
bildiradi ('very' esa betaraf).

sentencePatterns.formula: Shall we + asosiy fe'l ... ?   /   Why don't we + asosiy fe'l ... ?   /   Let's + asosiy fe'l ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Shall we go to Mykonos? Why don't we go to Santorini then? Okay! Let's go there then.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mikonosga boraylikmi? Unda nega Santoriniga bormaymiz? Yaxshi! Unda o'sha yerga boraylik.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Taklif qilishning uch usuli.
Hammasidan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
('to' yo'q, '-ing' yo'q).

sentencePatterns.formula: It's VERY / QUITE / TOO + oddiy sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It looks very nice, but I think it's too expensive for us. It's quite cheap and very pretty.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U juda chiroyli ko'rinadi, lekin menimcha biz uchun haddan tashqari qimmat. U ancha arzon va juda go'zal.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
quite (+) < very (++), too (−) esa SALBIY —
muammo borligini bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's MUCH + QIYOSIY daraja + THAN ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's much cheaper than Mykonos. It's much noisier than the other hotels.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Mikonosdan ancha arzonroq. U boshqa mehmonxonalardan ancha shovqinliroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'much' FAQAT qiyosiy daraja bilan.
'much cheap' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's THE + ORTTIRMA + OF THE THREE / IN TOWN.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It looks the most comfortable of the three. It is the cheapest hotel in town.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uchtasining eng qulayiga o'xshaydi. U shahardagi eng arzon mehmonxona.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'the ... OF' yoki 'the ... IN' —
ORTTIRMA daraja belgisi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's NOT AS + ODDIY sifat + AS ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's not as expensive as the Grand. Perhaps it's not as clean as the others.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 'Grand' chalik qimmat emas. Ehtimol u boshqalar chalik toza emasdir.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli.
'not as more expensive as' XATO.
Bu — 17-mashqning eng muhim darsi.

sentencePatterns.formula: This [sifat] town/city is in the [tomon] of [mamlakat] and is [nima bilan mashhur].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This romantic town is in the south-west of England and is Shakespeare's birthplace.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu romantik shaharcha Angliyaning janubi-g'arbida joylashgan va Shekspirning tug'ilgan joyi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Maqolaning BIRINCHI gapi:
nomi/turi + JOYLASHUVI + qisqa tasvir.
Writing qutisidagi qoida.

sentencePatterns.formula: X and Y are two lovely places TO STAY in [shahar].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Dukes Hotel and The Swans Nest are two lovely places to stay in Stratford.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 'Dukes Hotel' va 'Swans Nest' Stratfordda turish uchun ikki ajoyib joy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ACCOMMODATION bo'limining ochilish qolipi.
'a place TO STAY / TO VISIT / TO EAT AT'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Another fascinating place to visit is X, ONE OF THE [orttirma] [ko'plik ot] in [joy].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Another fascinating place to visit is Warwick Castle, one of the oldest castles in Britain.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yana bir maftunkor joy — Britaniyadagi eng eski qal'alardan biri Uorvik qal'asi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'one of the ...' dan keyin DOIM KO'PLIK ot.
ORTTIRMA daraja 'the' bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: However, for [nima], the [joy] is THE BEST.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: However, for gifts, the street market in Rother Street is the best.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Lekin sovg'alar uchun Rother ko'chasidagi ko'cha bozori eng yaxshisi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'However' = lekin (rasmiy).
'the best' — 'good' ning noto'g'ri orttirma shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is the ideal place for a/an [sifat] holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Stratford is the ideal place for an interesting holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Stratford — qiziqarli ta'til uchun ideal joy. Unga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat maqolasining an'anaviy TUGALLANMASI:
umumiy taassurot + chaqiriq.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is [sifat]-ER / MORE [sifat] THAN B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The city is noisier than the country.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shahar qishloqdan shovqinliroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QIYOSIY daraja — IKKI narsani solishtiradi.
Odatda 'THAN' bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is THE [sifat]-EST / THE MOST [sifat] + OF [guruh] / IN [joy].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The giraffe is the tallest animal of all.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jirafa hamma hayvonlardan eng balandi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja — bitta narsani BUTUN GURUH
bilan solishtiradi.
DOIM 'THE' bilan; OF + guruh, IN + joy.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is (NOT) AS [ODDIY sifat] AS B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My brother is as tall as my father.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Akam otam chalik baland bo'yli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TENGLIK qolipi.
'as' va 'as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli
('as taller as' XATO).
Inkor shakli KAMROQ ekanini bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is MUCH + [QIYOSIY daraja] THAN B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: An elephant is much heavier than a mouse.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Fil sichqondan ancha og'irroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'much' farqni KUCHAYTIRADI.
Faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is QUITE / VERY / TOO + [ODDIY sifat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is quite dark. It is very dark. It is too dark.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ancha qorong'i. Juda qorong'i. Haddan tashqari qorong'i.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
quite (biroz) < very (juda).
'too' esa MUAMMO borligini bildiradi:
'so ... that I can't ...'.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is [QIYOSIY] THAN B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Amazon River is longer than the Mississippi. My father is older than my mother.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Amazonka daryosi Missisipidan uzunroq. Otam onamdan katta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Gapda ikkinchi narsa bo'lsa va 'not as ... as'
ishlatilmagan bo'lsa — QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is THE [ORTTIRMA] [ot] OF all / IN [joy].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The giraffe is the tallest animal of all. Chile is the driest place in the world.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jirafa hamma hayvonlardan eng balandi. Chili dunyodagi eng quruq joy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'of all' → OF (guruh)
'in the world / in the USA' → IN (joy)
DOIM 'THE' bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is NOT AS [ODDIY sifat] AS B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: New York is not as clean as Stratford. The chimpanzee is not as big as the elephant.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nyu-York Stratford chalik toza emas. Shimpanze fil chalik katta emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'as' va 'as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli.
Javobga IKKALA 'as' ham kiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is VERY / QUITE + [ODDIY sifat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This city is very noisy. Joe is quite tall.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu shahar juda shovqinli. Jo ancha baland bo'yli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QIYOSLASH YO'Q — sifat O'ZGARMAYDI.
'very noisier' / 'quite taller' XATO.
5-mashqning 2, 5, 9, 16-bandlari.

sentencePatterns.formula: A has got MORE [ot] THAN B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She has got more toys than her sister.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning opasidan ko'proq o'yinchog'i bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'many' / 'much' → MORE (noto'g'ri sifat).
Sanaladigan ot bilan 'many',
sanalmaydigan ot bilan 'much'.

sentencePatterns.formula: My [qarindosh] is [QIYOSIY] THAN my [qarindosh].   /   My [qarindosh] is THE [ORTTIRMA] IN our family.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My father is taller than my mother. My brother is the tallest in our family.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Otam onamdan baland bo'yli. Akam oilamizdagi eng baland bo'yli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
6-mashqning ikki namunasi:
ikki odam → QIYOSIY + THAN,
butun oila → ORTTIRMA + IN.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is A VERY + [ODDIY sifat] + [ot].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paris is a very expensive city. The Roxy is a very famous club in Boston.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Parij juda qimmat shahar. 'The Roxy' — Bostondagi juda mashhur klub.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'a very' bo'lsa — sifat O'ZGARMAYDI.
'a' artikli va orttirma daraja BIRGA kelmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Were you ... ?  —  No, I wasn't.   /   Did you ... ?  —  Yes, I did.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Were you at home last night? — No, I wasn't. Did you have a good time? — Yes, it was great.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun uydamiding? — Yo'q, emasdim. Yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdingmi? — Ha, ajoyib edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'be' fe'li bilan 'did' KERAK EMAS;
boshqa fe'llar bilan 'did' KERAK.

sentencePatterns.formula: the last time you + O'TGAN fe'l   (ERGASH gap — 'did' YO'Q)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When was the last time you went out for dinner?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta qachon kechki ovqatga chiqqan eding?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savol qismi allaqachon 'When was ...?' bilan
berilgan → ikkinchi qismda 'did' KERAK EMAS.
'you did go' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: I think it WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Take an umbrella. I think it will rain.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Soyabon ol. Menimcha yomg'ir yog'adi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'I think' + WILL — TAXMIN qolipi.
'will' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: We ARE STAYING in ... (VAQTINCHA)   /   We LEFT ... last week (TUGAGAN)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We are staying in a small hotel. We left London last week.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz kichkina mehmonxonada turibmiz. Biz o'tgan hafta Londonni tark etdik.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
VAQTINCHA holat → present continuous.
TUGAGAN voqea ('last week') → past simple.

sentencePatterns.formula: shops/cafes THAT + PRESENT SIMPLE (ko'plik → '-s' yo'q)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: souvenir shops that sell traditional souvenirs; cafes that serve delicious cakes
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: an'anaviy esdaliklarni sotadigan sovg'a do'konlari; mazali tortlar beradigan kafelar
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'that' otni aniqlaydi.
Ot KO'PLIK bo'lsa, fe'lga '-s' QO'SHILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: A are [sifat]. B are [QIYOSIY] THAN A. C are THE [ORTTIRMA] OF ALL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Flats are big. Houses are bigger than flats. Castles are the biggest of all.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kvartiralar katta. Uylar kvartiralardan kattaroq. Qal'alar hammasidan katta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
✓ = oddiy, ✓✓ = qiyosiy + THAN,
✓✓✓ = orttirma + OF ALL.

sentencePatterns.formula: ega + FE'L + RAVISh(-ly).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My father always drives very carefully.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Otam doim juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Fe'lni RAVISH aniqlaydi, sifat EMAS.
'drives careful' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: When you WERE ten, COULD you ... ?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When you were ten, could you ski?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'n yoshingda chang'i ucha olarmiding?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Gap O'TGAN zamonda ('were') →
'can' emas, 'COULD'.

sentencePatterns.formula: What IS/ARE + [ot] LIKE in your town?  —  It IS / They ARE + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is the museum like in your town? — It is a modern building.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shahringizda muzey qanday? — U zamonaviy bino.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'like' bu yerda TASVIRLASH so'raydi
('yoqtirmoq' EMAS).
Ot ko'plik bo'lsa: 'What ARE ... like?'

sentencePatterns.formula: Where can I + fe'l ... in your town?  —  You can + fe'l ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where can I stay in your town? — You can stay in a luxurious hotel.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shahringizda qayerda turishim mumkin? — Hashamatli mehmonxonada turishingiz mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is X + [sifat]?  —  No, it's very/quite + [ZID sifat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is New York a quiet city? — No, it's very noisy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nyu-York tinch shaharmi? — Yo'q, u juda shovqinli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'No' bilan javob berilsa — zid sifat ishlatiladi.
'very' va 'quite' ODDIY sifat bilan keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is home TO ... / popular WITH ... / close TO ... / packed WITH ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: L.A. is home to many film stars. The town is packed with tourists.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: LA ko'plab kino yulduzlarining makoni. Shahar sayyohlar bilan to'lib ketgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TURG'UN birikmalar — predlogi o'zgarmaydi,
yodlash kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: Don't miss the chance to visit ...! There is never a dull moment.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't miss the chance to visit Paris! There is never a dull moment.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Parijga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang! Hech qachon zerikmaysiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat maqolasining TUGALLANMASI —
Coursebook 87-betdagi Stratford maqolasi bilan
bir xil qolip.

sentencePatterns.formula: A has got MORE + [ot] + THAN B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Fisherman's Inn has got more staff than Pebbles Restaurant. Fisherman's Inn has got more tables than Pebbles Restaurant.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 'Fisherman's Inn' da 'Pebbles' dan ko'proq xodim bor. ... ko'proq stol bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'many' → MORE (noto'g'ri sifat).
Ot bilan birga ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is NOT AS + [ODDIY sifat] + AS B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The nightlife in Boston is not as exciting as the nightlife in Los Angeles. The city isn't as polluted as it was ten years ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bostondagi tungi hayot LA dagi chalik qiziqarli emas. Shahar o'n yil oldingidek ifloslangan emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'as' va 'as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY shakli.
A ning B dan KAM ekanini bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A and B are the same ... . A is AS + [sifat] + AS B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The two cars are the same price. The blue one is as expensive as the white one.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ikki mashina bir xil narxda. Ko'k mashina oq mashina chalik qimmat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'the same' — TENGLIK belgisi →
'as ... as' qolipi kerak
('more ... than' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: We paid LESS for X THAN for Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We paid less for accommodation than for entertainment.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz turar joy uchun ko'ngilochardan kamroq to'ladik.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'little' → LESS (noto'g'ri sifat).
'less' fe'ldan keyin, 'than' ikkinchi qismdan
oldin.

sentencePatterns.formula: X was THE MOST + [sifat] + [ot] OF MY LIFE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Last night was the most romantic night of my life.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechagi kecha hayotimdagi eng romantik kecha edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'of my life' — guruh chegaralangan →
ORTTIRMA daraja.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is [QIYOSIY] than B but she's MUCH [QIYOSIY] THAN C.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ruth is older than Teresa but she's much older than Sandra.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Rut Teresadan katta, lekin Sandradan ancha katta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'much' farq KATTAROQ ekanini bildiradi.
Faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is [QIYOSIY] THAN B but C is THE [ORTTIRMA] OF ALL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ruth is taller than Sandra but Teresa is the tallest of all.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Rut Sandradan baland, lekin Teresa hammasidan baland.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir gapda IKKI daraja:
QIYOSIY (ikki odam) va ORTTIRMA (uchtasidan).

sentencePatterns.formula: No, [olmosh] can't. [It/He/She] is TOO + [sifat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No, they can't. It's too cold. No, she can't. She's too young.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'q, o'ynay olmaydilar. Juda sovuq. Yo'q, hayday olmaydi. U juda yosh.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'too' = HADDAN TASHQARI → IMKONSIZLIK.
NARSA/holat → 'IT', ODAM → 'HE'/'SHE'.

sentencePatterns.formula: DO you want/need/know ... ?   (HOLAT fe'llari — '-ing' YO'Q)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you want to come? Do you need anything? Do you know where my jacket is?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kelishni xohlaysanmi? Senga biror narsa kerakmi? Kurtkam qayerdaligini bilasanmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
want, need, know — HOLAT fe'llari →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS OLMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is nowhere [QIYOSIY] THAN X.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is nowhere nicer than Antigua.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Antiguadan yaxshiroq joy yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'nowhere' = hech qayerda.
QIYOSIY daraja → THAN ('as' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: SHALL we ...?  —  LET'S ...  —  WHY DON'T we ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Shall we go out on Saturday? Let's go somewhere special. Why don't we go to a nice restaurant?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shanbada sayrga chiqaylikmi? Kel biror maxsus joyga boraylik. Nega yaxshi restoranga bormaymiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Taklif qilishning uch usuli.
Hammasidan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: What was X LIKE?  /  What did you THINK OF X?  /  DID you enjoy X?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What was China like? What did you think of Chinese food? Did you enjoy the nightlife?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xitoy qanday edi? Xitoy taomlari haqida nima deb o'ylading? Tungi hayot senga yoqdimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat haqida fikr so'rashning uch usuli.
Javobning shakliga qarab savol tanlanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: You can stay at ... , which has ... .  /  It is [QIYOSIY] and very [sifat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can stay at the Ritz-Carlton Hotel, which has excellent service. The Bertram Inn is cheaper and very clean.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 'Ritz-Carlton' mehmonxonasida turishingiz mumkin — uning xizmati a'lo. 'Bertram Inn' arzonroq va juda toza.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Maqoladagi ACCOMMODATION bo'limining qolipi.
HOZIRGI zamon, umumiy 'you can'.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is THE BEST area for ... . They have MUCH CHEAPER prices THAN the others.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Newbury Street is the best area for shopping. They've got much cheaper prices than the others.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nyubari ko'chasi — xarid uchun eng yaxshi hudud. Ularning narxlari boshqalardan ancha arzonroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bir gapda ORTTIRMA, boshqasida MUCH + QIYOSIY.

sentencePatterns.formula: X is the ideal place for a/an [sifat] holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Boston is the ideal place for an interesting holiday. Don't miss the chance to visit it!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boston — qiziqarli ta'til uchun ideal joy. Unga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat maqolasining TUGALLANMASI —
Coursebook 87-betdagi Stratford maqolasi bilan
bir xil.
